Bava Kamma 32a:17-32b:1: Gemara matnitin dela keisi ben yehuda. detanya, isi ben yehuda omer: ratz – chayyayv, mippene shehu meshunne. umode isi beerev shabbat ben hashshemashot shehu patur, mippene sheratz birshut.

Amar rabbi yochanan: halacha keisi ben yehuda. umi amar rabbi yochanan hachi? vehaamar rabbi yochanan: halacha kistam mishna, utenan: echad ratz veechad mehallech, o shehayu shenehem ratzin – peturin!

Mimmay? middekatane: o shehayu shenehem ratzin – peturin. ha tu lema li? hasheta echad ratz veechad mehallech – patur, shenehem ratzin mibbaya? ella hachi kaamar: echad ratz veechad mehallech – patur. bamme devarim amurim – beerev shabbat ben hashshemashot, aval bachol – echad ratz veechad mehallech, chayyayv. shenehem ratzin – afillu bachol peturin.
Amar mar: umode isi beerev shabbat ben hashshemashot shehu patur, mippene sheratz birshut. beerev shabbat may birshut ikka?
"Bou venetze likrat kalla malketa". veamri la: "likrat shabbat – kalla malketa". rabbi yannay mitattef vekae, veamar: "boi challa, boi challa".
Berakhot 18a:12-18b:2: Amar rachava amar rav yehuda: kol haroe hammet veeno melavvehu over mishshum "loeg larash cheref osehu". veim hilvahu ma secharo? amar rav assi, alav hakkatuv omer: "malve Adonai chonen dal" "umechabbedo chonen evyon".

Rabbi chiyyay verabbi yonatan havo shakli veazli bevet hakkevarot. hava kashadya techelta derabbi yonatan. amar leh rabbi chiyyay: dalyay, keday shello yomru: lemachar bain etzlenu, veachshav mecharfin otanu.

Amar leh: umi yadi kulle hay? veha ketiv: "vehammetim enam yodim meuma"! amar leh: im karita — lo shanita. im shanita — lo shillashta. im shillashta — lo pershu lecha. "ki hachayyim yodim sheyyamutu" — ellu tzaddikim shebbemitatan nikreu chayyim, shenneemar: "uvenayahu ven yehoyada ben ish chay rav pealim mikkavtzeel hu hikka et shene ariel moav vehu yarad vehikka et haari betoch habbor beyom hashshaleg".

"Ben ish chay": attu kulle alma bene mete ninhu? ella: "ben ish chay" — sheafillu bemitato karuy chay. "rav pealim mikkavtzeel" — sheribba vekibbetz poalim lattora. "vehu hikka et shene ariel moav" — shello hinniach kemoto lo bemikdash rishon velo bemikdash sheni.
"Vehu yarad vehikka et haari betoch habbor beyom hashshaleg", ikka deamri: detabbar gezize devarda, unechat uteval. ikka deamri: ditna sifra deve rav beyoma desitva.
Isaiah 40:27-41:1: Lamma tomar yaakov utedabber yisrael nistera darki meAdonai umeelohay mishpati yaavor
Halo yadata im-lo shamata elohe olam <small>׀</small> Adonai bore ketzot haaretz lo yiaf velo yiga en cheker litvunato
Noten layyaef koach uleen onim otzma yarbe
Veyiafu nearim veyigau uvachurim kashol yikkashelu
Vekoye Adonai yachalifu choach yaalu ever kannesharim yarutzu velo yigau yelchu velo yiafu {s}
Hacharishu elay iyyim uleummim yachalifu choach yiggeshu az yedabberu yachdav lammishpat nikrava
Isaiah 41:11-16: Hen yevoshu veyikkalmu kol hannecherim bach yihyu cheayin veyovdu anshe rivecha
Tevakshem velo timtzaem anshe matztzutecha yihyu cheayin ucheefes anshe milchamtecha

Hinne samtich lemorag charutz chadash baal pifiyyot tadush harim vetadok ugevaot kammotz tasim

Isaiah 41:17-21: Haaniyyim vehaevyonim mevakshim mayim vaayin leshonam batztzama nashatta ani Adonai eenem elohe yisrael lo eezvem
Eftach al-shefayim neharot uvetoch bekaot mayanot asim midbar laagam-mayim veeretz tziyya lemotzae mayim
Etten bammidbar erez shitta vahadas veetz shamen asim baarava berosh tidhar uteashshur yachdav
Lemaan yiru veyedu veyasimu veyaskilu yachdav ki yad-Adonai asta zot ukedosh yisrael beraah {p}

Isaiah 41:2-5: Mi heir mimmizrach tzedek yikraehu leraglo yitten lefanav goyim umelachim yard yitten keafar charbo kekash niddaf kashto

Asher hechezakticha miktzot haaretz umeatzileha keraticha vaomar lecha avdi-atta becharticha velo measticha
Al-tira ki immecha-ani al-tishta ki-ani elohecha immatzticha af-azarticha af-temachticha bimin tzidki
Mishnah Bekhorot 1:1-5:
Hallokeach ubbar chamoro shel nachri, vehammocher lo af al pi sheeno rashshay, vehammishtattef lo, vehamekabbel mimmennu, vehannoten lo vekabbala, patur min habbechora, shenneemar (Bamidbar 3), beyisrael, aval lo vaacherim. kohanim uleviyyim peturin mikkal vachomer, im patru shel yisrael bammidbar, din hu sheyyifteru shel atzman: 
Para sheyyalda kemin chamor, vachamor sheyyalda kemin sus, patur min habbechora, shenneemar peter chamor peter chamor, shene feamim, ad sheyyehe hayyoled chamor vehannolad chamor. uma hem baachila. behema tehora sheyyalda kemin behema temea, muttar baachila. utemea sheyyalda kemin behema tehora, asur baachila, shehayyotze mehattame, tame. vehayyotze min hattahor, tahor. dag tame shebbala dag tahor, muttar baachila. vetahor shebbala dag tame, asur baachila, lefi sheeno giddulav: 
Chamor shello vikkera, veyalda shene zecharim, noten tale echad lakkohen. zachar unekeva, mafrish tale echad leatzmo. shete chamorim shello vikkeru, veyaldu shene zecharim, noten shene telayim lakkohen. zachar unekeva, o shene zecharim unekeva, noten tale echad lakkohen. shete nekevot vezachar o shene zecharim ushete nekevot, en kan lakkohen kelum: 
Achat bikkera veachat shello vikkera veyaldu shene zecharim, noten tale echad lakkohen. zachar unekeva, mafrish tale echad leatzmo, shenneemar (Shemot led), ufeter chamor tifde vese, min hakkevasim umin haizzim, zachar unekeva, gadol vekatan, tamim uvaal mum. ufode vo peamim harebe. nichnas laddir lehitasser. veim met, nehenim bo: 
En podim lo vaegel, velo vachayya, velo vashshechuta, velo vatterefa, velo vakkilayim, velo vakkoy. rabbi elazar mattir bakkilayim mippene shehu se, veoser bakkoy mippene shehu safek. netano lakkohen, en hakkohen rashshay lekayyemo ad sheyyafrish se tachtav:
Mishnah Berakhot 8:8-9:4:
Ba lahem yayin leachar hammazon veen sham ella oto hakkos, bet shammay omrim, mevarech al hayyayin veachar kach mevarech al hammazon. uvet hillel omrim, mevarech al hammazon veachar kach mevarech al hayyayin. onin amen achar yisrael hamevarech, veen onin amen achar hakkuti hamevarech, ad sheyyishma kol habberacha: 
Haroe makom shennaasu vo nissim leyisrael, omer baruch sheasa nissim laavotenu bammakom hazze. makom shenneekra mimmennu avoda zara, omer baruch sheakar avoda zara meartzenu: 
Al hazzikin, veal hazzevaot, veal habberakim, veal haramim, veal haruchot, omer baruch shekkocho ugevurato male olam. al heharim, veal haggevaot, veal hayyammim, veal hanneharot, veal hammidbarot, omer baruch ose maase vereshit. rabbi yehuda omer, haroe et hayyam haggadol omer baruch sheasa et hayyam haggadol, bizman sheroe oto lifrakim. al haggeshamim veal habbesorot hattovot omer baruch hattov vehammetiv, veal shemuot raot omer baruch dayyan haemet: 
Bana vayit chadash, vekana chelim chadashim, omer baruch shehecheyanu. mevarech al haraa meen hattova, veal hattova meen haraa. hatztzoek lesheavar, hare zo tefillat shav. ketzad. hayta ishto meubberet, veamar, yehi ratzon shetteled ishti zachar, hare zo tefillat shav. haya va vadderech veshama kol tzevacha bair, veamar yehi ratzon shello yihyu ellu bene veti, hare zo tefillat shav: 
Hannichnas lichrach mitpallel shetayim, achat bichnisato veachat bitziato. ben azzay omer, arba, shetayim bichnisato ushetayim bitziato, venoten hodaa lesheavar, vetzoek leatid lavo:
Mishnah Berakhot 9:5: Chayyav adam levarech al haraa keshem shehu mevarech al hattova, shenneemar (Devarim 6) veahavta et Adonai elohecha bechol levavcha uvechol nafshecha uvechol meodecha. bechol levavcha, bishne yetzarecha, beyetzer tov uveyetzer ra. uvechol nafshecha, afillu hu notel et nafshecha. uvechol meodecha, bechol mamonecha. davar acher bechol meodecha, bechol midda umidda shehu moded lecha heve mode lo bimod meod. lo yakel adam et rosho keneged shaar hammizrach, shehu mechuvvan keneged bet kadshe hakkadashim. lo yikkanes lehar habbayit bemaklo, uveminalo, uvefundato, uveavak sheal raglav, velo yaasennu kappandarya, urekika mikkal vachomer. kol chotme verachot shehayu vammikdash, hayu omrim min haolam. mishshekkilkelu hamminin, veamru, en olam ella echad, hitkinu sheyyehu omrim, min haolam vead haolam. vehitkinu, sheyyehe adam shoel et shelom chavero bashshem, shenneemar (Rut b) vehinne voaz ba mibbet lechem, vayyomer lakkotzrim Adonai immachem, vayyomru lo, yevarechcha Adonai. veomer (Shoftim 6) Adonai immecha gibbor hechayil. veomer (Mishlei 23) al tavuz ki zakna immecha. veomer (tehillim kayit) et laasot layya heferu toratecha. rabbi natan omer, heferu toratecha et laasot layya:
Mishnah Chullin 10:4-12:1:
Ger shennitgayyer vehayta lo fara, nishchata ad shello nitgayyer, patur. mishshennitgayyer, chayyav. safek, patur, shehammotzi mechavero alav haraya. ezehu hazzeroa, min happerek shel arkubba ad kaf shel yad. vehu shel nazir. uchenegdo varegel, shok. rabbi yehuda omer, shok, min happerek shel arkubba ad sovech shel ragel. ezehu lechi, min happerek shel lechi ad pikka shel gargaret: 
Reshit haggez noheg baaretz uvechutza laaretz, bifne habbayit veshello vifne habbayit, bechullin aval lo vemukdashin. chomer bazzeroa uvallechayayim uvakkeva mereshit haggez, shehazzeroa vehallechayayim vehakkeva nohagim bevakar uvetzon, bimrubbe uvemuat, vereshit haggez eno noheg ella virchelot, veeno noheg ella vimrubbe: 
Vechamma hu merubbe. bet shammay omrim, shete rechelot, shenneemar (yeshaya 7), yechayye ish eglat bakar ushete tzon. uvet hillel omrim, chamesh, shenneemar (Shmuel 1 25), chamesh tzon asuyot. rabbi dosa ben harekinas omer, chamesh rechelot gozzot mane mane uferas, chayyavot bereshit haggez. vachachamim omrim, chamesh rechelot gozzot kol shehen. vechamma notnin lo. mishkal chamesh selaim bihuda, shehen eser selaim baggalil, melubban velo tzoi, kede laasot mimmennu veged katan, shenneemar (Devarim 18), titten lo, sheyyehe vo chede mattana. lo hispik litteno lo ad shetztzevao, patur. libbeno velo tzevao, chayyav. hallokeach gez tzono shel nachri, patur mereshit haggez. hallokeach gez tzono shel chavero, im shiyyer hammocher, hammocher chayyav. lo shiyyer, hallokeach chayyav. hayu lo shene minim, shechufot ulevanot, machar lo shechufot aval lo levanot, zecharim aval lo nekevot, ze noten leatzmo veze noten leatzmo: 
Shilluach hakken, noheg baaretz uvechutza laaretz, bifne habbayit veshello vifne habbayit, bechullin aval lo vemukdashin. chomer bechissuy haddam mishshilluach hakken, shekkissuy haddam noheg bechayya uveof, bimzumman uvesheeno mezumman. veshilluach hakken, eno noheg ella veof, veeno noheg ella vesheeno mezumman. ezehu sheeno mezumman. kegon avvazin vetarnegolin shekkinnenu vefardes. aval im kinnenu bevayit, vechen yone haredsiot, patur mishshilluach:
Mishnah Chullin 12:2-5:
Of tame, patur milleshalleach. of tame rovetz al betze of tahor, vetahor rovetz al betze of tame, patur milleshalleach. kore zachar, rabbi eliezer mechayyev, vachachamim potrin: 
Hayta meofefet, bizman shekkenafeha nogot bakken, chayyav leshalleach. en kenafeha nogot bakken, patur milleshalleach. en sham ella efroach echad o vetza achat, chayyav leshalleach, shenneemar (Devarim 22), kan, ken mikkol makom. hayu sham efrochin mafrichin o vetzim muzarot, patur milleshalleach, shenneemar (sham), vehaem rovetzet al haefrochim o al habbetzim, ma efrochin bene keyama, af betzim bene keyama, yatzu muzarot. uma habbetzim tzerichin leimman, af haefrochin tzerichin leimman, yatzu mafrichin. shillechah vechazra, shillechah vechazra, afillu arbaa vachamishsha feamim, chayyav, shenneemar (sham), shalleach teshallach. amar, hareni notel et haem umeshalleach et habbanim, chayyav leshalleach, shenneemar (sham), shalleach teshallach et haem. natal habbanim vehecheziran lakken veachar kach chazra haem alehem, patur milleshalleach: 
Hannotel em al habbanim, rabbi yehuda omer, loke veeno meshalleach. vachachamim omrim, meshalleach veeno loke. ze hakkelal, kol mitzvat lo taase sheyyesh bah kum ase, en lokin aleha: 
Lo yittol adam em al habbanim, afillu letaher et hammetzora. uma im mitzva kalla shehi cheissar, amra tora (Devarim 22), lemaan yitav lach vehaarachta yamim, kal vachomer al mitzvot chamurot shebbattora:
Mishnah Chullin 8:5-9:2:
Kevat nachri veshel nevela, hare zo asura. hammaamid beor shel keva cheshera, im yesh benoten taam, hare zo asura. keshera sheyyanka min hatterefa, kevatah asura. terefa sheyyanka min hakkeshera, kevatah mutteret, mippene shekkanus bemeeha: 
Chomer bachelev mibbaddam, vechomer baddam mibbachelev. chomer bachelev, shehachelev moalin bo, vechayyavin alav mishshum piggul venotar vetame, ma sheen ken baddam. vechomer baddam, shehaddam noheg bivhema vechayya vaof, ben temeim uven tehorim, vechelev eno noheg ella bivhema tehora vilvad: 
Haor, veharotev, vehakkippa, vehaelal, vehaatzamot, vehaggidin, vehakkarnayim, vehattelafayim, mitztarfin letamme tumat ochalim, aval lo tumat nevelot. kayyotze vo, hashshochet behema temea lenachri umefarkeset, metammea tumat ochalin, aval lo tumat nevelot, ad shettamut o ad sheyyattiz et roshah. ribba letamme tumat ochalin mimma sheribba letamme tumat nevelot. rabbi yehuda omer, haelal hamechunnas, im yesh bo chazzayit bemakom echad, chayyav alav: 
Ellu sheorotehen kivsaran, or haadam, veor chazir shel yishshuv. rabbi yose omer, af or chazir habbar. veor chatoteret shel gamal harakka, veor harosh shel egel harach, veor happerasot, veor bet habboshet, veor hashshalil, veor shettachat haalya, veor haanaka vehakkoach vehalletaa vehachomet. rabbi yehuda omer, halletaa chachulda. vechullan sheibbedan o shehillech bahen kede avoda, tehorin, chutz meor haadam. rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer, shemona sheratzim yesh lahen orot:
Mishnah Chullin 9:3-7:
Hammafshit babbehema uvachayya, battehora uvattemea, baddakka uvaggassa, leshatiach, kede achiza. ulechemet, ad sheyyafshit et hechaze. hammargil, kullo chibbur lattuma, littame uletamme. or sheal hatztzavvar, rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer, eno chibbur. vachachamim omrim, chibbur, ad sheyyafshit et kullo: 
Or sheyyesh alav kazzayit basar, hannoge betziv hayyotze mimmennu, uvesaara shekkenegdo, tame. hayu alav kishne chatzae zetim, metamme vemassa velo vemagga, divre rabbi yishmael. rabbi akiva omer, lo vemagga velo vemassa. umode rabbi akiva bishne chatzae zetim shettechavan bekesam vehesitan, shehu tame. umippene ma rabbi akiva metaher baor, mippene shehaor mevattelan: 
Kulit hammet vekulit hammukdashim, hannogea bahen, ben setumim ben nekuvim, tame. kulit nevela vekulit hashsheretz, hannogea bahen setumim, tehorim. nekuvim kol shehu, mittamme vemagga. minnayin sheaf bemassa, talmud lomar (Vayikra 11), hannogea vehannose, et shebba lichlal magga, ba lichlal massa, lo va lichlal magga, lo va lichlal massa: 
Betzat hashsheretz hamerukkemet, tehora. nikkeva chol shehu, temea. achbar shechetzyo vasar vechetzyo adama, hannogea babbasar, tame. baadama, tahor. rabbi yehuda omer, af hannogea baadama shekkeneged habbasar, tame: 
Haevar vehabbasar hameduldalin bivhema, metammein tumat ochalin bimkoman, utzerichin hechsher. nishchata vehema, huchsheru vedameha, divre rabbi meir. rabbi shimon omer, lo huchsharu. meta habbehema, habbasar tzarich hechsher. haevar metamme mishshum evar min hachay veeno metamme mishshum evar nevela, divre rabbi meir. verabbi shimon metaher:
Mishnah Chullin 9:8-10:3:
Haevar vehabbasar hameduldalin baadam, tehorin. met haadam, habbasar tahor. haevar metamme mishshum evar min hachay veeno metamme mishshum evar min hammet, divre rabbi meir. verabbi shimon metaher: 
Hazzeroa vehallechayayim vehakkeva nohagin baaretz uvechutza laaretz, bifne habbayit veshello vifne habbayit, bechullin aval lo vemukdashin. shehaya vaddin, uma im hachullin, sheenan chayyavin bechaze vashok, chayyavin bammattanot, kadashim shechayyavin bechaze vashok, eno din shechayyavin bammattanot. talmud lomar (Vayikra 7), vaetten otam leaharon hakkohen ulevanav lechak olam, en lo ella ma sheamur bainyan: 
Kol hakkodashim shekkadam mum kavua lehekdeshan venifdu, chayyavin babbechora uvammattanot, veyotzin lechullin, lehiggazez uleheaved, uveladan vachalavan muttar leachar pidyonan, vehashshochatan bachutz patur, veen osin temura, veim metu yippadu, chutz min habbechor umin hammaaser. kol shekkadam hekdeshan et muman, o mum over lehekdeshan, uleachar mikkan nolad lahem mum kavua venifdu, peturin min habbechora umin hammattanot, veenan yotzin lechullin lehiggazez uleheaved, uveladan vachalavan asur leachar pidyonan, vehashshochatan bachutz chayyav, veosin temura, veim metu, yikkaveru: 
Bechor shennitarev bemea, bizman shemmea shochatin et kullan, potrin et kullan. echad shochet et kullan, potrin lo echad. hashshochet lechohen ulenachri, patur min hammattanot. vehammishtattef immahen, tzarich sheyyirshom. veim amar chutz min hammattanot, patur min hammattanot. amar, mechor li vene meeha shel para, vehayu vahen mattanot, notnan lechohen veeno menakke lo min haddamim. lakach hemennu vemishkal, notnan lechohen umenakke lo min haddamim:
Mishnah Ketubot 1:1-2:
Betula nisset layyom harvii, vealmana layyom hachamishi. sheppaamayim bashshabbat batte dinin yoshvin baayarot, bayyom hashsheni uvayyom hachamishi, sheim haya lo taanat betulim, haya mashkim levet din: 
Betula, ketubbatah matayim. vealmana, mane. betula almana, gerusha, vachalutza, min haerusin, ketubbatan matayim, veyesh lahen taanat betulim. haggiyyoret, vehashshevuya, vehashshifcha shennifdu veshennitgayyeru, veshennishtachreru, pechutot mibbenot shalosh shanim veyom echad, ketubbatan matayim, veyesh lahen taanat betulim:
Mishnah Ketubot 1:3-6:
Haggadol shebba al hakketanna, vekatan shebba al haggedola, umukkat etz, ketubbatan matayim, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, mukkat etz, ketubbatah mane: 
Betula almana, gerusha, vachalutza, min hannissuin, ketubbatah mane, veen lahen taanat betulim. haggiyyoret, vehashshevuya, vehashshifcha, shennifdu, veshennitgayyeru, veshennishtachreru, yeterot al benot shalosh shanim veyom echad, ketubbatan mane, veen lahen taanat betulin: 
Haochel etzel chamiv bihuda shello veedim, eno yachol liton taanat betulim, mippene shemmityached immah. achat almenat yisrael veachat almenat kohen, ketubbatan mane. bet din shel kohanim hayu govin labbetula arba meot zuz, velo michu veyadam chachamim: 
Hannose et haishsha velo matza lah betulim, hi omeret, mishsheerastani neenasti, venistachafa sadecha. vehalla omer, lo chi, ella ad shello erastich, vehaya mikkachi mekkach taut. rabban gamliel verabbi eliezer omrim, neemenet. rabbi yehoshua omer, lo mippiha anu chayyin, ella hare zo vechezkat beula ad shello titares, vehitattu, ad shettavi reaya lidvareha:
Mishnah Ketubot 1:7-10:
Hi omeret mukkat etz ani, vehu omer, lo chi, ella derusat ish at, rabban gamliel verabbi eliezer omrim, neemenet. verabbi yehoshua omer, lo mippiha anu chayyin, ella hare zo vechezkat derusat ish, ad shettavi reaya lidvareha: 
Rauha medabberet im echad bashshuk, amru lah ma tivo shel ze. ish peloni vechohen hu. rabban gamliel verabbi eliezer omrim, neemenet. verabbi yehoshua omer, lo mippiha anu chayyin, ella hare zo vechezkat beula lenatin ulemamzer, ad shettavi reaya lidvareha: 
Hayta meubberet, veamru lah ma tivo shel ubbar ze. meish peloni vechohen hu. rabban gamliel verabbi eliezer omrim, neemenet. rabbi yehoshua omer, lo mippiha anu chayyin, ella hare zo vechezkat meubberet lenatin ulemamzer, ad shettavi reaya lidvareha: 
Amar rabbi yose, maase vetinoket sheyyarda lemallot mayim min haayin, veneensa. amar rabbi yochanan ben nuri, im rov anshe hair massiin lakkehunna, hare zo tinnase lakkehunna:
Mishnah Peah 1:1-3: Ellu devarim sheen lahem shiur. happea, vehabbikkurim, vehareayon, ugemilut chasadim, vetalmud tora. ellu devarim sheadam ochel perotehen baolam hazze vehakkeren kayyemet lo laolam habba. kibbud av vaem, ugemilut chasadim, vahavaat shalom ben adam lachavero, vetalmud tora keneged kullam:
En pochatin lappea mishshishshim, veaf al pi sheamru en lappea shiur. hakkol lefi godel hassade, ulefi rov haaniyyim, ulefi rov haanava:

Notnin pea mittechillat hassade umeemtzaah. rabbi shimon omer, uvilvad sheyyitten bassof kashshiur. rabbi yehuda omer, im shiyyer kelach echad, somech lo mishshum pea. veim lav, eno noten ella mishshum hefker:
Mishnah Peah 1:4-2:1: Kelal amru bappea. kol shehu ochel, venishmar, vegiddulav min haaretz, ulekitato cheachat, umachniso lekiyyum, chayyav bappea. vehattevua vehakkitniyyot bakkelal hazze:
Uvailan, haog vehecharuvin vehaegozim vehashshekedim vehaggefanim veharimmonim vehazzetim vehattemarim, chayyavin bappea:

Leolam hu noten mishshum pea ufatur min hammaasrot, ad sheyyemareach. venoten mishshum hefker ufatur min hammaasrot, ad sheyyemareach. umaachil labbehema velachayya velaofot ufatur min hammaasrot, ad sheyyemareach. venotel min haggoren vezorea ufatur min hammaasrot, ad sheyyemareach, divre rabbi akiva. kohen velevi shellakchu et haggoren, hammaasrot shellahem, ad sheyyemareach. hammakdish ufode, chayyav bemaasrot, ad sheyyemareach haggizbar:

Veellu mafsikin lappea. hannachal, vehashshelulit, vederech hayyachid, vederech harabbim, ushevil harabbim, ushevil hayyachid hakkavua bimot hachamma uvimot haggeshamim, vehabbur, vehannir, vezera acher. vehakkotzer leshachat mafsik, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, eno mafsik, ella im ken charash:
Mishnah Peah 2:2-6:
Ammat hammayim sheenah yechola lehikkatzer keachat, rabbi yehuda omer, mafseket. vechol heharim asher bammader yeaderun, af al pi sheen habbakar yachol laavor bechelav, hu noten pea lakkol: 
Hakkol mafsik lazzeraim, veeno mafsik lailan ella gader. veim haya sear kotesh, eno mafsik, ella noten pea lakkol: 
Velecharuvin, kol haroin ze et ze. amar rabban gamliel, nohagin hayu bet abba, notnin pea achat lazzetim shehayu lahem bechol ruach, velecharuvin, kol haroin ze et ze. rabbi eliezer berabbi tzadok omer mishshemo, af lecharuvin shehayu lahem bechol hair: 
Hazzorea et sadehu min echad, af al pi shehu osehu shete geranot, noten pea achat. zeraah shene minin, af al pi sheasaan goren achat, noten shete feot. hazzorea et sadehu shene mine chittin, asaan goren achat, noten pea achat. shete geranot, noten shete feot: 
Maase shezzara rabbi shimon ish hammitzpa lifne rabban gamliel, vealu lelishkat haggazit veshaalu. amar nachum hallavlar, mekubbal ani merabbi meyasha, shekkibbel meabba, shekkibbel min hazzugot, shekkibbelu min hanneviim, halacha lemoshe missinay, bezorea et sadehu shene mine chittin, im asaan goren achat, noten pea achat. shete geranot, noten shete feot:
Mishnah Peah 2:7-3:2: Sade shekketzaruha kutim, ketzaruha listim, kirsemuha nemalim, shevarattah haruach o vehema, petura. katzar chetzyah vekatzru listim chetzyah, petura, shechovat happea bakkama:

Ketzaruha listim chetzyah vekatzar hu chetzyah, noten pea mimma shekkatzar. katzar chetzyah umachar chetzyah, hallokeach noten pea lakkol. katzar chetzyah vehikdish chetzyah, happode miyyad haggizbar, hu noten pea lakkol:
Malbenot hattevua shebben hazzetim, bet shammay omrim, pea mikkol achat veechat. bet hillel omrim, meechad al hakkol. umodim, sheim hayu rashe shurot meoravin, shehu noten pea meechad al hakkol:

Hamenammer et sadehu veshiyyer kelachim lachim, rabbi akiva omer, noten pea mikkol echad veechad. vachachamim omrim, meechad al hakkol. umodim chachamim lerabbi akiva bezorea shevet o chardal bishlosha mekomot, shehu noten pea mikkol echad veechad:
Mishnah Peah 3:3-6: Hammachalik betzalim lachim lashshuk umekayyem yeveshim laggoren, noten pea laellu leatzman velaellu leatzman. vechen baafunin, vechen bakkerem. hammedel, noten min hameshoar al ma sheshshiyyer. vehammachalik meachat yad, noten min hameshoar al hakkol:
Haimmahot shel betzalim chayyavot befea, verabbi yose poter. malbenot habbetzalim shebben hayyarak, rabbi yose omer, pea mikkol achat veechat. vachachamim omrim, meachat al hakkol:

Haachin shechalku, notnin shete feot. chazru venishtattefu, notnin pea achat. shenayim shellakchu et hailan, notnin pea achat. lakach ze tzefono veze deromo, ze noten pea leatzmo, veze noten pea leatzmo. hammocher kilche ilan betoch sadehu, noten pea mikkol echad veechad. amar rabbi yehuda, ematay, bizman shello shiyyer baal hassade. aval im shiyyer baal hassade, hu noten pea lakkol:

Rabbi eliezer omer, karka bet rova, chayyevet bappea. rabbi yehoshua omer, haosa satayim. rabbi tarfon omer, shishsha al shishsha tefachim. rabbi yehuda ven betera omer, kede liktzor velishnot. vahalacha kidvarav. rabbi akiva omer, karka kol shehu, chayyevet bappea, uvabbikkurim, velichtov alav perozbul, veliknot immo nechasim sheen lahem acharayut bechesef uvishtar uvachazaka:
Mishnah Yevamot 15:3-6:
Bet shammay omrim, tinnase vetittol ketubbatah. bet hillel omrim, tinnase velo tittol ketubbatah. amru lahen bet shammay, hittartem erva chamura, lo tattiru et mamon hakkal. amru lahen bet hillel, matzinu sheen haachim nichnasim lannachala al piha. amru lahem bet shammay, vahalo missefer ketubbatah nilmod, shehu chotev lah, sheim tinnasi leacher, titteli ma shekkatuv lichi. vechazru vet hillel lehorot kedivre vet shammay: 
Hakkol neemanim lahaidah, chutz mechamotah, uvat chamotah, vetzaratah, vivimtah, uvat balah. ma ben get lemita, shehakketav mochiach. ed omer met, venisset, uva acher veamar lo met, hare zo lo tetze. ed omer met, ushenayim omrim lo met, af al pi shennisset, tetze. shenayim omrim met, veed omer lo met, af al pi shello nisset, tinnase: 
Achat omeret met veachat omeret lo met, zo sheomeret met tinnase vetittol ketubbatah. vezo sheomeret lo met lo tinnase velo tittol ketubbatah. achat omeret met veachat omeret neherag, rabbi meir omer, hoil umachchishot zo et zo, hare ellu lo yinnaseu. rabbi yehuda verabbi shimon omrim, hoil vezo vazo modot sheeno kayyam, yinnaseu. ed omer met veed omer lo met, ishsha omeret met veishsha omeret lo met, hare zo lo tinnase: 
Haishsha shehalcha hi uvalah limdinat hayyam, uvaa veamra met bali, tinnase vetittol ketubbatah, vetzaratah asura. hayta vat yisrael lechohen, tochal batteruma, divre rabbi tarfon. rabbi akiva omer, en zo derech motziatta mide avera, ad shettehe asura linnase, vaasura milleechol batteruma:
Mishnah Yevamot 15:7-10:
Amra met bali veachar kach met chami, tinnase vetittol ketubbatah, vachamotah asura. hayta vat yisrael lechohen, tochal batteruma, divre rabbi tarfon. rabbi akiva omer, en zo derech motziatta mide avera, ad shettehe asura linnase, vaasura leechol batteruma. kiddesh achat mechamesh nashim veeno yodea ezo kiddesh, kol achat omeret oti kiddesh, noten get lechol achat veechat, umanniach ketubba benehen umistallek, divre rabbi tarfon. rabbi akiva omer, en zo derech motziattu mide avera, ad sheyyitten get uchetubba lechol achat veechat. gazal echad mechamishsha veen yodea meeze gazal, kol echad omer oti gazal, manniach gezela benehen umistallek, divre rabbi tarfon. rabbi akiva omer, en zo derech motziattu mide avera, ad sheyyeshallem gezela lechol echad veechad: 
Haishsha shehalcha hi uvalah limdinat hayyam uvenah immahem, uvaa veamra met bali veachar kach met beni, neemenet. met beni veachar kach met bali, enah neemenet, vechoshshim lidvareha, vecholetzet velo mityabbemet: 
Nittan li ven bimdinat hayyam, veamra met beni veachar kach met bali, neemenet. met bali veachar kach met beni, enah neemenet, vechoshshim lidvareha, vecholetzet velo mityabbemet: 
Nittan li yavam bimdinat hayyam, amra met bali veachar kach met yevami, yevami veachar kach bali, neemenet. halcha hi uvalah vivamah limdinat hayyam, amra met bali veachar kach met yevami, yevami veachar kach bali, enah neemenet. sheen haishsha neemenet lomar met yevami, shettinnase. velo, meta achoti, shettikkanes leveto. veen haish neeman lomar met achi, sheyyeyabbem ishto. velo, meta ishti, sheyyissa achotah:
Mishnah Yevamot 16:1-5:
Haishsha shehalach balah vetzaratah limdinat hayyam, uvau veamru lah met balech, lo tinnase velo tityabbem, ad shetteda shemma meubberet hi tzaratah. hayta lah chamot, enah chosheshet. yatzta melea chosheshet. rabbi yehoshua omer, enah chosheshet: 
Shete yevamot, zo omeret met bali vezo omeret met bali, zo asura mippene valah shel zo vezo asura mippene valah shel zo. lazo edim velazo en edim, et sheyyesh lah edim, asura. veet sheen lah edim, mutteret. lazo vanim velazo en banim, et sheyyesh lah banim, mutteret. veet sheen lah banim, asura. nityabbemu umetu hayevamin, asurot lehinnase. rabbi elazar omer, hoil vehutteru layvamin, hutteru lechol adam: 
En meidin ella al partzuf panim im hachotem, af al pi sheyyesh simanin begufo uvechelav. en meidin ella ad shettetze nafsho, vaafillu rauhu meguyyad, vetzaluv, vehachayya ochelet bo. en meidin ella ad shelosha yamim. rabbi yehuda ben bava omer, lo chol haadam velo chol hammakom velo chol hashshaot shavin: 
Nafal lemayim, ben sheyyesh lahen sof, ben sheen lahen sof, ishto asura. amar rabbi meir, maase veechad shennafal levor haggadol, veala leachar shelosha yamim. amar rabbi yose, maase vesuma sheyyarad litbol bimara, veyarad moshcho acharav, veshahu chede shettetze nafsham, vehissiu neshotehem. veshuv maase veasya beechad sheshshilsheluhu layyam, velo ala veyadam ella raglo, amru chachamim, min haarkubba ulemala, tinnase. min haarkubba ulematta, lo tinnase: 
Afillu shama min hannashim omrot, met ish peloni, dayyo. rabbi yehuda omer, afillu shama min hattinokot omrim, hare anu holchin lispod velikvor et ish peloni, ben shehu mitkavven uven sheeno mitkavven. rabbi yehuda ven bava omer, beyisrael ad sheyyehe mitkavven. uvegoy, im haya mitkavven, en eduto edut:
Mishnah Yevamot 16:6-7:
Meidin leor hanner uleor hallevana, umassiin al pi vat kol. maase veechad sheamad al rosh hahar veamar, ish peloni ven peloni mimmakom peloni met, halchu velo matzu sham adam, vehissiu et ishto. veshuv maase vetzalmon beechad sheamar, ani ish peloni ben ish peloni, neshachani nachash, vahare ani met, vehalchu velo hikkiruhu, vehissiu et ishto: 
Amar rabbi akiva, kesheyyaradti linhardea leabber hashshana, matzati nechemya ish bet deli, amar li, shamati sheen massiin et haishsha veeretz yisrael al pi ed echad, ella rabbi yehuda ven bava. venumeti lo, ken haddevarim. amar li, emor lahem mishshemi, attem yodim shehammedina meshubbeshet bigyasot, mekubbelani merabban gamliel hazzaken, shemmassiin et haishsha al pi ed echad. ucheshebbati vehirtzeti haddevarim lifne rabban gamliel, samach lidvaray, veamar, matzanu chaver lerabbi yehuda ven bava. mittoch haddevarim nizkar rabban gamliel, shennehergu harugim betel arza, vehissi rabban gamliel hazzaken neshotehem al pi ed echad, vehuchzeku lihyot massiin al pi ed echad. vehuchzeku lihyot massiin ed mippi ed, mippi eved, mippi ishsha, mippi shifcha. rabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua omrim, en massiin et haishsha al pi ed echad. rabbi akiva omer, lo al pi ishsha, velo al pi eved velo al pi shifcha, velo al pi kerovim. amru lo, maase vivne levi shehalchu letzoar ir hattemarim, vechala achad mehem badderech, veheviuhu vefundak, uvachazaratam amru lappundakit ayye chaverenu, amra lahem met ukevartiv, vehissiu et ishto. amru lo, velo tehe chohenet kappundakit. amar lahem, lichshettehe pundakit neemenet. happundakit hotzia lahem maklo vetarmilo vesefer tora shehaya veyado:
Niddah 9b:8-11: Rabbi eliezer omer: kol ishsha sheavru aleha vechulei. tanya: amar lahem rabbi eliezer lachachamim: maase beriva achat behayetalo, shehifsika shalosh onot, uva maase lifne chachamim veamru: dayyah sheatah.
Amru lo: en sheat haddechak reaya. may sheat haddechak? ikka deamri: shene vatztzoret havo, ikka deamri: teharot appesh (laavida) [vaavada], vechashshu rabbanan lehefsed ditharot.

Tanu rabbanan: maase, veasa rabbi kerabbi eliezer. leachar shennizkar, amar: keday hu rabbi eliezer lismoch alav bishat haddechak. may "leachar shennizkar"? illema leachar shennizkar deen halacha kerabbi eliezer ella kerabbanan, bishat haddechak hechi aved kevavteh?

Ella, dela ittemar hilcheta la kemar valo kemar, umay "leachar shennizkar"? leachar shennizkar delav yachid pelig aleh, ella rabbim peligi aleh, amar: keday hu rabbi eliezer lismoch alav bishat haddechak.
Proverbs 2:20-3:3: Lemaan telech bederech tovim veorchot tzaddikim tishmor
Ureshaim meeretz yikkaretu uvogdim yissechu mimmenna {p}
Beni torati al-tishkach umitzvotay yitztzor libbecha
Ki orech yamim ushenot chayyim veshalom yosifu lach
Chesed veemet al-yaazvucha koshrem al-gargerotecha kotvem al-luach libbecha
Proverbs 3:13-18: Ashre adam matza chochma veadam yafik tevuna
Ki tov sachrah missechar-kasef umecharutz tevuatah
Yekara hi (mapenayym) [mippeninim] vechol-chafatzecha lo yishvu-vah
Orech yamim biminah bismovlah osher vechavod
Etz-chayyim hi lammachazikim bah vetomcheha meushshar {p}
Proverbs 3:19-23: Adonai bechochma yasad-aretz konen shamayim bitvuna
Beni al-yaluzu meenecha netzor tushiyya umezimma
Az telech lavetach darkecha veraglecha lo tiggof
Proverbs 3:4-7: Al-tehi chacham beenecha yera et-Adonai vesur mera
Proverbs 3:8-12: Veyimmalu asamecha sava vetirosh yekavecha yifrotzu {p}
Musar Adonai beni al-timas veal-takotz betochachto
Ki etasher yeehav Adonai yochiach ucheav et-ben yirtze
Shabbat 41a:5-6: Rabbi zera hava ka mishtemit midderav yehuda, devae lemissak leara deyisrael. deamar rav yehuda: kol haole mibbavel leeretz yisrael over baase, shenneemar: "bavela yuvau veshamma yihyu". amar: ezil veeshma minneh milleta veete veessak. azal, ashkecheh dekae be vane vekaamar leh leshammaeh: haviu li neter, haviu li masrek, pitchu pummayychu veappiku havela, veishtu mimmayya deve vane. amar: ilmale lo bati ella lishmoa davar ze dayyi.

Bishlama "haviu neter, haviu masrek" — kamashma lan devarim shel chol muttar leomram bilshon kodesh. "pitchu pummayychu veappiku havela" — name kedishmuel, deamar shemuel: havela mappek havela. ella "ishtu mayya deve vane" may mealleyuta? detanya achal velo shata — achilato dam, vezehu techillat choli meayim. achal velo halach arba ammot — achilato markevet, vezehu techillat reach ra. hannitzrach linkavav veachal — dome letannur shehissikuhu al gabbe efro, vezehu techillat reach zuhama. rachatz bechammin velo shata mehen — dome letannur shehissikuhu mibbechutz velo hissikuhu mibbifnim. rachatz bechammin velo nishtattef betzonen — dome levarzel shehichnisuhu laur velo hichnisuhu letzonen. rachatz velo sach — dome lemayim al gabbe chavit.
Shulchan Arukh, Yoreh De'ah 247:1-4:
Mitzvat ase litten tzedaka kefi hassagat yad, vechamma peamim nitztavvenu bah bemitzvat ase. veyesh lo taase bammaalim enav mimmennah, shenneemar: lo teammetz et levavcha velo tikpotz et yadcha <small><small>(devarim 15, 7)</small>.</small> vechol hammaalim enav mimmennah nikra beliyyaal, ucheillu oved avodat kochavim. umeod yesh lizzaher bah, ki efshar sheyyavo lide shefichut damim, sheyyamut heani hamevakkesh im lo yitten lo miyyad, keuveda denachum ish gam zo. 
Leolam en adam maani min hatztzedaka, velo davar ra velo hezzek mitgalgel al yadah, shenneemar: vehaya maase hatztzedaka shalom. <small><small>(yeshaya lev, 17)</small>.</small> 
Kol hamerachem al haaniyyim, 112 merachem alav. <small>hagga: veyitten haadam al libbo shehu mevakkesh kol shaa parnasato mehkv, uchemo shehu mevakkesh shehkv yishma shavato kach hu yishma shavat aniyyim. gam yitten el libbo ki hu galgal hachozer baolam, vesof haadam sheyyavo hu o beno o ben beno lide midda zo, vechol hamerachem al acherim merachamin alav <small><small>(milleshon hattur)</small>.</small> </small> 
Hatztzedaka docha et haggezerot hakkashot, uveraav tatztzil mimmavet, kemo sheera latztzarfit. <small>hagga: vehi maasheret, veasur lenassot hakkabba ki im bedavar ze, shenneemar: uvechanuni na bazot vegomer <small><small>(malachi 3, 10)</small>. <small>(tur miggemara 180 detaanit)</small>.</small> veyesh omrim davka bintinat maasher muttar lenassot 112, aval lo bishar tzedaka <small><small>(bet yosef dechach mashma mishshas sham)</small>.</small> </small>
Shulchan Arukh, Yoreh De'ah 248:4: Gabbae tzedaka, en mekabbelin mehannashim umehaavadim umehattinokot, ella davar muat, aval lo davar gadol shechezkato gazul o ganuv mishshel acherim. vechamma hu davar muat, hakkol lefi osher habbealim vaaniyyutam. vehane mille bistama, aval im habbaal moche, afillu kol shehu asur lekabbel mehem.
Shulchan Arukh, Yoreh De'ah 249:6-13:
Shemone maalot yesh batztzedaka, zo lemala mizzo: maala haggedola sheen lemala mimmennah, hammachazik beyad yisrael hammach venoten lo mattana, o halevaa, o ose shuttafut, o mamtzi lo melacha kede lechazzek yado shello yitztarech labberiyyot velo yishal, veal ze neemar: vehechezakta bo <small><small>(bammidbar ko, la)</small>.</small> 
 Pachot mizze, hannoten tzedaka leani velo yeda lemi yitten, velo yeda heani mimmi mekabbel. vekarov laze, hannoten lekuppa shel tzedaka; velo yitten adam lekuppa shel tzedaka ella im ken yodea shehamemunne aleha neeman veyodea linhog bah kashshura. 
Pachot mizze, sheyyodea hannoten lemi noten, velo yeda heani mimmi lokeach, kegon gedole hachachamim shehayu holchim baseter umashlichim hammaot befitche haaniyyim; vechaze rauy laasot, umaala tova hi, im en memunnim al hatztzedaka nohagim keshura. 
Pachot mizze, sheyyodea heani mimmi notel, velo yeda hannoten lemi noten, kegon hachachamim shehayu tzorrim hammaot bisdinehem umashlichim otam laachorehem, uvaim haaniyyim venotlin, kede shello yihye lahem busha. 
Pachot mizze, sheyyitten leani beyado, kodem sheyyishal. 
Pachot mizze, sheyyitten lo karauy achar sheyyishal. 
Pachot mizze, sheyyitten lo pachot meharauy, besever panim yafot. 
Pachot mizze, sheyyitten lo beetzev. <small>hagga: veal kol panim lo yitpaer haadam batztzedaka shennoten. veim mitpaer, lo day sheeno mekabbel sachar, ella afillu maanishin oto aleha <small><small>(semag mevio bet yosef 70 247)</small>.</small> umikkol makom mi shemmakdish davar litzdaka, muttar lo sheyyichtov shemo alav sheyyehe lo lezikkaron, verauy laasot ken <small><small>(teshuvat rashba siman 581)</small>.</small> </small>
Shulchan Arukh, Yoreh De'ah 253:1-4:
Mi sheyyesh lo mezon shete seuddot, lo yittol mehattamchuy. mezon 14 seuddot, lo yittol mehakuppa. veim yesh lo Rabbi zuz, veeno nose venoten bahem, o sheyyesh lo chamishshim zuz vehu nose venoten bahem, lo yittol tzedaka. veim yesh lo Rabbi zuz chaser dinar, veeno nose venoten bahem, afilu notnim lo elef zuz bevat achat, hare ze yittol. <small>hagga: umi sheholech mibbeto venosea meir leir lekabbetz, kol hadderech shehaya bedato lissa keshehalach mibbeto, nikra paam achat. vaafillu natnu lo Rabbi zuz beir achat yachol lekabbel yoter, umikkan vaelach asur <small><small>(mardechay 180 8 beshem or zarua)</small>.</small> </small> veim yesh lo harebe vehu alav bechov, o shemmemushkan lichtubbat ishto, hare ze yittol. veim yesh lo bayit uchele bayit harebe, veen lo Rabbi zuz, hare ze yittol, veen tzarich limkor kele beto veafilu hem shel kesef vezahav. bamme devarim amurim, bichle achila ushetiyya umalbush umatztzaot vechayyotze bahen, aval magreda o eli shehem shel kesef, mochram, velo yittol mehatztzedaka. veha deen mechayyevim oto limkor kele tashmisho shel kesef vezahav, davka kol zeman sheeno tzarich littol mehakuppa ela notel baseter miyyechidim. aval im ba littol mehakuppa shel tzedaka, lo yittenu lo ad sheyyimkor kelav. <small>hagga: vechen bemakom deikka takkana shello litten tzedaka lemi sheyyesh lo davar katzuv, en choshvin lo bet dira uchele tashmishav. <small><small>(mardechay resh 180 106)</small>.</small> vechol mi shehu ashir, asur litten levanav, af al pi shehem gedolim, im hem semuchim al shulchan avihem <small><small>(mardechay 180 46 14 70 252)</small>.</small> vechol ze davka derech tzedaka, aval derech doron vechavod yachol lekabbel adam, kidamrinan harotze lehanot yehene keelisha. <small><small>(mardechay mehaggahot 106)</small>.</small> </small> 
Veyesh omrim shello neemru hashshiurim halalu ela bimehem, aval bazzeman hazze yachol littol ad sheyyihye lo keren kede sheyyitparnes hu uvene beto meharevach. udevarim shel taam hem. 
Mi shehayu lo karkaot veim yimkerem bimot hageshamim yimkerem bezol, veim yannichem ad yemot hachamma mochran beshavyan, en mechayyevin oto limkor ela maachilin oto maasar ani ad chatzi demehem, velo yidchok atzmo veyimkor shello bizman mechira <small><small>(30 harambam 89 75 110 din 17)</small>. <small>veyesh omrim sheen maachilin oto rak ad sheyyachol limkor karkaotav bachatzi demehen</small> <small>(tur ushear harebe poskim)</small>.</small> hayu shear haadam lokchim beyoker vehu eno motze mi sheyyikach mimmennu ela bezol, mippene shehu dachuk vetarud, en mechayyevim oto limkor, ela ochel maasar ani, veholech ad sheyyimkor beshave, veyedu hakkol sheeno dachuk limkor. 
Baal habbayit haholech mimmakom lemakom vechalu meotav badderech veen lo ma yochal, yittol tzedaka, uchesheyyachazor leveto eno chayyav <small><small>(leshallem)</small></small> kelum <small>dahava leh keani veheeshir deeno chayyav leshallem <small><small>(tur)</small>.</small> </small>
Shulchan Arukh, Yoreh De'ah 255:1-2:
Leolam yarchik adam atzmo mehatztzedaka vigalgel atzmo betzaar, shello yitztarech labberiyyot. vechen tziuu chachamim: ase shabbatcha chol, veal titztarech labberiyyot. vaafilu haya chacham mechubbad veheeni, yaa 100 beummanut veafilu beummanut menuvvelet, veal yitztarech labberiyyot. 
 Kol mi sheeno tzarich littol mehatztzedaka umeramme haam venotel, eno met ad sheyyitztarech labberiyyot. vechol mi shetztzarich littol veeno yachol lichyot ela im ken yittol, kegon zaken o chole o baal yisurin, umegis dato veeno notel, hare ze shofech damim, umitchayyev benafsho, veen lo betzaaro ela avonot vechataim. vechol mi shetztzarich littol umetzaer atzmo, vedochek et hashshaa, vechay chayye tzaar kede shello yatriach al hatztzibbur, eno met ad sheyyefarnes acherim, vealav hakkatuv omer: baruch hagever asher yivtach baAdonai <small><small>(yirmiyya 17, 7)</small>.</small>
Shulchan Arukh, Yoreh De'ah 334:43: Al 24 devarim menaddin et haadam, veellu hen: <small><small>(1)</small></small> hamevazze et hechacham, afillu leachar moto. <small><small>(b)</small></small> hamevazze sheliach bet din. <small><small>(3)</small></small> hakkore lachavero eved. <small><small>(4)</small></small> hamezalzel bedavar echad middivre sofrim, veen tzarich lomar middivre tora. <small><small>(5)</small></small> mi sheshshalchu lo bet din vekavu lo zeman, velo ba. <small><small>(6)</small></small> mi shello kibbel alav et haddin, menaddin oto ad sheyyitten. <small><small>(7)</small></small> mi sheyyesh birshuto davar hammazzik, menaddin oto ad sheyyasir hannezek. <small><small>(8)</small></small> hammocher karka shello legoy, menaddin oto ad sheyyekabbel alav kol ones sheyyavo mehaggoy leyisrael chavero baal hammetzer. <small><small>(9)</small></small> hammeid al yisrael beerkaot shel goyim, vehotzi mimmennu mamon beeduto, shello kaddin, menaddin oto ad sheyyeshallem. <small><small>(10)</small></small> tabbach kohen sheeno mafrish hammattanot, venotnam lechohen acher, menaddin oto ad sheyyitten. <small><small>(11)</small></small> hamechallel yom tov sheni shel galuyyot, af al pi shehu minhag. <small><small>(12)</small></small> haose melacha beerev pesach achar chatzot. <small><small>(13)</small></small> hammazkir shem shamayim levattala, o lishvua bedivre havay. <small><small>(14)</small></small> hammevi et harabbim lide achilat kadashim bachutz. <small><small>(15)</small></small> hammevi rabbim lide chillul hashshem. <small><small>(16)</small></small> hamechashshev shanim vekovea chodashim bechutza laaretz. <small><small>(17)</small></small> hammachshil et haivver. <small><small>(18)</small></small> hameakkev et harabbim millaasot mitzva. <small><small>(19)</small></small> tabbach sheyyatzta terefa mittachat yado. <small><small>(20)</small></small> tabbach shello hera bedikat sakkino lechacham. <small><small>(21)</small></small> hammakshe atzmo ladaat. <small><small>(22)</small></small> hamegaresh et ishto, veasu beno uvenah shuttafut o mashsha umattan hammevian lehizzakek ze laze, kesheyyavou levet din, menaddin otam. <small><small>(23)</small></small> chacham sheshshemuato raa. <small><small>(24)</small></small> hamenadde lemi sheeno chayyav nidduy. <small>hagga: veen tzerichin leinyan nidduy edut ureaya berura, ella omed haddaat baamittut haddevarim, shehattovea toen bari veaz afillu ishsha afillu katan neeman, im haddaat noten sheemet haddavar <small><small>(355 shoresh 120)</small>.</small> </small>
Yevamot 30a:8-11: Gemara amar rav yehuda amar rav: kol yevama sheen ani kore bah bishat nefila "yevamah yavo aleha" — hare hi keeshet ach sheyyesh lah banim, vaasura. may ka mashma lan? tenena: hare zo asura alav olamit, hoil veneesra alav shaa achat!
Mahu detema: hane mille hecha dela ichazya la binfila rishona, aval hecha deichazya la binfila rishona — ema tishtere, ka mashma lan.
Ha name tenena: shene achin nesuin shete achayot, met echad mehem, veachar kach meta ishto shel sheni — hare zo asura alav olamit, hoil veneesra alav shaa achat!
Mahu detema: hatam hu deiddechay la mehay beta ligmare, aval hacha dela iddechay la mehay beta ligmare, ema: miggo dechazya lehay nesuy nochrit, chazya name lehay — ka mashma lan.
Zevachim 32a:4-32b:2: Ureminhu: "veshachat" – shechita bezar keshera, shehashshechita keshera bezarim uvenashim uvaavadim uvitmeim. vaafillu bekodshe kadashim. o eno ella bakkohanim?
Amarta: vechi meayin bata – mikkelal shenneemar: "veatta uvanecha ittecha tishmeru et kehunnatchem lechol devar hammizbeach";
Yachol af bishchita? talmud lomar: "veshachat et ben habbakar lifne Adonai vehikrivu vegomer" – mikkabbala veelach mitzvat kehunna; limmed al hashshechita shekkeshera bechol adam.
Hu haddin daafillu lechattechilla name; umishshum deka bae lemitna temeim – dilchattechilla la, gezera shemma yiggeu babbasar; tena: "sheshshachatu".
Vetame diavad shappir dame?! ureminhu: "vesamach... veshachat" – ma semicha bithorim, af shechita bithorim! midderabbanan.
May shena semicha, dichtiv: "lifne Adonai"; shechita name, hachtiv: "lifne Adonai"! efshar deaved sakkin arukka veshachet.
Semicha name – efshar dimayyel yedeh vesamech. kasavar bia bemiktzat shemah bia.
Rav chisda matni ippecha: "vesamach... veshachat" – ma shechita bithorin, af semicha bithorin. may shena shechita? dichtiv: "lifne Adonai",
Semicha name ketiv: "lifne Adonai"! efshar dimayyel yedeh vesamech. shechita name efshar deaved sakkin arukka veshachet!

Ha manni – shimon hattimni hi. detanya: "veshachat et ben habbakar lifne Adonai" – velo hashshochet lifne Adonai. shimon hattimni omer: minnayin sheyyihyu yadav shel shochet lifnim min hannishchat? talmud lomar: "veshachat et ben habbakar lifne Adonai" – shochet et ben habbakar yehe lifne Adonai.
Zohar, Bereshit 76: Vaychal elohim bayyom hashshevii da tora shebbeal pe deihu yom shevii, uveh ishtachlal alma deihu kiyyuma decholla. melachto asher asa velo kol melachto, deha tora shebbichtav appik kolla betukefa dichtav denafik mechachmeta.

Telat zimnin hacha bayyom hashshevii. vaychal elohim bayyom hashshevii. vayyishbot bayyom hashshevii. vayvarech elohim et yom hashshevii. ha telat. vaychal elohim bayyom hashshevii, da tora shebbeal pe, deim yom hashshevii da ishtachlal alma kedka amaran.

Vayyishbot bayyom hashshevii, da yesoda dealma. besifra derav yeva sava da yovla veal kach ketiv hacha mikkol melachto decholla nafik minneh. veanan da yesoda kidkaamaran deha nayycha beh hava yattir mikkolla.

Vayvarecha elohim et yom hashshevii. da kohen gadol dimvarech lecholla vehu natil beresha ditnan kohen notel barosh, uvirchan beh sharyayn levarcha veikre shevii. rabbi yesa sava amar hani tere chad bisoda dealma ihu, vechad beammuda deemtzaita. (davar acher 33) (aval hane telat chad bemaale shabbeta delelya vechad deyoma vechad dealma deate deihu shabbat haggadol).

Vechen (davar acher 33 vaykaddesh) oto, leman, lehahu atar deat kayyayma beh sharya kema deat amer, (Shmuel b 15:25) vehirani oto veet navihu. uvehay atar sharyayn kol kidushin leela (davar acher dilella), venafke minneh lichneset yisrael lemehav lah tafnuka lechem pannag, veazla ha kema dichtiv, (Bereshit 49:20) measher shemena lachmo vehu yitten maadanne melech, measher da keyaym shelim dehava (davar acher 33) (leh) lechem oni ithaddar lemehve lechem pannag. vehu yitten maadanne melech. man melech, da kenset yisrael. hu yahiv (davar acher la) kol tafnukin dealmin, vechol kiddushin denafkin milleela mehay atar nafkin. veal da vaykaddesh oto, hahu at kayyayma.
Zohar, Lech Lecha 12: Vayyered avram mitzrayma lagur sham. may tama lemitzrayim. ella begin deshakil legan Adonai. dichtiv kegan Adonai keeretz mitzrayim. detamman shakil venachit chad nahara deihu leyamina dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:11) shem haechad pishon hu hassovev et kol eretz hachavila asher sham hazzahav.

Veavraham kevan deyada veal behemnuta shelemata. baa leminda kol innun dargin deitachadan letatta. umitzrayim hava natil miyyamina (davar acher limina) uvegin kach nachat lemitzrayim. veta chaze, kafna la ishtechach beara ella kad mistalleke rachame min dina:

Vayhi kaasher hikriv lavo mitzrayma. amar rabbi elazar kaasher hikriv, kaasher karav mibbae leh. may kaasher hikriv, ella kedichtiv, (Shemot 14:10) ufaro hikriv deihu akriv lehu leyisrael letiuveta. uf hacha hikriv, deakriv garmeh lekudesha berich hu kedka yeut. lavo mitzrayma leashgacha beinnun dargin uleitrachaka minnayyhu uleitrachaka meovde mitzrayim.

Amar rabbi yehuda ta chaze, chevan (sefer acher begin) denachat avraham lemitzrayim bela reshu, ishtabidu benoy bemitzrayim arba mea shenin, deha ketiv vayyered avram mitzrayma. vela ketiv red mitzrayim, veitztaar kol hahu lelya beginah desara.

Vayyomer el sara ishto hinne na yadati ki ishsha yefat mare at. vechi ad hahi shaata la hava yada avraham deishsha yefat mare havat. ella ha ukemuha dead hahi shaata la istakkal bediukena desara bisgiut tzeniuta dehavat benehon, vechad kariv lemitzrayim itgalyay ihi vechama bah.

Davar acher bemma yada, ella al yeda detorach orcha bar nash mitbazze vehi kayyma beshappiru dilah vela ishtanni. davar acher hinni na yadati dechama immah shechinta. uvegin kach itrechatz avraham veamar achoti hi.

Umilla da istallak litre gevavnin. chad kemashmao. vechad kedichtiv, (Mishlei 7:4) emor lachachma achoti at. uchetiv imri na achoti at. uchetiv, (Devarim 5:24) veat tedabber elenu. lemaan yitav li baavurech, kelappe shechina amar baavurech yitav li kudesha berich hu. vechayta nafshi biglalech. begin divda yistallak bar nash veyizke leistalleka learcha dechayye.

Imri na achoti vegomer. rabbi yesa amar yada hava avraham dechulhu mitzrae shetifin innun bezimma, vechevan dechol hay yada ammay la dachil al itteteh dela ahadar mearcha vela yeul letamman. ella begin dechama shechinta immah:
Zohar, Lech Lecha 17: Ta chaze, nafshi da nefesh deihi shalta ballayla ulemirdaf batar darga. ruach bayyom, dichtiv nafshi ivviticha ballayla, da nefesh deihi shalta ballayla. af ruchi bekirbi ashacharekka. da ruach deihu shalta bimama.
Vei tema ditren dargin innun bifruda, lav hachi, deha darga chad innun, veinnun teren bechibbura chad. vechad illaa deshalta alayyhu veitdabbak behu veinnun beh (veikrun) veitkeriat neshama,

Vechulhu dargin salkan beraza dechachmeta, dechad mistakkelan illen dargin yistakkel bar nash bechachma illaa, vehay neshama ayil behu umitdabbekan bah, vechad hay shalta keden hahu bar nash ikre kadosh shelim mikkolla. reuta chada legabbe kudesha berich hu.

Nefesh ihu itaruta tattaa veda semicha begufa vezanat leh, vegufa achid bah vehi itachadat begufa. levatar ittaknat veitavidat kurseyay leashraa alah ruach beitaruta dehay nefesh deitachidat begufa, kema dichtiv, (yeshaya lev) ad yeare alenu ruach mimmarom.
Levatar dimtakkeni tarvavyyhu, zeminin lekabbela neshama. deha ruach itavid kurseyay legabbe neshama leashraa aleh, vehay neshama ihi setima illaa al kolla temira dechol temirin.

Ishtechach deit (la) kurseyay lekurseyay vekurseyay legabbe illaa alayyhu. vechad tistakkal bedargin tishkach raza dechachmeta behay milla. vecholla hu chachmeta leitdabbeka behay gavvna millin setimin.

Ta chaze (leel oz b) nefesh ihi itaruta tattaa deitdabbeka beh begufa. kegavvna dinhora devutzina. dinhora tattaa deihi uchema itdabbekat biftila vela itperash minnah vela ittaknat ella bah. vechad ittaknat bappetila itavidat kurseyay linhora illaa chivvavra desharyay al hahu nehora uchema.

Levatar kad mittaknan tarvavyyhu itavidat hahu nehora chivvavra kurseyay linhora setimaa dela itchaze vela ityeyda ma deshara al hahu nehora chivvavra. ucheden nehora shelim. vechach hu bar nash deihu shelim becholla. ucheden ikre kadosh, kema deat amer, (Tehillim 16:3) likdoshim asher baaretz hemma vegomer. kegavvna da beraza illaa.

Ta chaze, beshaata deal avraham leara, itchaziyi leh kudesha berich hu kema deittemar dichtiv laAdonai hannire elav, vekabbil tamman nefesh uvana mizbeach lehahu darga. levatar haloch venasoa hannegba dekabbil ruach. levatar (ad) desalik leitdabbeka go neshama keden vayyiven sham mizbeach laAdonai setam, da hi neshama deihi setima dechol setimin.

Levatar yada devae leitzterafa uleitattera bedargin, miyyad vayyered avram mitzrayma, veishteziv mittamman. vela itpatta go innun tehirin, veittzarif vetav leatreh. kevan denachat veittzarif, miyyad vayyaal avram mimmitzrayim, salik vadday vetav leatreh veitdabbak bimhemnuta illaa dichtiv hannegba.

Mikkan ulehala yada avraham chachmeta illaa veitdabbak bekudesha berich hu veitavid yamina dealma. keden veavram kaved meod bammikne bakkesef uvazzahav. kaved meod besitra demizrach. bammikne besitra demaarav. bakkesef missitra dedarom. bazzahav missitra detzafon.

Atu rabbi elazar verabbi abba vechulhu chavraya uneshaku yedoy. becha rabbi abba veamar vavy vavy kad tistallak min alma man yanhir nehora deorayyta. zakkaa chulakhon dechavrayay deshamin millin deorayyta illen mippumach.
Zohar, Lech Lecha 2: Rabbi yose patach (Tehillim 84:2) ma yedidot mishkenotecha Adonai tzevaot. kamma it lon livni nasha leistakkala befulechana dekudesha berich hu. deha kol bene nasha la yade vela mistakkele al ma kaim alma. veinnun al ma kayymin. dechad bera kudesha berich hu alma avad shemaya meesh umimmayim mitarvin kechada vela havu galde. ulevatar aglidu vekayymu berucha illaa umittamman shatil alma, lekayyma al samchin, veinnun samchin la kayymin ella behahu rucha, uveshaata dehahu rucha istallak kulhu meraffin vezain vealma irtat hada hu dichtiv, (iyyov 9:6) hammargiz eretz mimkomah veammudeha yitpallatzun. vecholla kaim al orayyta, dechad yisrael mishtaddele beorayyta mitkayyem alma veinnun kayymin vesamchin kayymin beatrayyhu bekiyyuma shelim.

Ta chaze, beshaata deitar palgut lelya vekudesha berich hu al leginta deeden leishtashea im tzaddikaya, kulhu ilanin divginta deeden mezammeran umeshabbechan kammeh. dichtiv, (divre hayamim 1 16:33) az yerannenu atze hayyaar millifne Adonai vegomer.

Vecharoza kare vechayil veamar lechon amrin kaddishin elyonin, man minchon deayil rucha beudenoy lemishma, veenoy pekichin lemecheme. velibbeh patuach leminda, beshaata derucha dechol ruchin arim besimu denishmata, umittamman nafik kala dekalaya, cheylin itbaddar learba sitre alma.

1 Chad salik listar chad. b chad nachit lehahu setar. 3 (Tikkunim 73, leel lev b) chad ayil ben teren. 4 teren mitarin mitatteran bitlat. 5 telat ayyle bechad. 6 chad appik gevavnin. 7 shit minhon listar chad, veshit minhon nachate lehahu setar. 8 shit ayyle bitresar. 9 teresar mitarin beesrin uteren. 10 shit kelilan baasara. 11 asara kaim bechad.

Vavy leinnun denayyme shenta bechorehon, la yade vela mistakkelan ech yekumun bedina dechusheban itpakad, kad istaav gufa, venishmata shatya al anpe deavira detihara, vesalka venachata, vetarin la mitpattechan, mitgalgelan keavnin bego kusefita. vavy lon man yitba lon, dela yekumun beidduna da bego duchete deinnuge detzaddikaya, itpakdun duchetayyhu. itmasserun bida deduma, nachate vela salke. alayyhu ketiv, (iyyov 7:9) kala anan vayyelach ken yored sheol lo yaale.

Behahi shaata itar shalhova chad missetar tzafon uvatash bearba sitre alma venachit umate ben gadfe detarnegola veitar hahu shalhova beh vekare, velet man deitar bar innun zakkae keshot dekayyme veitaru beorayyta. ucheden kudesha berich hu vechol innun tzaddikayay divgo ginta deeden tzayyte lekalehon. kema deat amer, (Shir hashshirim 8:13) hayyoshevet baggannim chaverim makshivim lekolech hashshemiini:
Zohar, Lech Lecha 21: Rabbi elazar iara beve ushepiza belud, vehava immeh rabbi chizkiyya. kam belelya lemile beorayyta, kam rabbi chizkiyya gabbeh. amar leh rabbi elazar bekistera dekuseta chavrayy shechiche.

Patach rabbi elazar veamar (Shir hashshirim 2:3) ketappuach baatze hayyaar vegomer. ketappuach, da kudesha berich hu, deihu chamid umitattar bigvavnoy mikkol shear ilanin dela it dedame leh. rashim ihu mikkolla, rashim hu delet ochora kavvateh.

Begini kach betzillo chimadti. betzillo vela betzilla ochora. betzilo vela vetzilla dishar memannan. chimmadti, ematay, min yoma dehava avraham bealma deihu chamid verachim leh lekudesha berich hu beahava kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 41:8) avraham ohavi. ufiryo matok lechikki, da hu yitzchak deihu ibba kaddisha.

Davar acher betzillo chimadti veyashavti, da yaakov. ufiryo matok lechikki, da yosef hatztzaddik deavad perin kaddishin bealma. veal da ketiv (Bereshit 37:2) elle toldot yaakov yosef. dechol innun toldot deyaakov (yosef deihu deavid toldot) (nusach acher beyosef hatztzaddik kayyme, deavid toldot keen kullehu) (davar acher 33 shevatim), uvegin kach ikrun yisrael al shema deefrayim dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 31:20) haven yakkir li efrayim vegomer.

Davar acher ketappuach baatze hayyaar. da avraham. dedame leh letappuach desalik rechin veitreshim bimhemnuta shelemata al kol bene dareh, veitreshim chad leela, veitreshim chad letatta dichtiv (yechezkel 33 24) echad haya avraham.

May tama hava echad. dela hava ochora bealma di salik limhemnuta dekudesha berich hu bar ihu. amar leh rabbi chizkiyya veha ketiv veet hannefesh asher asu vecharan. amar leh ad kean innun la havu bedargin ilain deitattar behu avraham.

Levatar amar leh tu shemana dela ikre avraham echad ad deistallak beyitzchak veyaakov. kevan deistallak beyitzchak veyaakov (nusach acher veha) vehavu kulhu telathon avahan dealma keden ikre avraham echad. ucheden hu tappuach bealma rashim mikkol bene alma. amar leh shappir ka amart.

Davar acher ketappuach baatze hayyaar da kudesha berich hu. ken dodi da kudesha berich hu. betzillo da kudesha berich hu. chimadti veyashavti, beyoma deitgele kudesha berich hu al tura desinay vekabbilu yisrael orayyta veamru (Shemot 24:7) naase venishma.

Ufiryo matok lechikki. illen millin deorayyta dichtiv behu (Tehillim 19:11) umetukim middevash venofet tzufim. davar acher ufiryo matok lechikki, illen nishmathon detzaddikaya dechulhu ibba deovadoy dekudesha berich hu vekayyme immeh leela.

Ta chaze, kol nishmatin dealma deinnun ibba deovadoy dekudesha berich hu kulhu chad beraza chad, vechad nachate lealma kulhu mitparshin bigvavnin dechar venukeva, veinnun dechar venukeva mechubbarin kechada.

Veta chaze, tiuveta denukeva legabbe dechura avid nefesh. ureuta detiuveta didchura legabbe nukeva veitdabbekuta dileh bah, appik nefesh vechalil tiuveta (nusach acher tiuveteh) denukeva venatil lah. veitkelil) tiuveta tattaa betiuveta dilela veitavidu reuta chada bela piruda.
Ucheden (natil) kalil kola nukeva veitabberat min dechura vetiuvetin detarvavyyhu mitdabbekan kechada, veal da kolla kalil da beda. vechad nishmatin nafkin dechar venukeva kechada nafkin.

Levatar kevan denachate mitparshan da lesitra da veda lesitra da, vekudesha berich hu mezavvivg lon levatar. vela ityeyhiv ziuuga leochora ella lekudesha berich hu bilchodoy, deihu yada ziuuga dilhon lechabbera lon kedka yaot.

Zakkaa hu bar nash dezache beovadoy veazil beorach keshot begin deitchabbar nefesh benefesh kema dehava meikara, deha i zache beovadoy da hu bar nash shelim kedka yeut. uvegin kach ketiv ufiryo matok lechikki. dehu betikkuna mevorach leitbarcha minneh alma, begin decholla beovadin devar nash talya i zache i la zache.

Amar rabbi chizkiyya hachi shamana dichtiv, (Hoshea 14:9) mimmenni peryecha nimtza. kudesha berich hu amar leh lichneset yisrael mimmenni vadday peryecha nimtza. peryi nimtza la ketiv ella peryecha. hahu tiuveta denukeva deavid nefesh veitkelil betukefa diddechura veitkelil nefesh benefesh veitavidu chad kalil da beda kidamaran. levatar ishtakkachu tarvavyyhu bealma, veda bechela didchura ishtechach ibba denukeva.
Davar acher betiuveta denukeva ishtechach ibba didchura. dei lav tiuveta denukeva legabbe dechura la itavidu perin lealmin hada hu dichtiv mimmenni peryecha nimtza:
Zohar, Lech Lecha 8: Vayyelecha avram kaasher dibber elav Adonai. amar rabbi elazar ta chaze, deha la ketiv vayyetze avram kaasher dibber elav Adonai. ella vayyelech. kema deat amer lech lecha, deha yetzia bekadmita avdu dichtiv vayyetzu ittam meur kasdim lalechet artza kenaan, vehasheta ketiv vayyelech vela ketiv vayyetze.

Kaasher dibber elav Adonai, deavtach leh bechulhu havetachot. vayyelech itto lot, deitchabbar immeh begin lemelaf meovadoy, veim kol da la olif kule hay. amar rabbi elazar zakkain innun tzaddikayyay deolfe archoy dekudesha berich hu begin lemehach behu uledachala minneh mehahu yoma dedina dezammin bar nash lemehav dina vechushebana lekudesha berich hu.

Patach veamar, (iyyov 37:7) beyad kol adam yachtom ladaat kol anshe maasehu hay kera ukemuha. aval ta chaze behahu yoma deashlimu yomoy devar nash leafaka mealma, hahu yoma degufa itbar venafsha baya leitparsha minneh, keden ityeyhiv reshu levar nash lemecheme ma dela hava leh reshu lemecheme bezimna degufa shalta vekaim al bureyeh.
Ucheden kayyme aleh telat shelichan vechashve yomoy vechovoy vechol ma deavad behay alma, vehu ode al kolla befumeh, ulevatar hu chatim aleh bideh, hada hu dichtiv beyad kol adam yachtom,

Uvideh kulhu chatimin lemedan leh (behahu davar acher behay) alma al kadmae veal batrae al chadte veal attike la itneshe chad minnayyhu, hada hu dichtiv ladaat kol anshe maasehu. vechol innun ovadin deavad behay alma begufa verucha hachi name yahiv chushebna beguppa verucha ad la yippuk mealma.

Ta chaze, kama dechayyayvaya akshe kedal behay alma hachi name afillu beshata devae lenafka mehay alma akshe kedal. vegin kach zakkaa hu bar nash deyalif behay alma archoy dekudesha berich hu begin lemehach behu. vechayyayva af al gav deistakkal behanne (nusach acher deishtaddal bahade) tzaddikayay akshe kedal vela bae lemelaf.
Uvegin kach it leh letzaddika lemitkaf beh veaf al gav dechayyayva akshe kedal hu la yishbok leh veit leh leatkafa bideh vela yishbok leh, dei yishbok leh yehach veyachariv alma.

Ta chaze, min elisha dedacha legechazi. vechen beavraham kol zimna dehava lot bahadeh la itchabbar bahade rashshiayya, kevan deitperash minneh ma ketiv vayyivchar lo lot et kol kikkar hayyarden, uchetiv vayeehal ad sedom. ma ketiv batreh veanshe sedom raim vechattaim laAdonai meod.

Amar rabbi abba hay deamart vayyelech avram vela ketiv vayyetze avram shappir hu. aval sofa dikra ma ketiv betzeto mecharan. amar rabbi elazar mecharan ketiv vehahi yetzia meeretz moladto havat bekadmita:

rashi: Vahakimoti et beriti. uma hi habberit? lihyot lecha lelohim:
Ever. kanaf:
targum: Udesabbaru lefurekana dayya yitkanshun mibbene galutehon veyosfun chel veyitchadtun leulemathon ketzimuach desalek al gadfe nishrin yerahatun vela yilun yahachun vela yishtalhun:

rashi: Vayyikra avram shem vegomer. aappi shello shama avram divre hammalach sheamar vekarat shemo yishmael, sharta ruach hakkodesh alav ukerao yishmael:
Shodoy. ani hu sheyyesh day beelohuti lechol beriyya, lefichach hithallech lefanay veehye lecha leeloah vlfatron; vechen kol makom shehu bammikra perusho kach: day shello, vehakkol lefi hainyan:
Hithallech lefanay. ketargumo pelach kodamay, hiddabbek baavodati:

Vehye tamim. af ze tziuuy achar tziuuy, heye shalem bechol nisyonotay; ulefi midrasho hithallech lefanay bemitzvat mila, uvaddavar hazze tihye tamim, shekkol zeman shehaarla vecha atta baal mum lefanay. davar acher vehye tamim, (achshav atta chaser Adonai evarim, 2 enayim, 2 aznayim, verosh haggeviyya) sheosif lecha ot al shimcha, veyihyu minyan otiyyotecha 248 keminyan evarecha:
Im hassemol veemina. bechol asher teshev, lo etrachek mimmecha veeemod lecha lemagen uleezer, vesof davar hutzrach lo, shenneemar vayyishma avram ki nishba achiv vegomer:
Veemina. aymin et atzmi, kemo veasmeila asmeil et atzmi. veim tomar haya lo linnaked veaymina, kach matzinu bemakom acher im yesh lehemin (Shmuel 2 14) veen nakud lehayemin:
Ish et reehu vegomer yomar chazak lammilchama, ulay yaamdu lahem elohehem:
targum: Gevar yat chavre yisadun velaachohi yemar takif:

rashi: Anashim achim. kerovim, umidrash aggada domin biklaster panim:
ohc: Al na tehi meriva vegomer. taam amro beni uvenecha, hodio ki sofah lihyot hammeriva gam ben shenehem. vahagam sheyyomar lot ki chas veshalom lo yariv et rabbo ugeono velo yihye haddavar, af al pi chen yode baddavar asher kevar hu ben roav veroe avram, vehu amro uven roay vegomer. veamro ki anashim achim yitbaer al pi divrehem (Bereshit Rabba 121) ki roe lot hayu meshallechim tzonam veroim bisdot acherim betaanat ki haaretz leavraham velot ben achiv yorsho, veze hu shiur hakkatuv "al na tehi meriva beni" vegomer bemaamar ze sheanashim achim.

Od yitbaer al derech amro (Tehillim 50:20) "teshev beachicha tedabber beven immecha titten dofi", ufershu kadmonenu al ze hadderech: "teshev beachicha beven immecha" – shehu atta hamedabber "titten dofi", vehu amro "ki anashim achim", perush: ucheshettihye hammeriva veyuggeshu lifne shofte eretz shehem hakkenaani vehapperizzi sheamar hakkatuv besamuch, asher yarshiu shofte eretz mehashshenayim yesovev happegam gam leachiv, ki hannoshech vehannashuch anushim leheyotam achim.

Od yirtze, ki leheyotam achim en lot velo roav mitnahagim bakkavod hatztzarich leavraham, bechashvam ki en hefresh, ma sheen ken im hayu avraham velot bilti kerovim, hayu nohagim kavod beavraham letzad rommut kevodo asher giddelo elohim.

rashi: Haloch venasoa. lifrakim yoshev kan chodesh o yoter, venosea mishsham venote oholo bemakom acher, vechol massaav hannegba, lalechet lidromah shel eretz yishorael vehi letzad yerushalayim, shehu bechelko shel yehuda, shennatlu bidromah shel eretz yishorael lehar hammoriyya shehi nachalato (Bereshit Rabba):
Vayhi kevo avram mitzrayma. haya lo lomar kevoam mitzrayma? ella limmed shehitmin otah beteva, veal yede shettavu et hammeches patchu verau otah:

Asher asu vecharan. shehichnisan tachat kanfe hashshechina; avraham megayyer et haanashim vesara megayyeret hannashim, umaale alehem hakkatuv keillu asaum; ufeshuto shel mikra avadim ushefachot shekkanu lahem, kemo asa et kol hakkavod hazze (sham 31), veyisrael ose chayil (Bamidbar 24 18), leshon kone vechones:
Asher asa sham barishona. vaasher kara sham avram beshem Adonai vegam yesh lomar vayyikra sham achshav beshem Adonai:

Vayhi riv. lefi shehayu roim shel lot reshaim umarim behemtam bisdot acherim, veroe avram mochichim otam al haggezel, vehem omrim nittena haaretz leavram, velo en yoresh, velot yorsho, veen ze gezel, vehakkatuv omer vehakkenaani vehapperizzi az yoshev baaretz, velo zacha vah avram adayin (2"):
Lammachazikim bah. laochazim bah, kemo "vayyishlach yado vayyachazek bo" (Shemot 4:4):
Vetomcheha meushshar. hammitkarvim lah, vechen kol leshon temicha shebbesefer ze – shehu ochez bah:
targum: Ilana dechaye hi leilen demitchazkin ba veilen demitaskin vah tuvehon:

rashi: Vayvatter otam. chalak kol echad lishne chalakim; veen hammikra yotze mide feshuto, lefi shehaya choret berit immo lishmor havetachato lehorish levanav et haaretz kedichtiv bayyom hahu karat Adonai et avram berit lemor vegomer, vederech korte verit lechallek behema velaavor ben betareha, kema shenneemar lehallan haovrim ben bitre haegel (yirmeya 34), af kan tannur ashan velappid esh asher avar ben haggezarim hu shelucho shel shechina, shehu esh.

Veet hatztzippor lo vatar. lefi shehaummot nimshelu lefarim veelim ushoirim, shenneemar sevavuni parim rabbim vegomer (435 22), veomer haayil asher raita baal hakkeranayim malche maday ufaras (Daniel 8), veomer vehatztzafir hassair melech yavan (sham), veyishorael nimshelu livne yona, shenneemar yonati bechagve hassela (Shir HaShirim 2), lefichach bitter habbehemot, remez sheyyihyu haummot kalim veholchim, veet hatztzippor lo vatar, remez sheyyihyu yishorael kayyamin leolam:
Vattikkach saray. lekachattah bidvarim, ashrayich shezzachit liddavek beguf kadosh kaze (Bereshit Rabba):
Mikketz eser shanim. moed hakkavua leishsha sheshshahata eser shanim velo yalda levaalah, chayyav lishsha acheret:
Leshevet avram vegomer. maggid sheen yeshivat chutza laaretz ola lo min hamminyan (12 64), lefi shello neemar lo veeescha legoy gadol, ad sheyyavo leeretz yishorael:
Haayit. hu of, al shem shehu at veshoef el hannevelot latus ale ochel, kemo vattaat el hashshalal (Shmuel 1 15):

Al happegarim. al habbetarim. happegarim metargeminan paglayya, ella mittoch shehurgelu letargem "ish bitro" vihav palgayya, nitchallef lahem tevat paglayya lefalgayya, vetirgemu happegarim palgayya; vechol hametargem ken toe, lefi sheen lehakkish betarim lifgarim, shebbetarim targumo palgayya, ufegarim targumo paglayya, leshon piggul, kemo piggul hu (Vayikra 7) l peger:
Vayyashshev. leshon neshiva vehaferacha, kemo yashshev rucho (405 147), remez sheyyavo david ben yishshay lechallotam, veen mannichin oto min hashshamayim ad sheyyavo melech hammashiach:
Vehinne ema vegomer. remez letzarot vechoshech shel galiyyot:

ohc: Ki et kol haaretz vegomer. hinne yadua ki shiur chush harut hu mugbal baadam et asher yassig leor hashshemesh, vechan asa lo Adonai nes shennitkarvu ketzot haaretz veraa hakkol, uveemtzaut haddavar hechzik bechol haaretz, ki en lecha chazaka gedola mizzo sheyyetak tzur mimmekomo lehitkarev lifne adone haaretz, velo yarchik datecha davar ze ki matzinu shekkaftza haaretz leavdo (Bereshit Rabba 139) vegam nikpela tachat banav (chullin tze:).

rashi: Veyihyu chayyim lenafshecha. shehare etz chayyim hu:
Vechen legargerotecha. shehare ze shivchah haamur lemala "vaanakim legargerotecha" (Mishlei 1:9):
targum: Veyehevon chaye lenafshach vechisda letzavrach:

rashi: Etten bammidbar erez shitta. kol mine yishshuv, af bam etten kol mine chachma vetova veshalom:
Tidhar uteashshur. shemot ilane serak haasuyin levinyan:
targum: Etten bemadbera arzin shitin vahadasin veain dimshach erabbe vemeshra burevan murenyan veeshkeroin kachada:

rashi: Ashre adam matza chachma veadam yafik tevuna. shellomed chachma ad sheshshegura hi lehotzi mippiv:
targum: Tuvohi levar nasha deashkach chachmata uvar nasha demabbia beyuneta:

rashi: Yirdefem yaavor shalom. halach al maavrotav beshalom, lo nichshal beradfo otam:
Orach beraglav lo yavo. derech asher lo ba kodem lachen beraglav, lo yavo – lo haya ragil lavo:
targum: Redafinun ada shelam chayalat orach beriglohi la alat:

rashi: Al tehi chacham beenecha. lihyot moes bedivre mochichecha:
targum: La tehe chakkim beappach dechel min elaha useta min bishta:

rashi: Ki ger yihye zaracha. mishshennolad yitzchak ad sheyyatzu yishorael mimmitzrayim arba meot shana ketzad? yitzchak ben shishshim shana keshennolad yaakov, veyaakov kesheyyarad lemitzrayim amar yeme shene meguray sheloshim umeat shana, hare 190, uvemitzrayim hayu matayim veeser keminyan redu, hare arba meot shana. veim tomar bemitzrayim hayu arba meot, hare kehat miyyorde mitzrayim haya, tze vachashov shenotav shel kehat veshel amram ushemonim shel moshe shehaya kesheyyatzu yishorael mimmitzrayim, en atta motze ella shelosh meot vachamishshim, veatta tzarich lehotzi mehen kol hashshanim shechay kehat achar ledat amram veshechay amram achar ledat moshe:

Beeretz lo lahem. lo neemar beeretz mitzrayim, ella lo lahem – umishshennolad yitzchak vayyagar avraham vegomer (202 21), uveyitzchak gur baaretz hazot (sham 26), veyaakov gar beeretz cham (405 105), lagur baaretz banu (202 47):
ohc: Vayyomer leavram vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma kafal lomar yadoa teda. od tzarich ladaat lamma amar ger yihye zaracha velo amar "zaracha yihye ger" o "yihye zaracha ger", ki en derech lehazekir hammeora kodem sheyyazkir lemi yeera. od lamma lo peresh kavvanato beamro "ger vegomer vaavadum veinnu" vegomer, im shelashtam yachad yihyu bechol haarba meot shana o chelek mehaarba meot begerut vechelek beavdut vechelek beinnuy. haemet, ki mimma sherainu shekken haya nodaat hakkavvana, ella lamma lo peresh Adonai devarav?

Achen kavvanat hakkatuv hu al ze hadderech, taam shekkafal lomar yadoa teda leshalosh sibbot. ha al derech amram zichronam livracha (nedarim lev.) veze leshonam: yardu avotenu lemitzrayim bishvil davar kal sheamar "bamma eda", vehu amro "yadoa", letzad sheatta chafetz ladaat, "teda ki ger" vegomer. 2, leheyot sheamar Adonai bainyan shene devarim, achat pureaniyyot veachat hatava, keamro "veachare chen" vegomer, laze amar yedia shete peamim. 3 al derech amram zichronam livracha (berachot 18:) bappasuk (Devarim 34:4) "zot haaretz asher nishbati vegomer lemor" vegomer, sheamar lo Adonai, lech emor leavraham vegomer shevua shennishbati vechulei, ad kan. vehu amro shete yediot: 1 hi ma shemmodio beoto matztzav, veechad sheatid lehodio al yede moshe, velaze amar "teda" leatid.

Vetaam sheamar ger yihye vegomer, shehikdim hammeora, nitkavven lomar ki haggerut hi kasseder shehaya bah avraham. veim haya omer "ki yihye ger" mashma shettitchaddesh haggerut, veyihye nishma sheyyihye zeman shello yihyu gerim kodem vetitchaddesh lahem haggerut. velo chen hu shiur amro "ki ger yihye zaracha", perush: begerut yihye omed zaracha. velaze matzinu shechashav Adonai shene yitzchak veyaakov, hagam shehayu bahavayatan legerut avot.

Veim tomar haya lo lomar "ki zaracha ger yihye" vegomer, da ki nitchakkem Adonai lomar ken legallot dato ki lo lechol zaro gazar Adonai ol hashshibud vehainnuy, velaze amar "ki ger yihye zaracha", perush yihye lecha chelek bezaracha sheeno ella begerut velo yishtu yen merorot kol ikkar. veim haya makdim lomar "zaracha ger yihye" vegomer tihye hakkavvana al ze hadderech: "zaracha ger yihye" vegomer "vaavadum" vegomer, veen chelek mizzera mushlal mehaamur bainyan shehem gerut avdut innuy, vehu lo chen choshev ki yesh sheyyeshno begerut levad. velaze hifsik ben haggerut lashshear, perush, lomar ki yesh mehazzera shehu muchlat sheen lo ella gerut levad. veze hu shiur hakkatuv "ger yihye zaracha beeretz lo lahem", "zaracha beeretz lo lahem vaavadum" vegomer. vetaam shello shier kamma mehaavdut vechulei, davar ze en lo shiur yecholin lehippater beyom echad al derech amram zichronam livracha (Devarim Rabba 82) "yaancha" vegomer. umeatta shelosha haderagot bainyan: chelek mehazzera muchlat mehashshibud vehainnuy vehem haavot vehashshevatim, vehashshear chelek begalut vechelek beinnuy, veen shiur lizman hainnuy ki im yizku yom echad velo 210 shana. vetze ulemad mishshevet levi (Shemot Rabba 5:16) shennidma laavot. veda sheggam hem taamu davar ma, tze ulemad mimmoshe (Shemot 2:3) "vattikkach lo tevat gome" vegomer "al sefat hayeor"

rashi: Lemorag charutz. keli hu shel etz vechaved, veasuy charitzim charitzim keen keli nappachim shel barzel, shekkorin 81 109, vegorrin al hakkashshin shel shibbolin umechattechan ad shennaasu teven dak:
Chadash. keshehu chadash, ad shello huchleku piyyot charitzav, hu chotech harebe, aval mishshennityashshan, huchleku piyyot charitzav:
Baal pifiyyot. hem chiddude hacharitzin:
Tadush harim. melachim vesarim:
targum: Ha shavitechon lemorag takif chadat male simporin tekatel palche kochvaya uteshetze umalchuta kemotza teshave:

rashi: Vayyotze oto hachutza. lefi peshuto hotzio meoholo lachutz lirot hakkochavim, ulefi midrasho amar lo tze meitztagninut shellecha sheraita bammazzalot sheencha atid lehaamid ben, avram en lo ven, aval avraham yesh lo ven, saray lo teled, aval sara teled; ani kore lachem shem acher veyishtanne hammazzal. davar acher hotzio mechalalo shel olam vehigbiho lemala min hakkochavim, vezehu leshon habbata milmala lematta:

Vayyaal avram vegomer hannegba. lavo lidromah shel eretz yishorael, kemo sheamar lemala haloch venasoa hannegba, lehar hammoriyya; umikkol makom keshehu holech mimmitzrayim leeretz kenaan, middarom letzafon hu mehallech, sheeretz mitzrayim bidromah shel eretz yisrael kemo shemmochiach bammassaot uvigvule haaretz:
Kaved meod. taun massaot:
Lech lech. lahanaatcha uletovatcha, sham eescha legoy gadol, kan i atta zoche levanim, veod sheodia tivacha baolam:
ohc: Vayyomer Adonai el avram vegomer. taam sheddibber elav Adonai kodem heraot lo, ma shello asa ken bechol hannivraim, shene teamim baddavar: o lihyot shehu alav hashshalom nishtaddel behakkarat boro ma shello asa adam zulato, uven chamesh shanim hikkir et boro meatzmo behitchakkemuto (nedarim lev:), laze lo hutzrach lehiggalot elav ella amar elav dibberotav uchevar hukkar etzlo hamedabber.

O efshar, ki leheyoto adam rishon bakkedushsha, asher baasara dorot shekkadmuhu lo haya adam shehikkir elohuto vedibber itto elohim, laze nahag Adonai immo beseder ze shello hera shechinato elav ad shebbachan oto im mekayyem gezerotav, uleachar shekkiyyem devarav vehalach lo meartzo vechulei az nigla elav dichtiv (Bereshit 12:7) "vayyera Adonai el avram", ma sheen ken shear hannivraim shekkevar kadma venishtakkea haemuna belibbam meavraham vehushreshu bikdushsha haya nigle lahem techilla. vetze ulemad meavot umimmoshe bassene. vederech ze maskim ledivre razal (Bereshit Rabba 119) sheheemidu pasuk (tehillim 45:11) "shimi vat urei" vegomer beavraham avinu, battechilla shimi vehu amro vayyomer Adonai el vegomer, veachar kach nigla elav "vayyera" vegomer, vehu amoro "urei". velo hayu shenehem shemia ureiyya keachat ella behefsek benehem. velaze lo amar hakkatuv "shimi urei bat" o "bat shimi urei" vehifsik ben "shimi" leurei".
Lech lecha meartzecha vegomer. achar sheamar "meartzecha" en makom lomar "mimmoladtecha", ki betzeto meartzo hinne hu yotze gam mimmoladto.

Achen hattaam hu, leheyot ki beerech tzaar happereda katan hu tzaar peredato meartzo mipperedat moladto, uferedato mimmoladto mipperedato mibbet aviv, laze sidder hahadragot mimmatta lemala, velittol sachar al kol perat uferat, kederech amro (Bereshit 22:2) "et bincha" vegomer, ki Adonai yishtaddel lehetiv baruch hu leohavav.

Od yirtze lomar sheyyelech lo meartzo, ach lo yihye keseder yetziato meur kasdim sheyyolich immo moladto uvet aviv, ella hu levaddo yaazov artzo veyippared gam mimmoladto vaafillu mibbet aviv. ach avraham lo hevin ze bedivre Adonai velakach immo lot. o efshar shehevin ken, ella shellot davak bo keamro (Bereshit 12:4) "vayyelech itto lot" – davak bo. vahagam sheamar achar kach (Bereshit 12:5) "vayyikkach avram vegomer veet lot" vegomer – perush shello dechafo, ad sheyyimtza hametzaa shello yachlimehu. velaze timtza ki keshemmatza sibba ketanna sheravu haroim, techef amar elav (Bereshit 13:9) "hippared vegomer im hayyamin" vegomer, vehaddavar hu kimat zar sheyyomar elav kaddevarim haelle bechol kach harechaka, ella letzad shehaya choshev machashavot lehaferido kidvar Adonai, laze techef bematzo sibba dechafo bishte yadayim. veraiti lechazzek perush ze gam ken mimma sheamar hakkatuv (Bereshit 13:14) "vaAdonai amar el avram achare hippared lot meimmo sa na enecha" – maamar ze yochiach ki yoshev umetzappe haya Adonai matay yippared lot, lehareoto et haaretz sheamar lo bitchillat davar elav, "asher arekka", velo herahu ad atta shennifrad lot, vehu maamar rishon "lech lecha meartzecha umimmoladtecha umibbet avicha" – az arekka.

Od yechavven lomar al ze hadderech lech lecha letoaltecha, vahagam sheen hattova mesubbevet mehishtaddelut keamro (tehillim 75:7) "lo mimmotza umimmaarav vegomer harim" vegomer, vedarshu zichronam livracha (Bamidbar Rabba 105) veze leshonam: kol harim shebbammikra kemashmaah chutz mizzo shehi leshon harama, ad kan. af al pi chen yesh taam baddavar letzad shinnuy makom, vehu amro meartzecha, veamru zichronam livracha (chullin 95:) shelosha devarim af al pi sheen nachash yesh siman vehem bayit tinok vechulei, veamru od (bava metzia 75:) man devish leh behay mata vela azil lemata acharita tzoek lifne Adonai veeno naane.
Umimmoladtecha. al derech amram zichronam livracha (282 hilchot deot perek 6): leolam yadur adam bishchunat arye velo beir im reshaim", ad kan.
