El haaretz asher arekka. perush shello hodio, lirot im yemaher laasot devar melech shilton mibbeli daat hammakom, veze nissayon mehannisyonot. od ramzu sheyyarenna lo kullah dichtiv (Bereshit 13:14) "sa na enecha uree tzafona vanegba" vegomer venatan lo koach hariyya lirot kullah:

Od yitbaer al derech ma sheamru besifre bappasuk (Bamidbar 35:34) "asher ani shochen betochah asher ani shochen betoch bene yisrael", en shechina shora ella betoch bene yisrael uveodan baaretz, ad kan. vehu sheamar Adonai leavraham el haaretz asher arekka, perush: reuya lecha veatta rauy lah. veshiur hatteva hu are otcha lah veare otah lecha, ki ze belo ze enam reuyim lehasheraat shechina ulerov hahatzlachot.

rashi: Beetzem hayyom hazze. shemmalu leavraham 99 shana uleyishmael 13 shanim nimmol avraham veyishmael beno:
Vayyeehal. nata ohalim leroav ulemiknehu ad sedom:
Vayhi hashshemesh baa. kemo vayhi hem merikim sakkehem (Bereshit 42), vayhi hem kovrim ish (Melachim 2 13), kelomar, vayhi davar ze:
Hashshemesh baa. shaka:
Vaalata haya. chashach hayyom:
Vehinne tannur ashan vegomer. ramaz lo sheyyippelu hammalchuyyot baggehinnom:

Baa. taamo lemala, lechach hu mevoar shebba chevar. veim haya taamo lematta, beAlef, haya mevoar keshehi shokaat; veie lomar ken, shehare chevar ketiv vayhi hashshemesh lavo, vehaavarat tannur ashan leachar mikkan hayta, nimtza shekkevar shaka; veze chilluk bechol teva leshon nekeva sheyyesodah shete otiyyot, kemo ba, kam, shav: keshehattaam lemala, leshon avar hu, kegon ze, uchegon verachel baa, kama alummati, hinne shava yevimtech, ucheshehattaam lematta hu leshon hove, davar shennaase achshav veholech, kemo baa im hatztzon, baerev hi vaa uvabboker hi shava:
Shofocho mitzrit. bat paro hayta, kesheraa nissim shennaasu lesara amar: mutav shettehe vitti shifcha bevayit ze velo gevira bevayit acher:
Lo tiggof. leshon kishshalon, 387 belaaz, vechen "pen tiggof baeven" (tehillim 91:12), vechen "beterem yitnaggefu raglechem" (yirmeya 13:16), vechen "venagfu ishsha hara" (Shemot 21:22):
targum: Heden tezel besivra bearchatach veriglach la titkal:

rashi: Mi heir mimmizrach oto, shetzedek yikraehu leraglo; mi heir et avraham lahavio mearam, shehi bammizrach, vetzedek shehaya ose, hi hayta likrat raglav bechol asher halach:
Yitten lefanav goyim. mi sheheiro mimmekomo lehassia, hu natan lefanav arbaa melachim vachayalotehem:
Yard. yirde:
Yitten keafar charbo. "rema keafra ketilin kodam charbeh" (targum yonatan), natan et charbo veose chalalim rabbim keafar, veet kashto natan marbe harugim venoflim kekash niddaf (Bereshit Rabba 43 3):
targum: Man ayte viglay mimadincha avraham bechir tzadikaya bikshot karve leatre mesar kodamohi ammin umalchin takifin tevar rema keafra katolin kodam charbe kekasha redofin kodam kashte:

rashi: Rifut tehi lesharecha. hachachma. sharecha kemo "sharrech" (Shir HaShirim 7:3), vezehu tibburecha:
Veshikkuy leatzmotecha. hu hammoach, keinyan shenneemar "umoach atzmotav yeshukke" (Iyov 21:24):
targum: Asyuta teheve lechuneshrach veduhana legarmayich:

rashi: Lemaan yitav li vaavurech. yittenu li mattanot:
ohc: Lemaan yitav vegomer. perush: taam sheani metzavvech lomar achoti, velo ani mosif leharechik yoter shettomar alav ish nachri hu etzlah, lemaan yitav vegomer, veim yihye nachri en lo inyan sheyyetivuhu bishvilah. veulay ki laze hikpid shettomar hi velo hispik sheyyomar hu ki lo yatzdiku devarav lehetivo. ulefi happeshat lo hispik lomar hu ki chashash shettomar davar sheyyukkar mimmennu ki ishto hi. veamro vechayta hi tachlit hattova, shemmekavve lehachayot nafsho baraav. vedikdek lomar vechayta nafshi velo amar veechye vechulei lirmoz amro (Mishlei 13:25) "tzaddik ochel lesova nafsho".

Od yirtze bedikduk od amro kefel inyan "baavurech" uviglalech", shehaya lo lomar "yitav li vechayta nafshi biglalech" o "baavurech". achen nitkavven lishne devarim: haechad lemaan yetivu lo baavur achoto tova gashmiyyit, veod vechayta nafshi vegomer al derech ma sheddarshu zichronam livracha (berachot lo:) befasuk (Shmuel 1 1:11) "im rao tire" sheim lo yifkedeha taase sheal karchacha yire latet lah zera al yede shettelech vetissater vechulei vetibbadek kesota venizrea zara. kemo chen chashav avraham ki al yede setirat haishsha im haish vehi nekiyya Adonai yifkedenna bevanim bedomin lo, vehu amro vechayta nafshi bifkudat hazzera biglalech, perush baddevarim hammitgalgelim mimmech, al derech ma sheddarshu zichronam livracha (shabbat kanna:) befasuk "biglal haddavar" vegomer. velaze hifsik betevat "baavurech" lomar ki hem shene devarim. gam amro vechayta betosefet vav lomar shehu perat chadash veeno anaf "yitav li", ki hem shete bechinot hahatava: echad lagguf veechad lannefesh. vedavar ze husag etzlo bassetira shennistera im avimelech velo bappaam hazzot im paro, letaam ki sham lo haya chashad ki gersho meartzo, gilla ki lo asa davar. o efshar ki beemtzaut shete peamim nitparsem hakkol al sara ki nistera veal yede ze nifkeda. shuv ba leyadi maamar rabbotenu zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 133) veze leshonam: amar rabbi yitzchak, amar hakkadosh baruch hu, ketiv (Bamidbar 5:28) "veim lo nitmea haishsha utehora hi venikketa venizrea zara", vezo shennichnesa levet paro ulevet avimelech veyatzta tehora, en din shettippaked, ad kan leshono. vehem devarenu atzmam vehaven. hare shechayta nafsho shel avraham bevanim biglal sara.

rashi: Vaytzav alav. al odotav, leshallecho uleshamro:
Vayshallechu. ketargumo vealviu:

Beetzem hayyom. bo bayyom shennitztavva, bayyom velo ballayla; lo nityare lo min haggoyim velo min halletzanim, veshello yihyu oyvav uvene doro omrim illu reinuhu lo hinnachnuhu lamul ulekayyem mitzvato shel makom:
Vayyamol. leshon vayyifal:
ohc: Vayyikkach avraham vegomer. leheyot sheyyishmael haya gadol ben 13 shana, laze hutzrach lekachto bidvarim lehitratztzot lo. vegam lilide veto umiknat kaspo, ki haya bahem gedolim, ulekacham befiyyus, ki ratza shekkullam yekabbelu alehem birtzonam mitzvat hammelech.

Kaasher dibber vegomer. tzarich lanu ladaat lamma hutzrach lomar "kaasher dibber" vegomer, roe ani ki chen asa. veulay sheyyechavven lomar sheoto maase shellakach otam beritztzuy hu kaasher dibber itto elohim.
Od yechavven lomar shello nitakkev measot mitzvat Adonai ella techef umiyyad, kaasher dibber perush samuch, veze lehodia zerizuto alav hashshalom baavodat hakkadosh baruch hu.

Od yechavven lomar al derech amram zichronam livracha (avoda zara 27.) "hammal yimmol" – shetztzarich hammal sheyyihye hu atzmo nimmol. veze hu sheamar kaasher dibber itto, perush shekkadam hu umal atzmo techilla veachar kach mal haacherim. uchefi ze lo kashe lamma lo hizkir hakkatuv milat avraham, ki mishshene teamim yesh lo lehakedim atzmo: ben mitztzad hazzerizut, keshot atzmecha vechulei, ben mitztzad kede sheyyamul otam kahalacha asher tzivvahu Adonai "hammal yimmol".

Uma sheamar hakkatuv achar kach: "veavraham ben tishim vatesha shana" vegomer (Bereshit 17:24), ze lehodia hazzeman shebbo nimmol, keshem sheamar "veyishmael ben shelosh esre", af al pi chen hizkiro kodem. ulema shepperashti lo kashe, ki hishmianu hakkatuv shehu mal atzmo techilla, kemo shekkatuv "kaasher dibber itto" vegomer al ofen shepperashti.
Chassalat parashat lecha lecha

rashi: Mevakshim mayim. nitnabbe hannavi al acharit hayyamim (Amos 8:11-12): "lo raav lallechem velo tzama lammayim ki im lishmoa et devar Adonai, yeshottu levakkesh et devar Adonai velo yimtzau", uchesheyyashuv appo yachin lahem lechem umayim, veyashkon shechinato veruach befi neviehem:

Nashatta. leshon "venishshetu mayim mihayyam" (Yeshayahu 19:5), leshon "hashshet vehashshever" (Eicha 3:47), vechullan leshon churba veyovesh. ulechach hattav mudgeshet, shehare baa bimkom shetayim, sheen shet belo tav, vehaya lo lomar linkeva 'nashteta, shehare lezachar yachid yomar 'nishta velirbim 'venishtu:
targum: Invetanaya vachashichaya dimchamdin leulefana ha ketzachya lemaya vela meshakkechin ruchehon besigufa meshalhaya ana Adonai akabbel tzelothon elaha deyisrael la arachekinun:

rashi: Harimoti yadi. leshon shevua, merim ani et yadi leel elyon, vechen bi nishbati (202 22), nishba ani, vechen natatti kesef hassade kach mimmenni (sham 23), noten ani lecha kesef hassade, kachehu mimmenni:
ohc: Vayyomer avram el melech vegomer. taam haramat yado hi kede sheyyitammet etzel melech sedom sheen dato od lachzor bo baddavar hazze, lo kullo velo miktzato.

Veamro im michut vegomer veim ekkach, shello haya lo lomar ella "im ekkach michut" vegomer, nitkavven lomar al ze hadderech: harimoti vegomer im michut vegomer – perush: hare hu alay kitruma im lakachti michut vead vegomer meharchush haamur bainyan, veod hosif shello yikkach leatid mikkol vechulei, vehu amro "veim ekkach" vegomer:

Od yechavven lomar al ze hadderech: harimoti yadi – perush: natatti teruma sheani chayyav mehakkol, "im michut vead" vegomer, ma sheani chayyav kefi haddin. veshello tomar sheani lahut achar hammamon vetovea ma sheeno shelli – "veim ekkach mikkol" vegomer, aval lo mippene havvatranut ehye gozel laggavoah ma sheani chayyav latet lo, shehu terumat maaser.

rashi: Uverachti otah. uma hi habberacha? shechazra lenaarutah, shenneemar hayta li edna (202 18):

Uverachtiha. bahanakat shadayim keshennitzrecha lechach beyom mishte shel yitzchak, shehayu merannenin alehem sheheviu asufi min hashshuk veomrim benenu hu, vehevia chol achat bena immah umeniktah lo hevia, vehi henika et kullam; hu shenneemar henika vanim sara, ber remazo bemiktzat:

Hannearim. avaday asher halchu itti veod aner eshkol umamre vegomer; af al pi sheavaday nichnesu lammilchama, shenneemar hu vaavadav vayyakkem, veaner vachaverav yashvu al hakkelim lishmor, afillu hachi hem yikchu chelkam. umimmennu lamad david, sheamar kechelek hayyored bammilchama uchechelek hayyoshev al hakkelim yachdav yachaloku (Shmuel 1 30), ulechach neemar vayhi mehayyom hahu vamala vaysimeha lechok ulemishpat (sham), velo neemar vahala, lefi shekkevar nittan hachok bime avram:
ohc: Hem yikchu chelkam vegomer. perush: lo sheyyihye harshut beyadcha vetikkanes immahem beshiurin, ella harshut beyadam lakachat asher yishpetu hem, ki hu hannogea lahem. gam baze hera lo kefi haemet elav nogim hannechasim, ella shechash laamira, hagam shehi kozevet af al pi chen memaet bichvodo shel avram baamirato.

rashi: Achare hippared lot. kol zeman sheharasha immo haya haddibbur poresh mimmennu:
ohc: VaAdonai amar vegomer. taam shello hitchil lomar "vayyomer Adonai el avram achare" vegomer, yechavven lomar leheyot sheamar hakkatuv "vayyomer avram el lot vegomer hippared na" vegomer vehifrid rasha mealav, mosif hakkatuv lomar sheggam Adonai haya yoshev umetzappe el haddavar, vetechef umiyyad shennifrad harasha dibber elav veherahu et haaretz. vehu ma sheamar lo (Bereshit 12:1) "asher arekka" uchemo shepperashnuhu bimkomo:
Uree min hammakom. taam shehutzrach lomar min hammakom asher atta sham, kan asa lo nes atzum sheyyuchal lirot mitztzafon ledarom umimmaarav lemizrach mimmakom echad mibbeli sheyyutzrach lesovev.

rashi: Veavram ben shemonim vegomer. leshivcho shel yishmael nichtav, lehodia shehaya ben 13 shana keshennimmol velo ikkev:
Uleavram hetiv. paro baavurah:
Hacharishu elay. kede lishmoa davar:
Iyyim. ummot shel avodat kochavim umazzalot:
Yachalifu choach. yitkashshetu veyitchazzeku bechol gevuratam, ulay yaamdu baddin bechoach:
Yiggeshu. halom, veaz mishsheyyiggeshu yedabberu:
Lammishpat nikrava. lehochicham al penehem:
targum: Atzitu lememri nagvan umalkevan yosfun chel yitkarvun bechen yemallun kachada ledina nitkerav:

rashi: Al yaluzu meenecha. al yitakkemu minneged enecha lahasiram mikkenegdecha:
targum: Beri la nizal beenach netar mada vetarita:

rashi: Vayyomer lah malach vegomer. al kol amira haya shaluach lah malach acher, lechach neemar malach bechol amira vaamira:
Tolaat yaakov. mishpachat yaakov hachalasha ketolaat, sheen lah gevura ella befiha (tanchuma beshallach 9). tolaat – 313 belaaz:
Mete yisrael. mispar yisrael:
targum: La tidachlun shivtaya devet yaakov zarita deyisrael memri vesaadchon amar Adonai ufarikchon kadisha deyisrael:

rashi: Haholech et avram. mi garam shehaya lo zot? halichato im avram:

Vayyelech lemassaav. keshechazar mimmitzrayim leeretz kenaan haya holech velan baachsanyot shellan bahem bahalichato lemitzrayim, limmedcha derech eretz, shello yeshanne adam meachsanya shello. davar acher bachazarato para hakkafotav (Bereshit Rabba):
Minnegev. eretz mitzrayim bidromah shel eretz kenaan:
Veatta. vav zo mosif al inyan rishon, ani hinne veriti ittach, veatta heve zahir leshamro, uma hi shemirato? zot beriti asher tishmeru himmol lachem vegomer:
Vearel zachar. kan limmed shehammila beoto makom shehu nikkar ben zachar linkeva (Bereshit Rabba):
Asher lo yimmol. mishsheyyaggia lichlal onashin venichreta; aval aviv en anush alav karet, aval over baase:
Venichreta hannefesh. holech ariri umet kodem zemanno (shabbat 24):

Veeescha legoy gadol. lefi shehadderech goremet lishlosha devarim, memaetet periyya ureviyya umemaetet et hammamon umemaetet et hashshem, lechach huzkak lishlosha berachot hallalu, shehivticho al habbanim veal hammamon veal hashshem:
Vaavarechcha. bemamon (Bereshit Rabba):

Vehye beracha. habberachot netunot beyadcha; ad achshav hayu veyadi, berachti leadam venoach, umeachshav atta tevarech et asher tachpotz (Bereshit Rabba). davar acher veeescha legoy gadol ze sheomrim elohe avraham, vaavarechcha ze sheomrim elohe yitzchak, vaagaddela shemecha ze sheomrim elohe yaakov. yachol yihyu chotmin bechullan, talmud lomar vehye beracha, becha chotmin velo vahem:
Meartzecha. vahalo chevar yatza mishsham im aviv uva ad charan? ella kach amar lo hitrachek od mishsham vetze mibbet avicha:

Asher arekka. lo gilla lo haaretz miyyad kede lechabbevah beenav, velatet lo sachar al kol dibbur vedibbur; kayyotze vo, et bincha et yechidcha asher ahavta et yitzchak (203 22), kayyotze vo al achad heharim asher omar elecha, vchyvb ukera eleha et hakkeria asher anochi dover elecha (Yona 3):
ohc: Veeescha legoy gadol vegomer. leheyot shetztzivva lo shelosha, kava lo kenegdam shalosh: veeescha vegomer keneged "lech lecha meartzecha", vaavarechcha vaagaddela shemecha keneged "umimmoladtecha", vehye beracha keneged "umibbet avicha". shettimtza ki bihyot haadam beartzo toch mishpachto uvet aviv yeshno bishlosha devarim: ha sheyyesh lo harebe makkirim vereim veohavim. 2 shebbene mishpachto tefaarehu vechavod vehadar teatterehu kederech kol mishpacha livne mishpachtam. 3 sheyyihye nizzon umitparnes umitrachem mibbet aviv letzrachav. uchesheyyotze meartzo vechulei chaser lechullan, velaze amar elav Adonai keneged "meartzecha" ani eese lecha harebe ohavim mimmecha miyyotze chalatzecha. ucheneged chesron hattoelet shel bene hammishpacha kannizkar "vaavarechcha vaagaddela shemecha", ucheneged chesron hammoil mibbet avicha "vehye beracha".

rashi: Betach el Adonai. ufazzer meotecha levakkesh lecha rav lilmod mimmennu, veel binatcha al tishshaen:
targum: Sevir belaha min kule libbach veal beyuneta delibbach la tistemich:

rashi: Achar haddevarim haelle. kol makom sheneemar achar – samuch, achare – muflag (Bereshit Rabba). achar haddevarim haelle achar shennaasa lo nes ze, sheharag et hammelachim vehaya doeg veomer, shemma kibbalti sachar al kol tzidkotay, lechach amar lo hammakom al tira avram anochi magen lach, min haonesh, shello teanesh al kol otan nefashot sheharagta; uma sheatta doeg al kibbul secharcha, secharcha harebe meod (Bereshit Rabba):

Et hakkeni. eser ummot yesh kan velo natan lahem ella shiva goyim, vehashshelosha edom umoav veammon, vehem keni, kenizzi, vekaddemoni atidim lihyot yerushsha leatid (Bereshit Rabba), shenneemar: edom umoav mishloach yadam uvene ammon mishmatam (yeshaya 11):
Veanshe sedom raim. veaf al pi chen lo nimna lot millishkon immahem. verabbotenu lamdu mikkan (yoma 38) veshem reshaim yirkav (Mishlei 10):
Raim. begufam:
Vechattaim. bemamonam (115 109):
LaAdonai meod. yodim ribbonam, umitkavvenim limrod bo:
Lamma tomar ammi yaakov utedabber baggalut:
Nistera darki meAdonai. helim minneged enav kol ma sheavadnuhu, vehimshil alenu otam shello yedauhu:
Umeelohay mishpati yaavor. heevir millefanav mishpat haggemul hattov, shehaya lo leshallem laavotenu velanu:
targum: Lema temar yaakov utemalel yisrael metamra orchi min kodam Adonai umin kodam elahi dini yeade:

rashi: Vayyechalek alehem. lefi feshuto sares hammikra "vayyechalek hu vaavadav alehem layla" kederech harodfim shemmitpallegim achar hannirdafim, keshebborchin ze lechan veze lechan:
Layla. kelomar achar shechashcha lo nimna milleradfam. umidrash aggada shennechelak hallayla, uvechetzyo harishon naasa lo nes, vechetzyo hashsheni nishmar uva lo lachatzot layla shel mitzrayim:
Ad chova. en makom sheshshemo chova, vedan kore chova, al shem avoda zara sheatida lihyot sham:

Vayyippol avraham al panav vayyitzchak. ze tiu, leshon simcha, vachadi, veshel sara leshon machoch; lamadta sheavraham heemin vesamach vesara lo heemina veliglega, vezehu shehikpid hakkabba al sara velo hikpid al avraham:
Halleven. yesh temihot shehen kayyamot, kemo haniglo nigleti? (Shmuel 1 2), haroe atta (18 8), af zo hi kayyemet; vechach amar belibbo, hanaasa chesed ze leacher, ma shehakkabba ose li?

Veim sara havat tishim shana. hayta cheday leled; veaf al pi sheddorot harishonim hayu molidin bene 500 shana, bime avraham nitmaatu hashshanim kevar uva tashshut koach laolam, tze ulemad measara dorot shemminnoach vead avraham, shemmiharu toldotehen bene 60 uvene 70:
Shenem asar nesiim. kaananim yichlu; kemo nesiim veruach (Mishlei 25):
ohc: Uleyishmael shematicha vegomer. hakkavvana leheyot sheavraham lo hitpallel al yishmael ella letzad shehu levaddo zaro, ma sheen ken achar shennatan lo Adonai zera missara, az lo yevakkesh od al yishmael. laze amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu "uleyishmael shematicha", perush kibbalti devarecha, vehu al derech amram zichronam livracha (makkot 11.) killat chacham afillu al tenay mitkayyemet, umerubba midda tova mimmiddat vechulei. ulefi ma shepperashti shettefillat avraham al yishmael hayta sheyyihye tzaddik, ramaz lo Adonai sheyyachzor bitshuva, keamro "hinne berachti oto" sheyyachzor bitshuva, shehabberacha hu sheyyihye nichlal bevaruch, uvaruch hu mekor hakkedushsha. veamar leshon avar berachti vegomer, hu ma sheramaz beamro (Bereshit 15:15) "tikkaver beseva tova", vechen haya, keamram zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 59:7) sheasa teshuva.

rashi: Veettena veriti. berit shel ahava uverit haaretz lehorishah lecha al yede mitzva zo:
Veet harfaim. eretz og, shenneemar bah: hahu yikkare eretz refaim (Devarim 3):
Shetem esre shana avdu. chamishsha melachim hallalu et kedarlaomer:
Mamre. shem adam:
Asher hechezakticha. lekachticha lechelki, kemo (Shemot 4:4) "vayyishlach yado vayyachazek bo":
Miktzot haaretz. mishshear haovde kochavim umazzalot:
Umeatzileha. min haggedolim shebbahen:
Keraticha. beshem lechelki, "beni vechori yisrael" (Shemot 4:22):
Velo measticha. kaze shenneemar bo (Malachi 1:3) "saneti":
targum: Dekarevtach mizarit ara umimalkevata bechartach vaamaret lach avdi at itreeti bach vela archekinach:

rashi: Beerot beerot chemar. beerot harebe hayu sham, shennotlin mishsham adama letit shel binyan. umidrash aggada shehaya hattit mugbal bahem, venaasa nes lemelech sedom sheyyatza mishsham, lefi shehayu vaummot miktzatan shello hayu maaminin shennitztzal avraham meur kasdim mikkivshan haesh, vechevan sheyyatza ze min hachemar, heeminu veavram lemafrea:

Hera nasu. lehar nasu, hera, kemo lehar; kol teva shetztzericha lamed bitchillatah, hetil lah hei besofah. veyesh chilluk ben hera lehahara, shehe shebbesof hatteva omedet bimkom lamed shebberoshah, aval enah omedet bimkom lamed unekuda pattach tachteha, vahare hera kemo lehar o kemo el har, veeno mefaresh leeze har, ella shekkol echad nas baasher matza har techilla, ucheshehu noten hei veroshah lichtov hahara o hammidbara, pitrono kemo el hahar o chemo lehahar, umashma leoto har hayyadua umeforash bapparasha:
Veheemin baAdonai. lo shaal lo ot al zot; aval al yerushshat haaretz shaal lo ot veamar lo bamma eda.

Vayyachsheveha lo tzedaka. hakkabba chashavah loavram lizchut velitzdaka al haamana sheheemin bo. davar acher bamma eda, lo shaal lo ot ella amar lefanav, hodieni beeze zechut yitkayyemu bah, amar lo hakkabba, bizchut hakkarbanot:
ohc: Veheemin baAdonai vayyachsheveha lo tzedaka. perush al derech amram zichronam livracha (rosh hashshana 6.) ki din hatztzedaka kannedarim, shehannoder laggavoah kemoser lehedyot. vehu sheamar "veheemin baAdonai" perush hifkid etzlo habberacha, veim tomar vahalo adayin lo higgia leyado lehafekidah beyad neeman, laze amar vayyachsheveha lo tzedaka, perush hechshiv avraham ma sheamar Adonai elav shehu tzedaka, vechevan shekken din mesira yesh lah veheeminah beyad Adonai.

Od yirtze, leheyot shehivticho vehu sheyyihyu banav tzaddikim, vedavar ze eno beyado shel hakkadosh baruch hu, keamram zichronam livracha (berachot log:) hakkol bide shamayim chutz miyyirat shamayim, amar hakkatuv sheheemin baAdonai shekken yaase, velo hirher achar middotav lomar "vahalo" vechulei, vayyachsheveha Adonai leavraham tzedaka shehifli lehatzedik. o yirmoz al ze hadderech shehagam shemmeet Adonai hayta zot lihyot sheloshim tzaddikim baolam (Bereshit Rabba perek la uferek mat), im ken hu chafetz lehattot adam lederech yashar, veen laish hazze mishpat tzedaka sheamar hakkatuv (Devarim 6, 25) "utzedaka tihye lanu ki nishmor" vegomer. meatta hashsheloshim tzaddikim muchrachim hem bemaasehem. laze amar sheaf al pi chen vayyachsheveha Adonai lo tzedaka, perush lazzera hammuzkar besamuch, dichtiv "yihye zarecha" ki sham ramaz hashsheloshim bemispar "yihye".

rashi: Ki chullah mashke. eretz nachale mayim:
Lifne shachet Adonai et sedom veet amora. haya oto mishor:
Kegan Adonai. lailanot:
Keeretz mitzrayim. lazzeraim (Bereshit Rabba):
Boacha tzoar. ad tzoar. umidrash aggada dorshah lignay, al shehayu shetufe zimma bachar lo lot bishchunatam:
Vatteanneha shoroy. hayta meshabedet bah bekoshi (Bereshit Rabba):
Vaynagga Adonai vegomer. bemakkat ratan laka, shehattashmish kashe lo (Bereshit Rabba):
(Veet beto ketargumo veal enash bete umidrasho lerabbot kotalav veammudav vekelav berashi yashan):
Al devar saray. al pi dibburah; omeret lammalach hach, vehu makke;
ohc: Vaynagga Adonai vegomer al devar saray eshet vegomer. perush, ki bishat hannega hodia ki saray hi eshet avram:

rashi: Hinne na yadati. midrash aggada ad achshav lo hikkir bah mittoch tzeniut shebbishnehem, veachshav hikkir ba al yede maase. davar acher, minhag haolam sheal yede torach hadderech adam mitbazze, vezot amda beyafyah. ufeshuto shel mikra hinne na higgia hashshaa sheyyesh lidog al yafyech, yadati ze yamim rabbim ki yefat mare at, veachshav anu vaim ben anashim shechorim umechoarim, achehem shel kushim, velo hurgelu veishsha yafa; vedome lo hinne na adonay suru na (202 19):
ohc: Vayhi kaasher hikriv vegomer hinne na yadati vegomer. rabbotenu zichronam livracha amru (bava batra 16.) lehaggid tzeniut shehaya benehem, vetzarich ladaat leeze inyan amar lah ken avraham.

Achen leheyot ki ratza letzauot aleha lomar "achi hu", chash shettomar sara lamma hichnisah begeder sakkana, sheal kol panim hi mistakkenet o timmaser beal karchah beyad hattemeim al yede harigat habbaal o birtzonah, velo haya lo lahaviah lemakom kaze. vahagam shebbetuchim hatztzaddikim behakkadosh baruch hu, af al pi chen kelal ze beyadenu sheen somchin al hannes, uma gam legabbe bechirat haadam. vetze ulemad (kiddushin lat:) mishshemuel sheamar (Shmuel 1 16:2) "veshama shaul vaharagani". laze amar eleha hinne na vegomer, natan hitnatztzelut al haddavar ki atta noda lo velo mikkodem, sheim haya yodea ma sheyyada atta lo haya meviah el mitzrayim vehaya holech lemakom acher. vetaam netinat lev ladaat letzad kirvato lavo lemitzrayim raa panim keurot, o yada bikrivat hair ki hammelech yikkach hayyafa bannashim venatan dato vehikkir bah. veamro "ki ishsha yefat" vegomer, velo hispik lomar "ki yefat mare at", nitkavven lomar ki achat hi baolam, ishsha yefat mare hi veen dome lah, vehaven:

Veal yikshe beenecha shehalach immah leeretz pelishtim achar sheyyada ki ishsha yefat mare hi, ki eretz pelishtim lo hayu keurot kol kach kemitzrayim. velaze timtza shello hutzrach letzauot aleha shettomar hi, ella hu amar aleha "achoti hi" (Bereshit 20:2), ki lo haya bet mechush keanshe mitzrayim shehayu betachlit hakkiur vehi betachlit hayyofi:

rashi: Vechol-chafatzecha. kol chamuddotecha:
Lo yishvu vah. lo yihyu shavin beshavyah vedamehen bedameha:
targum: Yakira hi min kefe tavata vechol midaam la fachem leh:

rashi: Emek hassiddim. kach shemo, al shem shehav vo sadot harebe:
Hu yam hammelach. leachar zeman nimshach hayyam letocho venaasa yam hammelach. umidrash aggada omer shennitbakkeu hatztzurim sevivotav venimshechu yeorim letocho:
Amrafel. hu nimrod, sheamar leavraham pol letoch kivshan haesh (Bereshit Rabba):
Melech goyim. makom yesh sheshshemo goyim, al shem shennitkabbetzu shamma mikkamma ummot umekomot vehimlichu ish alehem ushemo tidal:
ohc: Vayhi bime vegomer. taam seder hodaat hainyan, lomar ki arbaa melachim ellu takkifim hayu. tze ulemad ezer elohim sheim avraham asher macha haarbaa melachim bachatzi hallayla ushear hattoaliyyot.

rashi: Lezaracha natatti. amirato shel hakkabba keilu hi asuya:

Hannahar haggadol. lefi shehu davuk leeretz yisrael korehu gadol, aappi shehu meuchar bearbaa neharot hayyotzim meeden, shenneemar vehannahar harvii hu ferat. mashal hedyot: eved melech melech, hiddavek lashshachavar veyishtachavu lecha (Bereshit Rabba):
ohc: Bayyom hahu karat vegomer. amro natatti leshon avar, lefi ma shekkadam lanu shehechzik bah avraham kemo shepperashnu bimkomo (Bereshit 13:15) yutzdak lomar natatti kevar, ki habbanim yizku middin yoresh.

Hinne yesh litmoah ech tach merot enehem shel hammemaanim lehaamin bigdullatenu umaalatenu haatida lavo, ki mikra male dibber hakkatuv shekkarat Adonai berit im avraham avinu alav hashshalom latet lezaro asara ummot, vead atta lo matzinu shennatan Adonai leyisrael ella sheva ummot venisharu shalosh ummot, veech yomru haatzamot hayeveshot (Yechezkel 37) avda tikvat nachalatenu ushevuat Adonai menaggedtam? vegam hashsheva shennatan Adonai lo kullam bau leferek hitkabbel, uvaavonotenu avadim mashlu vanu. veasa Adonai kacha lirmoz midda keneged midda: keshem sheanu avde Adonai veen nichnaim lo yitbarach keeved mored berabbo, gam ken yavou avadim shellanu veyimredu banu. veod yesh leeloah millin lekayyem berito.

Od natatti libbi latur beseder hakketuvim, vaere ki hikdim hakkeni vehakkenizzi vehakkadmoni shehem ammon umoav veedom, shello bau leyadenu barishona ella shiva hammeucharim, veen nachon lehakedim hammeuchar. achen vadday ki meet Adonai hayta zot lehaircha ulehaggid lecha ki ikkar hannetina hi haatida, sheyyavou yachad hashshalosh veimmam hannotar mehashsheva ummot, vetikpotz piha avla birot shevuat Adonai. vesiman laddavar netinat haarbaa melachim asher natan Adonai leavraham: shelosha keneged keni ukenizzi vekadmoni, veharvii tidal melech goyim (Bereshit 14:1) remez el hitassefut haggoyim hannisharim behashshiva harishonim, vehaven:

rashi: Mizze vat. mehechan bat? yode haya, ella litten lah petach likkanes immah bidvarim. uleshon e mizze: ayye hammakom shettomar alav mizze ani vaa?
Aval. leshon amittat devarim, vechen aval ashemim anachnu (Bereshit 42), aval ben en lah (Melachim 2 4):
Vekarata et shemo yitzchak. al shem hatztzechok, veyeo al shem haasara nisyonot 96 shana shel sara 14 yamim shennimmol, 106 shana shel avraham:

Vahakimoti et beriti itto. lamma neemar, kevar ketiv veatta et beriti tishmor atta vezaracha vegomer? ella lefi sheomer vahakimoti vegomer, yachol bene yishmael uvene ketura bichlal hakkiyyum, talo vahakimoti et beriti itto – velo im acherim: veet beriti akim et yitzchak. lamma neemar? ella limmed shehaya kadosh mibbeten. davar acher amar Rabbi abba, mikkan lamad kava ben haggevira mibben haama; ketiv hinne berachti oto vehifreti oto vehirbeti oto, ze yishmael, vekava veet beriti akim et yitzchak:
Veet beriti. berit hammila tehe mesura lezaro shel yitzchak:
ohc: Vayyomer elohim aval sara vegomer – tzarich ladaat taam amro "aval", ki en lah mashmaut.

Venire shennitkavven lomar elav: in, hachi nammi, im hannetina hi bishvilcha levad, yesh lecha pe lomar sheatta mistappek beyishmael, aval sara ishtecha yoledet, perush: letzad shetteled sara encha rashshay levatter beshel hazzulat. vedikdek lomar "lecha", perush: sheyyihye lah ben mimmecha kitfillatah, shekkol banim sheyyihyu lah yihyu mimmecha.

Od efshar lomar ki Adonai hikpid al sheamar lo "yishmael", shebbachar beyishmael. veefshar ki ze haya sibba shennittan lo yitzchak missitra denukeba, vehu amro "sara yoledet", venitztaer harebe mitztzad ze kesheakad oto al gabbe hammizbeach, ki al yede haakeda nittena lo hannefesh hayyoledet venolda lo az rivka bat zugo.

rashi: Kikkar. mishor, ketargumo:
Mikkedem. nasa meetzel avram vehalach lo lemaaravo shel avram; nimtza nosea mimmizrach lemaarav. umidrash aggada hissia atzmo mikkadmono shel olam; amar i efshi lo beavram velo velohav:

Al tishta. al yimmas libbecha lihyot keshaava zo (Bereshit Rabba 65 19). veze hakkelal: kol teva shettechillat yesodah shin, keshebba ledabber bilshon mitpael, hitpael o yitpael, hattav choleket venichneset ben shete otiyyot sharshe hatteva, kemo "vayyishtomem" (Yeshayahu 59:16), "veyishtammer chukkot amri" (Micha 6:16), "tishtakkarin" (Shmuel 1 1:14), "tishtappech nafshi" (Iyov 30:16):
targum: La tidchal are vesaadach memri la tittevar are ana elahach itkefinach af esadinach af achadinach bimin kusheti:

rashi: Ulay ibbane mimmenna. limmed al mi sheen lo banim sheeno vanuy ella harus:
Ibbane mimmenna. bizchut sheachnis tzarati letoch beti:
Lekol saray. leruach hakkodesh shebbah (Bereshit Rabba):
Beni uvenechem vegomer. otam shel achshav:
Uven zaracha acharecha. haatidin lehivvaled:
Himmol. kemo lehimmol, kemo sheatta omer asot, kemo laasot:
Vaychazzek charash. nosech happesel:
Et tzoref. hammerakkeo bezahav:
Machalik pattish. baacharona, keshehu makke benachat lehachalik et hammelacha:
Et holem paam. hu hammatchil bah keshehi ashet, umakke bechol kocho:
Omer laddevek tov hu. al otan shehayu mechazzerin achar karka tova ledabbek bah ashashiyyot barzel:
Vaychazzekehu. latztzelem:
Bemasmerim lo yimmot. kullam yechazzeku ze et ze:
targum: Hala yevahatun beovadehon dematkef nagara im kenaa mache befatisha im dimtappach vekurensa zimna amar al divka takin hu umatkef leh vemasmerin dela yitztele:

rashi: Adonai bechachma yasad aretz. al pi hattora, vehi hattora vehi hattevuna vehu haddaat. veachar shekkol haolam nivra vahem, lechach:
targum: Elaha bechachmeta shitasya ara veatken shemaya vivyuna:

rashi: Ki av hamon goyim. leshon notarikon shel shemo; veresh shehayta vo battechilla, shello haya av ella laaram shehu mekomo veachshav av lechol haolam, lo zaza mimmekomah, sheaf yod shel saray nitraama al hashshechina ad shennittosfa lihoshua, shenneemar vayyikra moshe lehoshea bin nun yehoshua (Bamidbar 13):
ohc: Velo yikkare vegomer vehaya shimcha vegomer. bemidrash bereshit rabba amru (Bereshit Rabba 44,4) veze leshono: "vayyomer avram hen li", amar rabbi shemuel bar yitzchak: hammazzal dochakeni veomer li: avram, en atta molid. amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu: kidvarecha – avram eno molid, avraham molid, saray lo yalda, sara teled, ad kan leshono. kashe, hare matzinu sheyyalad avraham et yishmael kodem shennikra shemo avraham!
Od tzarich ladaat amro "saray lo yalda" vechulei, nidrashti lelo shaalu, shehare lo taan ella avram, lo haya lo lehashiv ella "avram" vechulei, ki saray mi hizkirah?

Venire leheyot sheikkar banim shel avraham hem asher tolid lo sara, dichtiv "ki veyitzchak" vegomer (Bereshit 21:12), veavraham avinu alav hashshalom yada ze beruach hakkodesh ki yishmael eno ella berure pesolet shel yitzchak, veraa bammazzal ki ikkar zaro lo yetze laolam, ki min hassetam lo yaggid hammazzal ella al ish im bat zugo, velaze amar, avram eno molid, ki ledat yishmael eno leda, keamro "ki veyitzchak yikkare lecha zara". uvaze yityashshev lamma bitshuvat Adonai elav hizkir sara ki hi ikkar ledat avraham.

rashi: Vegam et haggoy. vegam lerabbot 4 malchuyyot, sheaf hen kalim al sheshshibedu et yisrael:
Dan anochi. beeser makkot:
Birchush gadol. bemamon gadol, kemo shenneemar vaynatztzelu et mitzrayim (Shemot 12):
ohc: Vegam et haggoy vegomer. kashe ech yutzdak lomar "vegam" al ma shekkadam shehu hashshibud vehainnuy, veze hatava linkom nakam meoyvenu. 2, tevat et meyutteret. 3, amro dan anochi davar yadua hu ki hu hu hashshofet. 4, lamma hifsik ben hammeora asher gazar Adonai al banav bemishpat hameshabedim, vehaya lo lehashelim lomar "veachare chen yetzu" vegomer shehu gemar inyan yisrael, veachar kach yomar "et haggoy asher yaavodu" vegomer. velaze efshar shennitkavven lomar beshinnuy ze sheachar sheyyishpot Adonai et haggoy yetzu birchush, velakach seder heasuy, uchemo shemmatzinu shekken haya, battechilla dan otam veachar kach hishilum rechush gadol.

Achen mashmaut hakketuvim yitbaaru al derech amram zichronam livracha (tanchuma, beshallach) "vachamushim alu" vegomer, echad mechamishshim veyesh omrim echad mechamesh meot, vehashshear metu bemitzrayim bime choshech vaafela kede shello yargishu bahem hammitzrim. od amru zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 94) befasuk "ulechol bene yisrael haya or" vegomer shehayu yisrael mechappesim chadre cheftze mitzrayim vehayu yodim vechulei, uveemtzaut ze hishilum vaynatztzelu vegomer, veayyen ma shepperashti beferush pasuk ze bimkomo. vehu sheamar Adonai leavraham vegam et vegomer, perush: millevad gezerat hashshibud vehainnuy, vegam tosefet gezerat puraniyyot yadun et yisrael kesheyyadun et hammitzrim, lehashemid velaharog chelek gadol mehem, lemar chamishshim chalakim ulemar chamesh meot chalakim. uvaze yeduyyak tevat vegam vetevat et, veamro anochi perush: makka zo lo yadu bah hammitzrim ki im hu levaddo ki hayu bime hachoshech. vesamach laze amro veachare chen vegomer, perush: beemtzaut oto hammishpat kesheyyavi hammakka hahi ladun et shenehem, goy oved vegoy neevad, shehu makkat hachoshech, achare chen yetzu birchush vegomer kaamur lemala ki beemtzaut ze hishilum.
Od yitbaer hakkatuv bema shennedakdek od, lamma hevi Adonai al hammitzriyyim eser makkot veal hayyam laku vechulei, achar shemmatzinu ki chen gazar haggozer.

Vehinne harambam zichrono livracha besefer hammadda (hilchot teshuva perek 6 halacha Adonai) katav ki taam chiyyuv haummot hameshabedim hu letzad shello amar Adonai umma pelonit vechulei. vehissiguhu ramban veraavad ki ma bechach, sof sof mitzva osim bekiyyum devar melech. uferesh ramban ki haonesh hu letzad shehosifu leannot yoter midde haavoda asher gazar Adonai, velidvarav en haummot neenashim ella al tosefet innuy. uledarko zichrono livracha yitbaer hakkatuv al ze hadderech: vegam et haggoy dan anochi, perush yadin Adonai ammo, umimmotza davar atta yodea ki yarbe yoter mishshiur haggezera, vedikdek lomar et, perush yadun itto immo hu bichvodo uveatzmo, vehu omer anochi ki hu hayyodea shiur haggezera veshiur hattosefet shealav yaanish otam, vechol ze ledarko shel ramban.

Vehannachon beenay hu ki chol haummot chayyavin leanesh al kol hainnuy vehatztzaar asher yareu lanu, vehachakira meikkara enah tzodeket. ki haummot taam asher yeannunu hu letzad havedalatenu mehem vekiyyum hammitzvot asher anu mekayyemim, vetze ulemad im hayu yisrael ovdim lattale vehayu leam echad bemitzrayim lo hayu hammitzriyyim mishtabedim bahem vehayu kaachehem hammitzrim. vechen bechol umma veumma asher teshabed yisrael vetarea, hattaam hu letzad heyotenu nachalat shadday. umeatta ma makom letaanat shehem sheluche el haggozer, vahalo el gazar al asher avru anaf echad middevarav, vehem mereim al sheenam ovrim al kol hattora vehayu kechol haggoyim bet yisrael. vehu amro (Zecharya 1:15) "ani katzafti meat", perush: al asher avru al chelek mehattora katzafti meat, vehem haummot hameyasserim et yisrael adrabba ozrim beemtzaut hainnuy leraa laavor al hakkol, vechen hu shehaover al haddat potrim oto mikkol ra umetivin lo.

Vehu amro vegam et haggoy ani etdayyen immo, ki ani yodea machshevot adam vetachbulotav vetaam hainnuy, sheeno letzad kiyyum mitzvat Adonai sheggazar alehem ken. umimmotza davar atta yodea ki higdil oyev asot resha, kevan shemmeyasser letzad sinato, en sina kesinat haddat, ufashut hu ki yitachzer alehem behafelaga. uchefi ze yutzdak lomar vegam et vegomer, shehu hodaat ribbuy hatztzaar asher yaavor al banav, vesamuch laze katav veachare chen yetzu vegomer, perush kevan sheen datam lekayyem mitzvat Adonai yeshnam bahashavat haggezela bechol ma sheshshibedu otam. vetze ulemad mimmaase geviha (sanhedrin tze:) shettava mehammitzrim sechar kamma shanim sheshshibedu beyisrael.

Od yirmoz hakkatuv al derech amram zichronam livracha (Megila 29): galu lemitzrayim shechina immahem vechulei, uchetiv (Tehillim 91:15) "immo anochi vetzara". veod amru befasuk (Shemot 24:10) "vetachat raglav kemaase livnat hassappir" sheyyirmoz el shibud shennishtabedu yisrael ballevenim vechulei, vehu amro vegam et haggoy asher yaavodu bahem sham ittam immam dan anochi, sheyyirmoz el hashshechina shettihye immam baggalut, uvaze yeduyyak tevat vegam shehu tosefet tzaar, vetevat et vetevat anochi.

rashi: Vehu yoshev bisdom. mi garam lo zot? yeshivato visdom:
ohc: Vayyikchu vegomer ben achi avram vegomer. taam shehutzrach lomar "ben achi avram", gam taam amro vehu yoshev bisdom lelo tzorech, shekkevar yadanu ki sham kana mekomo, yechavven lomar shehammelachim yadu ki lot ze hu ben achi avram veaf al pi chen lakchu oto veholichuhu bashshivya, venatan hakkatuv hattaam shello chashshu lichvod avraham, vehu haya nichbad umeulle beene kol haolam ki leheyoto yoshev bisdom, vehu al derech amram zichronam livracha: moav tahar besichon, ad kan. hare shehagam sheppatar Adonai moav miyyad yisrael (Devarim 2:9) kevan shennimtzeu besichon huttar lahem. kemo chen lot hagam heyoto ben achiv shel ish shelomam af al pi chen kevan shennimtza bisdom huttar lahem. uvaze matzanu nachat ruach letaam avraham asher lo kara leshalom learbaa melachim lehashiv lot veim lo yashlimu az yakkem kaasher hikkam, ella hattaam hu leheyot sheyyadua haya lahem lot heyoto ben achi avraham, velaze ramaz hakkatuv beamro vayyishma vegomer ki nishba achiv, perush shennishba achar sheyyadua shehaya achiv shel avraham uvaze gillu ki oyve avraham hem, velaze radaf acharehem vayyakkem

Veim tomar: halo haddin hu im arbaa melachim shellekachuhu mittoch hair hammoredet bahem. veyesh lomar shemma sheanu omrim taharu besichon hu leumma sheen lanu immah lo shalom velo milchama, aval anshe shalom lo nadin lishbotam, vetze ulemad ma sheasu yisrael lakkeni shetztziuu alav (Shmuel 1 15:6) "suru redu mittoch amaleki" vegomer, uchemo chen haya lahem letzauot alav laavor mibbenehem im hem anshe shalom im avraham.

rashi: Veatta yisrael avdi, vealay yesh laazor lecha. sof hammikra al tira ki ittecha ani. kach nire li chibbur hainyan lefi peshuto. umidrash aggada bivreshit rabba (Bereshit Rabba 44 7) doresh kol hainyan bemalki tzedek veavraham:
Rau iyyim. otah milchama veyirau. shem nityare meavraham, pen yomar lo: heemadta reshaim ellu baolam, veavraham nityare mishshem, lefi sheharag et bene elam shehem mishshem:
Iyyim. keshem sheiyye hayyam mesuyyamin baolam, kach avraham veshem hayu mesuyyamin baolam:
Ish et reehu yaazoru. ze ozer et ze bivrachot "baruch avram" (Bereshit 14:19), veze ozer et ze bemattanot "vayyitten lo maaser mikkol" (Bereshit 14:20):
Vaychazzek charash. ze shem, shehaya nappach laasot masmerot uverichim latteva:
Et tzoref. ze avraham, shehu tzoref et habberiyyot lekarvan el hashshechina:
Et holem paam. ze avraham, shehalam kol hammelachim haelle paam achat:
Omer laddevek tov hu. tov liddavek beloah shel ze:
Vaychazzekehu. shem leavraham lihyot davek behakkadosh baruch hu, vlo yimmot:
Veatta yisrael avdi avraham, shello haya mizzera tzaddikim, asiti lo kol zot, veatta yisrael avdi, hakkanuy li mishshene avot:
Zera avraham ohavi. shello hikkirani mittoch tochacha velimmud avotav, ella mittoch ahava:
targum: Veat yisrael avdi yaakov deitreeti bach zare deavraham rechimi:

rashi: Yirafu. kemo yattifu:
targum: Bedateh tehome itbeziu ushemaya tzae mitalaya:

rashi: Hinnach hara. keshettashuvi tahari, kemo hinnach hara deeshet manoach:
Veyoladt ben. kemo veyoledet, vedome lo yoshavt ballevanon mekunnantey baarazim (yirmeya 22):
Vekarat shemo. tziuuy hu, kemo sheomer lezachar vekarata et shemo yitzchak (202 17):
Vayyarek. ketargumo vezariz, vechen vaharikoti acharechem charev (Vayikra 26) – ezdayyen becharbi alechem, vechen arik charbi (Shemot 15), vechen veharek chanit usegor (405 35):

Chanichav. chanacho ketiv (sefer acher kere), ze eliezer shechinnecho lemitzvot vehu leshon hatechalat kenisat haadam o cheli laummanut shehu atid laamod bah, vechen chanoch lannaar (Mishlei 22), chanukkat hammizbeach (46 7), chanukkat habbayit (405 30) 115 korin lo aynatzenayyr:
Shemona asar vegomer. rabbotenu amru eliezer levaddo haya (nedarim 32), vehu minyan gimatriyya shel shemo:
Ad dan. sham tashash kocho, sheraa sheatidin banav lehaamid sham egel (115 96):

Bore ketzot haaretz vegomer en cheker litvunato. umi sheyyesh lo koach kaze vechachma kazo, hu yodea et hammachashavot. lamma hu meacher tovatchem? ella kede lechallot et happesha ulehatem et hachattat al yede hayyissurin:
targum: Hala yedata im la shemata elaha alma Adonai di vera yesode ara la vaamal vela veleu let sof lesucheltanuteh:

rashi: Asher miggen. asher hisgir, vechen amaggencha yisrael (Hoshea 11):
Vayyitten lo. avraham maaser mikkol asher lo, lefi shehaya chohen:
ohc: Uvaruch el elyon. razal amru (nedarim lev:) shenneenash al asher icher birkat Adonai vehikdim birkat avraham, venittela mimmennu hakkehuna. veefshar shettaam shem hu shellakach seder hammaase, ki avraham hu meatzmo hikkir boro vehishtaddel beemunato yitbarach, veelav yeot habberacha, veachar kach berach laAdonai shennitratztza bo, vechen rauy laasot. ulelammed hu ba sheen hakkadosh baruch hu mitratztze ella bemi shemmitratztze bo kodem, vehu amro "baruch avram leel elyon" shehu hichshir atzmo lihyot eved leel elyon, velaze "baruch hu el elyon asher miggen" vegomer. vederech ze lo yutzdak ella bammevorach kodem. uchefi ze lo neenash shem ella hu meatzmo netanah leavraham uchemo shepperashti befasuk "vehu chohen". o efshar shenneenash al hannishma mishshitchiyyut hammaamar, shennire shello chash lehakedim eved lerabbo, hagam shennitkavven letova, umatzinu sheyyaanish Adonai al kayyotze baze bechamma mekomot.

rashi: Vayyavo happalit. lefi feshuto ze og, sheppalat min hammilchama, vehu shekkatuv ki rak og nishar miyyeter harfaim (206 3) vezehu nishar, shello haraguhu amrafel vachaverav keshehikku harfaim beashterot karnayim, tanchuma umidrash bera ze og, sheppalat middor hammabbul; vezehu miyyeter harfaim, shenneemar hannefilim hayu vaaretz vegomer (leel 6) umitkavven sheyyehareg avram veyissa et sara:
Haivri. shebba meever hannahar (Bereshit Rabba):
Baale verit avram. shekkartu immo berit:

ohc: Vegam et lot vegomer. hagam sheikkar redifato hayta alav veoto haya lo lehakedim, hodia hakkatuv seder hahatzlachot bederech "lo zo af zo": 1 heshiv harchush shel hammelachim, hatzelacha 2 sheheshiv lot velo serafuhu hammelachim birotam bammilchama im avraham linkama. vehodia hakkatuv shennatan dato lehashiv hannashim vehattaf letzad kavod sheasu lelot.

rashi: Umalki tzedek. mia hu shem ven noach (nedarim 32):
Lechem vayayin. kach osim ligie milchama, vehera lo sheen belibbo alav al sheharag et banav. vmia ramaz lo al hammenachot veal hannesachim sheyyakrivu sham banav:
ohc: Umalki tzedek vegomer. rabbotenu amru (nedarim lev:) ki hu shem. vetaam shehifsik beinyan melech shalem ben yetziat melech sedom lehodaat devarav el avraham vechulei, lehaggid shevach hatztzaddikim ma benam leven harshaim, ki melech sedom yatza likrat avraham lirot panav rekam, hagam sheelav yechuyyav lehakebil pene avraham bemincha keyad hammelech, vehu harasha yatza beyadayim rekaniyyot, veshem hatztzaddik mibbeli chiyyuv nedivut yaatz vehikbil panav belechem vayayin.

Od yirtze al derech amram zichronam livracha (yoma koach:) kiyyem avraham avinu afillu eruve tavshilin shehem tikkune rabbanan, velaze hodianu hakkatuv, ki avraham sar vegadol umechubbad beene hakkol haya, uchesheyyatza likrato melech sedom min hassetam yekabbel panav bitshurat lechem lo velaavadav veanshe milchamto, uletzad ki avraham yifrosh mimmaachalam, mehallechem mishshum pat shel goyim, vehayyayin mishshum setam yenam, laze nitchakkem venishtaddel melech sedom sheyyaase teshurat haachila al yad neeman shehu shem umiyyado shel shem leyado shel avraham. vechiddush hishmianu hakkatuv sheafillu lechem veyayin sheenan ella midderabbanan hikpid avraham, vechol shekken shear devarim sheyyesh bahem chashash issur tora.

Od yirtze hakkatuv lehodia taam asher mimmennu ala al daat melech sedom lomar leavraham "veharchush kach lach" velo shaal hakkol, laze amar vayyetze melech sedom likrato veachar tzeto yatza melech shalem vechulei, venatan lo avraham maaser mikkol. mizze hirgish melech sedom, ki hare ze maggid ki kinyanav hem, sheen adam measser mimma sheeno shello. laze shaal mimmennu hannefesh, veharchush askim ledatecha shettikkachem lecha, vehu amro kach lach, vahare ze maggid ki od haya lo taana lehachezik bakkol. uchede shello yikkanes immo bemachloket pishsher veamar: ten li hannefesh, veharchush lo ered immecha ledin ella hareni maskim shettikkachennu. veayyen taam haddavar beferush pasuk "ten li hannefesh"

Vehu chohen vegomer. perush: hu kohen, aval zaro eno kohen, shennittena kehunna leavraham, dichtiv (tehillim 110:4) "atta chohen leolam". veamro "al divrati malki tzedek", ki hu berach et avraham sheyyihye kohen leel elyon, uvirtzono natan haddavar leavraham kaasher avaer.

Veamro leel elyon, leheyot shehaya lahem elohot emtzaiyyim kayyadua lakkesilim, amar ki ze kohen leel elyon al kol haelohot shehayu lahem az. verabbotenu zichronam livracha amru (nedarim lev:) ki beavon shehikdim birkat avraham levirkat kono nittela mimmennu kehuna, uledivrehem zichronam livracha amro vehu chohen titparesh gam ken lemaet mishsham vahala, shemmiato hakkatuv al chattato haamur bainyan, vahagam shehikdim hammiut lachet, ma bechach, ki hattora nichteva achar kach.

rashi: Arbaa melachim vegomer. veaf al pi chen nitztzechu hammuatim, lehodiacha sheggibborim hayu, veaf al pi chen lo nimna avraham millirdof acharehem:
Emek shave. kach shemo, ketargumo lemeshar mefanna – panuy meilanot umikkol michshol:

Emek hammelech. bet resa demalka bet ris 1 shehu sheloshim kanim, shehaya meyuchad lammelech letzachek sham. umidrash aggada emek, shehushvu sham kol haummot vehimlichu et avraham alehem linsi elohim ulekatzin:
Im michut vead seroch naal. aakkev leatzmi min hashshevi:
Veim ekkach mikkol asher lach. veim tomar latet li sachar mibbet genazecha, lo ekkach:
Velo tomar vegomer. shehakkadosh baruch hu hivtichani leashshereni, shenneemar vaavarechcha vegomer:
ohc: Velo tomar ani vegomer. vekashe ech yutzdak lomar shehu heeshir vechulei, vahalo haadon Adonai tzevaot hu miggen tzarav?

Achen lefi ma shepperashnu bedivre melech sedom, ki choshev shehannechasim elav nogim, ella shemmitratztze latet lo harchush keamro "veharchush kach lach", laze amar shezze ose letzad dato, shehu choshev shehannechasim shello, shello yemalle fiv lomar "ani heesharti et avram harimoti vegomer im" vegomer. uvaze, lo tomar atta vegomer, uleolam kefi haddin nechasay hem asher natan li elohim, velaze natatti maaser mikkol, uchemo shehochachnu beferush (Bereshit 14:21) "ten li hannefesh" vegomer. uvaze yeduyyak amro velo tomar shehaya lo lomar "velo etashsher mishshellecha" vehaven.

rashi: Behareram. behar shellahem:

El paran. ketargumo mishor. veomer ani sheen el leshon mishor, ella mishor shel paran el shemo, veshel mamre elone shemo, veshel yarden kikkar shemo, veshel shittim avel shemo, avel hashshittim, vechen baal gad baal shemo; vechullam meturgamin mishor, vechol 1 shemo alav:
Al hammidbar. etzel hammidbar, kemo vealav matte menashshe (Bamidbar 2):
Veatta tavo. velo tire kol ele:
El avotecha. aviv oved aza vehu mevassero sheyyavo elav? limmedcha sheasa terach teshuva:
Tikkaver beseva tova. bissero sheyyaase yishmael teshuva beyamav, velo yetze esav letarbut raa beyamav; ulefichach met Adonai shanim kodem zemanno, uvo vayyom marad esav:
ohc: Veatta tavo vegomer. kashe lamma hifsik behavetachat avraham toch havetachot habbanim, vahagam shemmavticho shello yire bechayyav mehashshibud shel zaro, im kol ze lo hayta nifsedet hakkavvana im haya meacher, sheggam atta en hammaamar samuch lashshibud ella laggeulla. od tzarich ladaat lamma kafal lomar "beshalom" "beseva tova" velo hispik beamro "beseva tova" uvah kalul gam ken besorat teshuvat yishmael sheamru zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 38:12), velo yire shibud habbanim?

Achen kavvanat hakkatuv lefi ma shekkadam lanu, ki hatztzaddikim uvifrat haavot yakpidu al nikkuy sachar laolam hannitzchi. vetze ulemad (Bereshit Rabba 44,4) shemmatzinu lo shehaya metzer baharigat hammelachim shemma nitnakka lo missachar haelyon, ad sheamar lo Adonai (Bereshit 15:1) "al tira avram vegomer secharcha harebe". asher al ken keshehivticho sheyyetzu mehashshibud birchush gadol, yesh makom leavraham lachush velomar ki tzarich lenakkot missecharo laasot lo nissim veniflaot levanav ulehotziam birchush gadol. laze hivticho samuch laamirat "yetzu" vegomer veatta tavo el avotecha beshalom, shello yitnakke mishshalom asher hechezakta bemaoz, vechesed habbittachon mattat elohim hu. veze keneged havetachot hishshaarut hannefesh, ucheneged perate olam hazze amar tikkaver beseva tova. kan kalal shello yabbit mehashshibud levanav, gam sheyyaase yishmael teshuva kede sheyyikberuhu beseva tova bevanim tzaddikim, ki hu hamekuvve latztzaddikim ushear perate hattov vehashshalva. uvaze salka kushyat ramban yeuyyan sham devarav, ki lo baa hahavtacha al haggerut vechulei, vedivre ramban dechukim.

rashi: Kone shamayim vaaretz. kemo ose shamayim vaaretz (405 134); al yede asiyyatan kenaan lihyot shello:
ohc: Vayvarchehu vayyomar. tzarich ladaat im habberacha shebbercho hi hammuzkeret bainyan "baruch avram", im ken lo haya tzarich lomar "vayvarchehu", veroani meamro "baruch avram" shebbercho. od haya lo lomar "vayvarchehu lemor baruch" vegomer, al derech amro (Bereshit 48:20) "vayvarchem bayyom hahu lemor" vegomer.

Achen hakkavvana hi: mittechilla berach avraham, perush beracha hannogaat lo shello yippol beyad oyvav veyishar cheleh, shehem berachot haggufaniyyot. veachar kach amar inyan acher, letzad illaa yemallel, "baruch avram", uvirchato tihye leel elyon shehu yaavod hael, veshebbeemtzauto yihye hael kone shamayim vaaretz. vechach haya, shebbeemtzaut avraham natan hashshem chayye olam levanav venitkayyemu shamayim vaaretz, ucheamram zichronam livracha (avoda zara 3.) shettenay hitna hakkadosh baruch hu im maase vereshit vechulei, ucheamram (shabbat pach.) befasuk (tehillim 76:9) "eretz yara" vegomer. hare ki lule avraham en laAdonai kinyan shamayim vaaretz, vehaven.

Od yirtze al ze hadderech vayvarchehu vegomer, lehaggid ba ki shete berachot haamurot bidvarav hem berachot hannogim leavraham, vaafillu beracha sheamar "baruch el elyon asher miggen" hi birkat avraham, keshemmitbarech Adonai beemtzauto asher miggen vegomer, uleolam lo berech ella berachot haamurim bainyan.

rashi: En mishpat hi kadesh. al shem heatid, sheatidin moshe veaharon lehishshafet sham al iske oto haayin vehem me meriva. veunkelos tirgemo chifshuto makom shehayu vene hammedina mitkabbetzim sham lechol mishpat:
Sede haamaleki. adayin lo nolad amalek, venikra al shem heatid:
Bechatztzon tamar. hiv en gedi, mikra male bedivre hayyamim (2 20) bihoshafat:
Vayyavo el hagar vattahar. mibbia rishona (Bereshit Rabba):

Vattekal gevirtah beeneha. amra saray zo en sitrah kigluyah mara atzmah keillu hi tzaddeket veenah tzaddeket, shello zachta leherayon kol hashshanim hallalu, vaani nitabbarti mibbia rishona (Bereshit Rabba):
Hen li lo natatta zara. uma toelet bechol asher titten li?
ohc: Vayyomer avram hen li vegomer. kashe: 1 ech yuchal lomar lo natatta vegomer, vahalo kevar hivticho veamar lo (Bereshit 13:16) "vesamti zaracha kaafar haaretz", uma lo lefakpek chas veshalom bedivre Adonai. 2 amro "hen li", haya lo lomar "hen lo natatta li". 3 tzarich ladaat hakkavvana beamro vehinne ven beti yoresh, achar sheen lo zera, ma li im yoresh oto ben beto o acher?

Achen kavvanat hakkatuv hi al ze hadderech, shelleheyot shebbesorat hazzera sheamar lo Adonai amar kaafar haaretz, vedavar yadua ki hannimshalim laafar haaretz hem bene adam habbezuyim vehappechutim sheen bahem nefesh kedosha, al derech amro (Kohelet 3:21) "ruach habbehema hayyoredet hi lematta laaretz", vehem hannikraim amme haaretz, uvene adam kaellu lo yitmalle retzon hatztzaddikim bahem, laze amar avraham hen li vegomer, perush davar hashshave li lo natatta zara. velaze heshivo Adonai veamar lo sefor hakkochavim ko yihye zarecha, vehem hatztzaddikim hammeshulim lakkochavim, dichtiv (Daniel 12:3) "umatzdike harabbim kakkochavim", uvaze nacha dato. veal yikshe lecha leferush ze mimmaamar rabbotenu zichronam livracha sheddarshu bappasuk "vehaya zaracha kaafar haaretz" sheamar Adonai leyaakov, veze leshonam (Bereshit Rabba parasha 69), "kaafar" vegomer, ma afar eno mitbarech ella bemayim kach banecha vechulei, ma afar mechalle kele mattachot vechulei, ad kan, hare dehamshalat heafar leshevach. hinne lo darshu zichronam livracha bederech ze lashshevach shebbeafar ella achar shemmatzinu shehimshilam Adonai lakkochavim ha lamadta shello himshilam leafar achare chen ella leshevach shebbeafar, lo livchinat happechitut, velaze timtza shello darshu chen befasuk rishon hanneemar leavraham ella bappasuk hanneemar leyaakov achar shehuvtach avraham kakkochavim, velaze daag avraham al hammashal rishon kaafar haaretz. uvaze nityashshevu shene haddikdukim, lamma lo huvtach avraham behavetacha rishona, gam dikduk amro hen li.

Veamro vehinne ven beti yoresh oti, titparesh bishne derachim: ha sheim lo yitten lo ella keafar, yoter yivchar leven beto lirash oto, leheyoto talmido hechaviv lo, mimma sheyyirashennu ben sheeno hagun, umatzinu sheasu kayyotze baze anshe maase mibbene yisrael hemma.

Vehav al ze hadderech, ki millevad shehaya mitztaer al hazzera, gam haya mitztaer al divrat habben bayit shehaya omer ki hu hayyoresh, veze hu shiur hakkatuv. vehinne, perush lefi shaa hu omer yoresh oti, veech yitav beyom tova levavo beshamo et haddevarim mibben beto. umatzati lerazal (Bereshit Rabba 124) sheamru meen ze sheppershu shebbikkesh avraham lalechet ariri velo yihyu lo banim sheenam mehugganim.

rashi: Unemaltem. kemo umaltem, vehannun bo yetera lisod hannofel bo lifrakim, kegon 50 shel noshech 56 shel nose, unemaltem, kemo unesatem; aval yimmol leshon yippael, kemo yease, yeachel:
Lo yishmael yichye. halevay sheyyichye yishmael; eni cheday lekabbel mattan sachar kaze:
Yichye lefanecha. yichye veyiratecha, kemo hithallech lefanay – pelach kodamay:
ohc: Vayyomer avraham vegomer lu yishmael vegomer. yechavven bitfilla zo sheyyihye yishmael holech betzedek lifne Adonai, veze hu yichye lefanecha shehatztzaddikim keruyim chayyim. veamro lefanecha al derech amro "veattem haddevekim baAdonai" vegomer (Devarim 4:11), vehutzrach litfilla lefi sheraa bo simanim lo tovim, sheal kol panim lo tihye rishat harasha neelemet meene hatztzaddik uma gam beno, laze hitpallel alav sheyyihye tzaddik, vegilla dato ki hu ze mevukkasho uchemo shepperashti befasuk (Bereshit 15:3) "hen li". vehivticho Adonai sheyyihye zaro kakkochavim veshoel shettitkayyem havetacha zo beyishmael.
Vayyelech avram vegomer. kol hakkatuv meyuttar, shehare omer besamuch beseder hodaat hahalicha (Bereshit 12:5) "vayyikkach avram vegomer vayyetzu lalechet" vegomer.

Achen kavvanat hakkatuv hu lehodia chibbato shel avraham, shello nitakkev afillu shaa achat, ella bigmar divre Adonai "lech lecha" techef "vayyelech avram", velo nitakkev leshum sibba veazav et aviv umoladto. veshiur tevat 100 "kaasher", hodaat hazzeman shehaya samuch lidvar Adonai elav. vehodia hakkatuv ki lot letzad devekuto beavraham halach itto, perush: lo letzad kiyyum maamar Adonai ella raahu holech vehalach immo. vechavvanato behodaa zo ki hagam shennitchakkem avraham lachpoz lalechet leval yitchabberu immo mimmoladto umibbet aviv, af al pi chen lo hoil beerech perat ze, vehalach itto lot.

Od yirtze, leheyot sheamar lo Adonai havetachot toaliyyot harebe kesheyyelech lo meartzo vechulei, im ken hagam sheyyelech yisbor haroe ki en lehachezik lo tova al ze, sheafillu kal shebbakkallim kesheyyire kol hattoaliyyot yemaher lissa. laze hodia hakkatuv tzidkuto shel avraham, ki ma shehalach lo letzad havetachot haamurot ella laasot devar Adonai. vedikdek lomar kaasher dibber velo "kaasher amar" kemo shehitchil bitchillat happarasha "vayyomer Adonai" leammet kidvarenu. vehu, yesh lecha ladaat ki chol makom sheyyomar hakkatuv dibbur yaggid al davar kashe, vehaamira hi rakka. vechan hizkir bitchillat happarasha "vayyomer Adonai" letzad shekkol haddavar hu lahanaat avraham, uvemaase avraham amar "kaasher dibber", perush sheasa haddavar letzad gezerat melech alav velo lattoelet hannimshach lo.

Od yirtze lehodia ki avraham halach kaasher dibber elav Adonai besamuch, uma neemar bedivre Adonai? "el haaretz asher arekka", shello hodio makom asher yavo shamma, veaf al pi chen halach meartzo vesamach al ma sheyyodiehu Adonai kesheyyirtze, mibbeli chashov lomar, ech etze mehair kodem shenneda hammakom? veze nissayon gadol. veachar kach hodia hakkatuv hotzaat et asher immo, shello nissa Adonai otam bedavar ze ella hodia hammakom veachar kach yatzu, vehu amro bappasuk sheachare ze vayyikkach avram vegomer vayyetzu lalechet artza kenaan, velo hutzrach hakkatuv lehodia ki Adonai hodio hammakom ki hu muvan meatzmo.

rashi: Velo nasa otam. lo hayta yechola lehasepik mire lemiknehem, velashon katzar hu, vetzarich lehosif alav, kemo velo nasa otam mire haaretz, lefichach katav velo nasa bilshon zachar:
Yelid bayit. sheyyeladattu hashshifcha babbayit:
Miknat kesef. shekkenao mishshennolad:
Egla meshulleshet. shelosha agalim; remez lishlosha farim, par yom hakkippurim ufar helem davar shel tzibbur veegla arufa:
Veez meshulleshet. remez lesair hannaase bifnim useire musafin shel moed useir chattat yachid:
Veayil meshullash. asham vadday veasham taluy vechivsa shel chattat yachid:
Vetor vegozal. tor uven yona (Bereshit Rabba):
Mehonecha. mikkol ma shechanancha, afillu mikkol arev. (al tikri mehonecha ella miggeronecha):
Umereshit. ellu terumot umaasrot:
targum: Yaker lelahach min mamonach umeresh kulhon alaltach:

rashi: Holech ariri. menachem ben saruk persho leshon yoresh, vechaver lo er veone (Malachi 2), ariri, velo yoresh, kaasher tomar uvechol tevuati tesharesh (Iyov 31), teakker sharasheha, kach leshon ariri chasar banim, 115 dayshaanapenateysh. veli nire er veone miggizrat velibbi er (Shir HaShirim 5), vaariri leshon churban, vechen aru aru (405 137), vechen arot yesod (Chavakuk 3), vechen arer titarar (250 nusach acher), vechen ki arza era (Tzefanya 2):
Uven meshek beti. ketargumo, shekkol beti nizzon al piv, kemo veal picha yishshak (202 Melachim 1), appotroppos shelli, veillu haya li ven, haya veni memunne al shelli:
Dammesek. lefi hattargum middammesek haya, ulefi mia sheradaf hammelachim ad dammesek. uvattalmud darshu notarikon dole umashke mittorat rabbo laacherim:
Vayyaavor avram baaretz. nichnas letochah:
Ad mekom shechem. lehitpallel al bene yaakov, kesheyyavou lehillachem bishchem:
Elon more. hu shechem. herahu har gerizim vehar eval, sheshsham kibbelu yisrael shevuat hattora:

Vehakkenaani az baaretz. haya holech vechovesh et eretz yisrael mizzaro shel shem, shebbechelko shel shem nafla keshechalak noach et haaretz levanav, shenneemar umalki tzedek melech shalem (203 12), lefichach vayyomer Adonai el avram lezaracha etten et haaretz hazzot, atid ani lehachazirah levanecha shehem mizzaro shel shem:
ohc: Vayyaavor avram vegomer. modia hakkatuv ki haya avraham over baaretz mimmakom lemakom, veen omer elav davar mibbene haaretz. vahagam shebbaale haaretz shehem kenaan hayu az baaretz asher avar avraham shamma, lo patza piv vetziftzef.

Od yirmoz ki avraham haya over velo haya machzik atzmo bachashivut ella ivri, al derech amro (Bereshit 14:13) "avram haivri". vetaam amro vehakkenaani vegomer, velo hispik bema sheamar bappasuk shellifne ze "artza kenaan", kan hodia zeman shennichnesa lirshut hakkenaani, uma shekkadam veamar "artza kenaan", en reaya, ki keraah chen al shem heatid.

O efshar sheramaz beshem kenaan al derech ma sheddarshu zichronam livracha (yalkut) befarashat shelach lecha vegomer, "eretz kenaan" – sheramaz el yisrael shebbau meavraham ben mea shana vesara bat tishim shana, harmuzim becheshbon tevat kenaan. laze hutzrach lehodia vehakkenaani az baaretz.

Od yirtze behodaat vehakkenaani lomar petach hazzechiyya baaretz, ki hakkenaani haya az baaretz shehu eved, dichtiv (Bereshit 9:25) "eved avadim yihye leechav", en lo kinyan, vechol hattofes bekinyanav mibbene shem o yefet yizke vahem uveadmatam. uva hakkadosh baruch hu vezikka haddavar leavraham. vezulat ze im lo haya hakkenaani az baaretz ella mibbene yefet, lo haya makom lehotziam miyyadam achar shezzachu vah. verabbotenu zichronam livracha amru (torat kohanim parashat kedoshim) ki shel bene shem hayta, veavraham mibbene shem zacha kodem bah. uledarkam hodia Adonai ki lo zacha leheyoto kenaani, yad eved keyad rabbo.

Od yirtze, leheyot sheratza lomar Adonai el avram "lezaracha etten et haaretz", vead atta yodea hayiti ki haaretz shel shem hayta veavraham mibbene vanav hu, veen yadua ki shel kenaan hayta az, veyomar haomer ma noten lo Adonai davar asher shello hu meaz umikkodem. vahagam shetztziyyenah mikkodem lichnaan, kevar perashti sheen reaya mizze. asher al ken hodia Adonai vehakkenaani az baaretz, velaze hutzrach Adonai lehaveticho sheyyittenenna lezaro.

rashi: Behimmolo. behippaalo, kemo behibbaram (Bereshit 2):
Meal avraham. leshon nekiyya hu kelappe shechina, velamadnu shehatztzaddikim merkavto shel makom (Bereshit Rabba):
Atta el roi. nakud chataf kamatz, mippene shehu shem davar, eloah hariyya, sheroe veelbon shel aluvin:

Hagam halom. leshon tema; vechi sevura hayiti sheaf halom bammidbarot raiti shelucho shel makom achare roi otam beveto shel avraham sheshsham hayiti regila lirot malachim? veteda shehayta regila lirotam, shehare manoach raa et hammalach paam achat veamar mot namut (386 13), vezo raata 4 ze achar ze velo charda:
Kach valech. lo chaavimelech sheamar lo hinne artzi lefanecha, ella amar lo lech veal taamod, shehammitzrim shetufe zimma hem, shenneemar vezirmat susim zirmatam: (Yechezkel 23):
Veyiafu nearim. gevurat hakkasdim hamenoarim min hammitzvot tiaf:
Uvachurim kashol yikkashelu. otam shehem achshav gibborim vachazakim, yikkashlu, veattem kove Adonai tachalifu koach chadash vechazak:
targum: Veyishtalhun ulemin chayavin veyilun urevake rashiaya ittekala yitkelun:

ohc: (18-19) Vayyikra faro vegomer lamma vegomer, lama vegomer. kashe lamma kafal hakkushya shete peamim beofen meshunne? veulay sheyyechavven lomar shete haderagot bitmihato al ze hadderech: haachat, min harauy haya lecha lachush li shemma lo neda ki hi ishtecha veekkachenna, veod shehosafta laasot bema sheamarta beferush "achoti hi".

Od yitbaer al derech amram zichronam livracha (Rashi) ki taam paro sheamar lo "hinne ishtecha kach valech", vaavimelech amar elav "hinne artzi lefanecha" vegomer, ki paro leheyot anashav keurim ushetufe zimma chash al haddavar sheyyikkashlu bo veyeanshu, ma sheen ken avimelech shello hayu keurim vechulei. velaze timtza sheavimelech amar elav "ma raita ki asita" vegomer, ma sheen ken paro ki yodea tamo shel avraham ki yare pen yamut aleha. umeatta yitbaer hakkatuv al nachon, leheyot sheyyada paro hattaam lo yutzdak lomar lo "lama amarta achoti hi", ki im sheela rishona "lamma lo higgadta li" beyichud ki hi ishtecha. uvaze, hagam shettomar "achoti hi" tihye lecha shemira mehaam velo hayita gorem li raa lehikkashel bah, ki paro haya machzik atzmo vadday shello yaase davar megunne beyado ki hi ishto velo yachshedennu avraham. vehahaggada hayta moelet leavraham leechad mishshene derachim: o yetzav alav paro anashim leshamro kaasher asa achar kach bizman muat, o haya memaher leshallecho. vehosif lomar lama amarta vegomer, perush: veim tomar vechi chovat gavra hiv shekkol ish asher yavi et ishto yelech veyaggid lefaro ki ishto zot? laze amar "lama amarta" vegomer, umehattaam atzmo sheamarta "achoti hi" letzad maalat yafyah, laze alecha bifrat muttal lehodia.

O yomar al ze hadderech: lama amarta vegomer, vechevan sheamarta haya lecha lachush li lekachtah leishsha. hen emet im lo hayita omer, ani hayiti choshesh lah meeshet ish, aval kevan sheamarta "achoti" haya lecha lachush li sheekkachenna leishsha vetaggid li besod. velo heshiv avraham davar kemo sheheshiv laavimelech, ki avraham tamo haya shehaya choshed lefaro atzmo veen rauy lehashiv al ze. veulay ki laze chash paro umiher leshallecho meartzo, vezulat ze yetzav alav bitmidut anashim.

rashi: Ucheav et ben yirtze. sherotze bivno lehetiv lo vifayyesehu leachar shemmakkehu bashshevet, ken yeerav lecha hattova achar hammakka:
targum: Metul dilman derachem leh elaha radeh leh vehech abba derade livreh:

rashi: Behimmolo et besar orlato. beavraham lo neemar "et", lefi shello haya chaser ella chittuch basar, shekkevar nitmaech al yede tashmish; aval yishmael shehaya yeled, huzkak lachtoch arla velifroa hammila, lechach neemar bo "et" (Bereshit Rabba):

Chamasi alecha. chamas heasuy li, alecha ani metil haonesh; keshehitpallalta lehakkabba ma titten li veanochi holech ariri, lo hitpallalta ella alecha, vehaya lecha lehitpallel al shenenu, vehayiti ani nifkedet immecha, veod devarecha atta chomes mimmeni, sheatta shomea bizyoni veshotek (Bereshit Rabba):

Anochi natatti shifchati vegomer beni uvenecha. kol benecha shebbammikra chaser, veze male, keri veh uvanayich, shehichnisa ayin hara beibburah shel hagar vehippila ubbarah; hu shehammalach omer lehagar hinnach hara, vehalo chevar harta, vehu mevashsher lah shettahar? ella melammed shehippila herayon harishon:
ohc: Vattomer saray vegomer chamasi vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma masra din sara al avraham, vehosifa lefaret velomar "chamasi alecha", shennire shennitkavvena lemaet hazzulat. veim al hagar nitkavvena, en bidvareha nechona lefi hannire, ki hagar hi shehekella bichvod gevirtah vealeha telunnatah, lo al avraham. od tzarich ladaat kavvanat divre avraham asher heshiv hinne shifchatech vegomer, shennire shekkibbel kevilat saray, ella shehu metakken mikkan ulehabba, veim lo paal aven haya lomar "ma tariv elay"?

Achen yitbaer hainyan behakedim divrehem zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 45:1), veze leshonam: "velah shifcha mitzrit" – shifchat melog hayta, vehaya chayyav bimzonoteha velo haya rashshay lemachrah. bae resh lakish: mahu detanya melog? amar lehon: kema deat amar melog melog, ad kan. hare dehagar hayta gufah kenuya lesara uferoteha leavraham lemalgam. uveinyan bene shifchat melog im yalda, nechleku bemassechet ketubbot daf 79 chananya vachachamim. chachamim omrim: velad melog laishsha, vehattaam mishshum dechayshinan lemita vehakkeren kale. vachananya sover labbaal delo chayshinan lemita. od amrinan begittin daf 39, amar rav ashe amar rav: "eved shennasa bat chorin bifne rabbo asao ben chorin", umefaresh lah hashshas beshehissio rabbo bat chorin ad kan. umefarshim sham mishshum shemmin hassetam shichrereh, deim lo chen lo haya ose al yado avera lehassio bat chorin, ad kan. vehu haddin shifcha shehissiah rabbah leven chorin asaah bat chorin. vechatav morenu harav yosef karo beyore dea hilchot avadim siman 267 veze leshono: habba al shifchato asaah bat chorin, vedavka leshem ishut, aval shello leshem ishut lo asaah bat chorin, ad kan. vehinne beva aleha setam nechleku harif veharambam, leharif (yevamot 82) min hassetam gam ken asaah bat chorin, uleharambam (hilchot avadim 89) lo asaah bat chorin ella im ken peresh leshem ishut.

Uvaze navo leveur hainyan, ki birot sara ki hagar mezalzelet bichvodah ragza veraasha, hayittachen ki shifcha takel gevirtah, umin hassetam avraham hirgish baddavar mimma shemmitraemet sara alav kodem hodaat haddavar elav, vahagam sheamra achare chen en ze derech hodaa ella divre hitraamut, vehayyedia kevar hikkira sheyyada, vedana baze shene chilluke dinim: ha sheavraham gilla beferush shebba aleha leshem ishut o hagam shebba aleha setam choshevet hagar shehi bat chorin vedatah keharif. vehav hu shechashva bedatah hagar sheyyatzta lecherut middin sheamru begittin shekkatavnu besamuch: eved shennasa bat chorin bifne rabbo yatza lecherut, vechen lehefech shifcha shennisset leven chorin asaatta gevirtah bat chorin uvaze paka avdut mehagar. velaze tzaaka bifne avraham ki alav telunatah velo al hagar, ki hagar kefi haddin shechoshevet bedatah en lehaashimah, aval chamasi alecha sheatta maskim al datah shello kefi haddin.

Veamra teanot listor velintosh tzidde haddinim shemmehem yatza hattaut lecherut hagar, vehu amrah anochi natatti shifchati bechekecha perush shifcha zo shelli hi veen lecha bah ella meligat perot, velu yihye shettavo aleha beferush leshem ishut, en lah baze din shichrur ki enah shifchatcha leshachrerah vahagam shettomar ken beferush. veim letzad taanat hammassi shifchato leven chorin vechulei vezo netattiha lecha leishsha sheatta ben chorin, davka im netattiha setam, uchemo shennatnu hattaam shemmin hassetam lo yaavor al lav delo tihye kedesha velo yihye kadesh" shehu azhara leven chorin vechulei, aval anochi lo hinnachti haddavar setam ella perashti lecha haddevarim beferush shello shichrartiha ella odenna shifchati hagam shehi bechekecha. uchemo chen timtza bidvareha harishonim elav sheamra lo "bo na el shifchati" perush achar sheyyavo aleha odenna shifchatah, shehaya lah lomar "bo na el hagar".

Shuv matzati midrash rabbotenu zichronam livracha berabbot (Bereshit Rabba 45:3), veze leshonam: "vattitten otah leavram ishah" velo leacher, ad kan. hinne rabbotenu zichronam livracha dikdeku tevat "ishah" shello haya tzarich leamrah, veyishshevu shellemaet ba, vetzarich ladaat miut ze lamma hutzrach. ulefi devarenu tzarich haddavar leamer lomar sheadayin hi shifchatah velo netanatah ella leavraham. veim yirtze avraham letittah leacher o leshallechah leatzmah laasot kattov beeneha en lo reshut, ha lamadta sheodenna shifchatah.

Veavraham hoda lidvareha shehaddin immah betaanatah, veyesh baze shene derachim. haechad, efshar sheavraham kemo chen haya dato mittechilla vead sof, vaafillu hache ba aleha letaam asher avaer. o lo chashav ken mittechilla vedato hayta ki leshem ishut baal umeshuchreret hi, ki lo chashav shennitkavvena sara lema sheggilleta datah atta, veillu chashav ken efshar shello haya ba aleha middin (Devarim 23:18) "lo yihye kadesh", vechen timtza shebbemeshech 14 shana mishshennolad yishmael ad shennolad yitzchak lo yasaf od ledatah.

Vetaam sara shello hikpida latet shifcha leven chorin, vegam avraham lema shenneemar shehevin divre sara velo chash al atzmo, da ki lefi happeshat nuchal lomar sheadayin lo nitztauu al ze. vahagam shehayu medakdekim lekayyem afillu dikduke mitzvot shel chachamim, letzad hannevua hayu ovrim al hammitzvot lefi shaa. uchevar katav rambam besefer hammadda beferek 9 mehilchot yesode hattora ki im yavo navi bemaamaro yitbarach sheyyaavru yisrael vaafillu rabbim al avera achat lefi shaa ki muttar laasot ken, ucheeliyyahu behar hakkarmel (Melachim 1 18), uchemo chen asa avraham al pi sara ki nevia hayta yoter meavraham kemaamaram zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 1) befasuk "kol asher tomar elecha sara shema bekolah", velaze kesheamra lo "bo na el shifchati" hiskim ledivre hannevia. vetzorech haya baddavar lihyot ken, ki beemtzaut heyotah shifchatah nitbarer bah chelek hammaus shehaya davuk beavraham mime kedem veyatza hazzohama beyishmael venishar or shalem venachon beyitzchak, veillu hayta hagar meshuchreret lo haya yotze kol hazzihum levad mibbeli sheyyetze immo chelek hattov, ufirtza gedola hayta mesubbevet mehaddavar, vaAdonai yitbarach asa nifleotav elenu. veulay ki laze nitkavvena sara beamrah yishpot hashshofet beni uvenecha, ki chashsha sheyyomar avraham veech taskim alav lihyot kadesh, laze amra, hu hashshofet yishpot beno uvenah vechulei.

Vetechef hoda lidvareha aleha hashshalom. uchesheyyada sara ki en setira letaanoteha veodenna shifchatah vatteanneha saray .vattivrach vegomer, perush ki hagar lo kibbela haddin, vechashva sheavru aleha et hadderech vedin bat chorin yesh lah, letzad sheggevirtah natna otah leven chorin, haadam haggadol avraham avinu alav hashshalom, vadday yatzta lecherut, vehi lo shama hattenay shehitnet sara, laze barcha lah, vayyifgeu bah bene haelohim vehodiuha ki hi shifchat saray, vattekabbel aleha et haddin vattomer mippene saray gevirti vegomer:

Veyesh ladun beyishmael im yesh lanu eze kinyan bo o lo. tanya betorat kohanim parashat behar sinay veze leshono: minnayin atta omer yisrael shebba al shifchato veyalda mimmennu ben muttar atta leshabedo eved? talmud lomar "asher yihyu lecha meet haggoyim asher sevivotechem" velo min hakkenaanim shebbaaretz, ad kan leshono. perush: shello haya tzarich lomar "asher yihyu lecha", vegam mashmaut tevat "yihyu lecha" dechuka, shehaya lo lomar "asher tikne". umizze doresh "asher yihyu lecha" – perush: tolid atta meet haggoyim, dehaynu yisrael shebba al shifchato. veamram velo min hakkenaani vechulei – perush ki ze yesh bo din (Devarim 20:16) "lo techayye kol neshama". umeatta yatza haddin ki yishmael vezaro kenuyim lanu kinyan gamur, lo mibbaya lisvarat rabbanan shebben shifchat melog laishsha veanu yorshe sara, ella afillu lisvarat chananya hare natan avraham et kol asher lo leyitzchak, veyishmael bichlal, velanu hu im haammim asher karat Adonai berit latet lanu, umikkelalam hu edom hu vechelko beyishmael.

Vehaed hanneeman lidvarenu hu ma sheamar habbore yitalle (Bereshit 21:13) "vegam et ben haama", hare shekkeraah ama ukerao benah velo beno. ki timtza bivne hashshefachot bilha vezilpa dikdek hakkatuv lomar bahem "vatteled leyaakov ben" (Bereshit 30:5), vechen amar bashsheni "ben sheni leyaakov", vechen bashshelishi amar "vatteled zilpa shifchat lea leyaakov ben", vechen barvii amar "ben sheni leyaakov". hare shebbechullan dikdek lechannotam beshem bene yaakov ki nishtachreru, vechan amar Adonai lehefech "ben haama", veamar lo od "ki veyitzchak yikkare lecha zara" (Bereshit 21:12).
Veen ze bichlal asara amamin asher amar Adonai otam etten lachem, ki ze zachinu vo mishshellanu veen tzorech netina bo.

rashi: Vayyippol avram al panav. mimmora hashshechina; shead shello mal lo haya vo choach laamod veruch hakkodesh nitztzevet alav, vezehu shenneemar bevilam nofel ugeluy enayim, bivrayta derabbi eliezer:
Uvearba esre shana. lemirdan:
Ba chedorlaomer. lefi shehu haya vaal hammaase nichnas beovi hakkora:
Vehammelachim. elle shelosha melachim:
Hazzuzim. hem zamzummim:
Mi faal veasa. lo et zot? mi shehu kore haddorot merosh leadam harishon, hu asa leavraham gam et zot:
Ani Adonai rishon. lehafeli pele velaazor:
Veet acharonim ani hu. af immachem, banim acharonim, ehye vaaazor etchem:
targum: Man amar ilen kayam amar vaavid vesidar daraya milkadmin ana Adonai baret alma mibbereshit af alme almaya dili inun bar mini let elaha:

rashi: Raav baaretz. beotah haaretz levaddah, lenassoto, im yeharher achar devarav shel hakkabba sheamar lalechet el eretz kenaan, veachshav massio latzet mimmenna:
Ten li hannefesh. min hashshevi shelli shehitztzalta, hachazer li haggufim levaddam:
ohc: Ten li hannefesh veharchush vegomer. tzarich ladaat leeze inyan hu omer lo veharchush kach lach, halo lakuach hu etzlo, velo haya lo lomar ella davar shehu shoel mimmennu sheyyitten lo betorat mattana, ki meamro "kach lach" maggid ki tzarich hu lehasekim sheyyikkachennu, veze menagged leamro "ten li hannefesh"?

Achen yitbaer hainyan al derech ma sheamru zichronam livracha beferek haggozel umaachil (102 116), veze leshonam: tanu rabbanan, shayyara shehayta mehallechet veamad aleha gayis uterafah, veamad echad vehitztzil – hitztzil laemtza, veim amar "ani matztzil leatzmi" – hitztzil leatzmo. umefaresh rav ashe kesheyyecholin lehatztzil bene hashshayyara al yede haddechak, laze im hitztzil setam – laemtza, perush: kol echad yakkir et shello veyittelennu, uchemo shepperesh Rashi. veim amar "leatzmi ani matztzil" veshamu bene hashshayyara veshatku, gillu datam deiyyaush velo masru atzman, uleatzmo hitztzil, ad kan. vesavar melech sedom shehu lo nityaesh veodennu omed lehatztzil veyiskor geyasot alav, ucheshehalach avraham lehatztzil, hagam sheyyomar sheggilla dato shelleatzmo matztzil – eno moil, vetzarich sheyyishma melech sedom devarav veyaskim, vezulat ze laemtza hitztzil velo yittol ella ma shehu shello, shehu lot urechusho. vetimtza shemmelech sedom haya machzik atzmo bemadrega gedola, shekken amru bammidrash veze leshonam (Bereshit Rabba 123): "vayyetze melech sedom" vegomer, hitchil mechashkesh biznavo, atta yaradta lechivshan haesh venitztzalta vaani yaradti lachemar venitztzalti, ad kan. hare shehechzik atzmo bevaal hayyecholet.

Uvaze yitbaer hakkatuv ten li hannefesh vegomer, perush: ani kefi sevarati laemtza hitztzalta, ki lo nityaashti velo hodatani sheatta matztzil leatzmecha veshatakti, ella lefi sevaratcha sheatta noten maaser nire sheatta sover sheen metziut li lehatztzil afillu al yede haddechak, uvaze encha tzarich legallot datecha. laze, kede shello nikkanes bemachloket naskima yachad lefashsher: atta tevattel zechutecha vetachlit li hannefesh, vaani avattel zechuti veachlit lecha harchush kachennu lach, vehaven. vehu happachut toe haya, ki meshullal hu mehatztzala, velo chalak rav ashe ella begayis shettaraf vehalach lo, aval bammetziut shellefanenu kevar heerichu milchama veavdu veen lecha "enan yecholin lehatztzil" baze, shekkevar batlu bemiutan venityaashu vadday, uvetaanat sheker hu ba bechishkush zenavo. vetimtza shello hitzrich rav ashe sheyyomar beferush "leatzmi ani matztzil" ella davka beyachol lehatztzil al yede haddechak, aval im eno yachol lehatztzil eno tzarich lomar "leatzmi" vechulei, vechen hu mevoar sham. veim ken hagam sheyyomar achar kach "yachol hayiti lehatztzil" en taanato taana, vechen pasku rambam (hilchot gezela veavda perek 12) veharosh.

Vetimtza sheramzu inyan [ze] razal bemetek leshonam beamram "mechashkesh biznavo", perush: sheachar sheroe atzmo shennittal rosho, adayin hu mechashkesh biznavo, ki bihyoto bechol tokef malchuto vearbaa melachim asher itto lo amdu bifne haarbaa melachim, umikkol shekken achar horadat edyo hayachol yuchal lehatztzil. ha lamadta sheavraham hitztzil leatzmo vekana hakkol, velaze natan maaser mikkol, shehagam sheyyevatter lemelech sedom, adam rashshay beshello, lo bemaaser shehu shel gavoah.

rashi: Unetatticha legoyim. yisrael veedom, shehare yishmael kevar haya lo, velo haya mevassero alav:

Vedor revii. leachar sheyyiglu lemitzrayim yihyu sham 3 dorot, veharvii yashuvu laaretz hazzot, lefi shebbeeretz kenaan haya medabber immo, vecharat berit zo, kedichtiv: latet lecha et haaretz hazzot lerishtah. vechen haya: yaakov yarad lemitzrayim, tze vachashov dorotav: yehuda, peretz, vechetzron, vechalev ben chetzron mibbae haaretz haya:
Ki lo shalem avon haemori. lihyot mishtalleach meartzo ad oto zeman, sheen hakkabba nifra meumma ad shettitmalle seatah, shenneemar besassea beshalchah terivenna (310 27):
