ohc: Vedor revii vegomer ki lo shalem. tzarich latet lev betaam ze. vehinne Rashi veramban nechleku beferush dor revii, Rashi zichrono livracha peresh revii laggolim: yehuda, peretz, chetzron, vechalev ben chetzron haya mibbae haaretz. veramban zichrono livracha dacha divre Rashi uferesh dor revii laemori ki Adonai poked avon avot al shilleshim veal ribbeim (Shemot 34:7). vekashe li gam ledivre ramban ki leeze inyan modia Adonai davar ze leavraham. vegam eno ramuz hattenay bedivre Adonai sheim yashuvu haemori lo yacharimem shehu ikkar hodaat dor revii lidvarav. veod im dor revii deemori hu, lo haya tzarich lachzor lehazekiro achar kach beamro avon haemori kevan shebbo hu medabber besamuch. ufashut sheen divre ramban mechuvvarim.

Vehannachon hu sheyyechavven Adonai lomar shene kitztzim: haechad hu ketz haggalut vehashshibud vehainnuy sheyyitztaref hakkol leminyan arba meot, uchesheyyaggia arba meot shana nishlema haggezera, vehotzi Adonai otam mimmitzrayim beetzem hayyom shennishlemu haarba meot. veketz sheni hu leviat haaretz, shello tihye kenisat haaretz betashlum haarba meot ella ad dor acher shehu dor revii. veheve yodea ki doro shel kalev dor shelishi yechashev vehu sheyyatza mimmitzrayim, vahagam ki kalev nichnas laaretz en haddor nechshav ella berubbo vechalev hu levaddo nishar mehaddor, dichtiv (Bamidbar 14:30) "ki im kalev ben yefunne". uchesheamar hakkadosh baruch hu dor revii al kelalut bene yisrael hu omer. veen divre Rashi mechuvvarin bema sheamar baze, ella dor revii hem dor sheyyatzu mimmitzrayim pachot meesrim shana shehem nichnesu laaretz, shehem bene kalev, vehem revii laggezera keshettachshov peretz, chetzron, kalev, yesher veshovav bene kalev hem dor revii sheshshavu leeretz kenaan, ki en limnot haddorot mehashshevatim kemo shehitchil limnot Rashi yehuda peretz vechulei, sheim banu lehatechil miyyom shehitchila gezerat arba meot nachshov gam yitzchak, veim banu lehatechil merishon adam sheyyarad lemitzrayim nachshov miyyaakov veyihye kalev chamishi, ella vadday sheen limnot haddorot ella mishshehitchil hashshibud shehayu yisrael shello birshut atzmam, veze haya achar mitat hashshevatim sheaz hitchil hashshibud, keamram zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 1:5) shekkol zeman shehayu hashshevatim baolam lo taamu shibud vechahem kaavotam.

VaAdonai ramaz zeman sheyyatchil cheshbon haddorot beamro yashuvu henna, dikdek lomar tevat yashuvu lomar shebbammeukkavim beyad moshel hu omer "yashuvu" kesheyyashlimu arbaa dorot, vedor rishon shettakaf alav yad moshel hem bene hashshevatim, shehashshevatim birshut atzman hayu, veet benehem shavu hammitzrim leval alot min haaretz, vehaven veikkar.

Umeatta nashkif lehavin imre kadosh yenovev chachma beamro ki lo shalem avon haemori, im ken muchach sheavon haemori meakkev hakkenisa, uvemaase asher sidder Adonai betorato hanneima yaggid ki avon hameraggelim hu asher sibbev akkavat dor hayyotze mimmitzrayim ad tumo, veet benehem hevi shamma, vezulat hameraggelim shehirshiu hayu nichnasim haddor hayyotze beshana sheniyya litziat mitzrayim shehu sof haarba meot, velo halchu hameraggelim ella lahafakat retzon hashshoalim leraggel, vezulat ze amar Adonai lahem sheyyikkansu beoto dor atzmo sheyyatza mimmitzrayim shehu shelishi, vahalo lo shalem avon haemori adayin kemaamaro yitbarach (Bereshit 15:16).

Achen kavvanat hakkatuv hi al derech amram zichronam livracha bemassechet berachot (7:) perek rishon befasuk (Chavakuk 1:13) "bevalla rasha tzaddik mimmennu" – tzaddik mimmennu bolea, tzaddik gamur eno bolea, ad kan. perush, ki im yihye rasha adayin yesh beyado ketzat zechut, veyavo tzaddik sherubbo zechuyyot lehitgarot bo – en koach batztzaddik leabbedo, ki adayin yesh larasha lehishtallem zechut hannishar lo baolam hazze, veharasha yitnakkem mehatztzaddik leheyot sheyyesh beyad hatztzaddik mehattiuv sheeno tzaddik gamur. aval kesheyyihye gamur, hagam sheyyishshaer larasha chelek mehattov – yufka kelilato, vechen im yihye harasha muchlat venigmar dino lamut, bakkol ose hashshem shelichuto leabbedo, vechol hakkodem bo zacha, vaafillu eno tzaddik gamur yachol leabbedo min haolam.

Vehinne betzet yisrael mimmitzrayim uchesheshshalchu hameraggelim hayu bemadregat tzaddikim gemurim, vahagam sheasu haegel, kevar neenshu alav, vehashshimtza en bo shiur sheyyimna mehem shem tzaddik gamur leinyan ze shello yikkaru tzaddikim gemurim beerech haemori, vehen henna dor chasid (sanhedrin 110:) dichtiv (tehillim 50:5) "isfu li chasiday korte" vegomer asher lo chen hayu achar shelichut hameraggelim shehiknitu et Adonai vehimru vechulei, veaz nichnesu begeder tzaddik mimmennu beerech haemori. velachen keshehayu tzaddikim gemurim kodem hameraggelim haya bahem koach lidchot haemori, ki yomru elav panne makom meartzenu asher natan lanu Adonai, ucheshello yirtze hare ze mored uven mavet hu, ma sheen ken achar shechatu vehimru imre el lo nisharu bechezkat tzaddik gamur. veleheyot sheadayin lo shalem avon haemori en beyadam lehashemido. velaze timtza keshehepilu laalot hahara yatza haemori uredafum vayyakkum kaasher taasena haddevorim, veze yaggid balla rasha tzaddik mimmennu.

Vetimtza od shebbichnisatam amar moshe (Devarim 9:5): "lo vetzidkatcha vegomer ki im berishat haggoyim haelle", ki nishlam avonam. uchefi ze, hagam sheenchem tzaddikim gemurim, "atta ba lareshet" vegomer, ki en lo shum zechut leamer alav "tzaddik mimmennu". ki mashmaut "tzaddik mimmennu" yore sheyyesh lo ketzat zechut sheyyutzdak leamer "tzaddik mimmennu", aval muchlat beresha en lo chelek hatztzadkut leamer "tzaddik mimmennu", vehaven.

Umeatta yitparshu divre Adonai al nachon, vedor revii vegomer, perush: mavticho havetacha sheen lah bittul beshum ofen baolam, venatan taam laddavar yitbarach shemo, uvintinat hattaam ki lo shalem vegomer. veatta taskil ladaat ki lo yaspik taam ze ella lizman shehayu yisrael beheder shem tzaddik gamur, veaz letzad sheadayin lo shalem avono shel emori lo yuchelu bo leartzo. aval im yihyu yisrael bemadregat tzaddik gamur, en meniut shelemut heavon timnaem mibbo lareshet artzo. velaze kesheyyatzu mimmitzrayim vekibbelu hattora, nitratztza hael sheyyikkansu laaretz techef umiyyad veyikchu et artzo, ki yitgaru bahem veyitkanneu beose risha. ma sheen ken achar avon meraggelim nichnesu begeder tzaddik mimmennu, laze icher Adonai ad tom kol haddor, uvene uvene yashlim avon haemori. veim lo haya taam shelemut avon haemori, hayu banav nichnasim techef umiyyad vaavonam yifreu boonashim acherim kaasher yishpot hashshofet betzedek.

rashi: Ki tov sachrah missechar kasef. kol chillufin sheadam machalif bischora, ze notel ze veze notel ze. aval haomer lachavero: shene li pirkecha vaani eshne lecha pirki, nimtzeu shenehem beyad kol echad veechad:
Charutz. min zahav hu:
targum: Metul detava tigrutah min tigruta desima umin dahava senina alaltah:

rashi: Pere adam. ohev midbarot latzud chayyot, kemo shekkatuv vayyeshev bammidbar vayhi rove kashshat (Bereshit 21):
Yado vakkol. listim:
Veyad kol bo. hakkol sonin oto umitgarin bo:
Veal pene kol echav yishkon. sheyyihye zaro gadol (Bereshit Rabba):
Himmol yimmol yelid betcha. kan kafal alav velo amar lishmona yamim lelammedcha sheyyesh yelid bayit nimmol leachar shemona yamim (leechad) kemo shemmeforash bemassechet shabbat (daf 135 2):
Laachuzzat olam. vesham ehye lachem lelohim, aval haddar bechutza laaretz dome chemi sheen lo eloah:

Venivrechu vecha. yesh aggadot rabbot, vezehu feshuto, adam omer livno tehe keavraham, vechen kol venivrechu vecha shebbammikra, veze mochiach becha yevarech yisrael lemor yesimcha elohim keefrayim vechimnashshe (202 48):
ohc: Vaavarcha mevarchecha vegomer. beracha zo keneged ma shehelim mimmennu haaretz velo hodio kodem letzeto, venissayon ze gadol hu sheyyetze meartzo el hassade mibbeli daat an yifne, vehu lo hirher. laze hivticho ki lo yifchad middavar ki hu yevarech vechulei, uvammakom asher yachane sham yetzav Adonai itto et habberacha, uvaze kol makom asher yidroch kaf raglo hatzelachato umaalato immo:

Veyesh lishol lamma shinna leshono beinyan habberacha? amar "vaavarcha mevarchecha" – hikdim birchato levirchatam, uvakkelala hikdim killatam lekillato. hattaam hu ki hammevarech yakdim Adonai levarcho kodem sheyyevarech leavraham, ma sheen ken hamekallelo lo yakdim Adonai laor oto. vehattaam hu ki yachpotz Adonai lehafechid leval yezalzel adam bichvodo shel avraham. vezulat ze, im yakdim Adonai lekallel mi shehu atid lekallel, lo yuregash haddavar ki hu ze sibba veyikkashlu baddavar bene adam gam bene ish. aval beerech habberacha en michshol. veim letzad hahatava, hinne mevorachim bo kol hammishpachot. gam taam hakedamat birkat hamevarchim kede shettitkayyem birchatam leavraham.
Od yechavven lomar, bema shennedakdek lamma hamevarchim hizkiram bilshon rabbim, vehamekallelim hizkiram bilshon yachid.

Achen yitbaer al derech amram bemassechet moed katan (9:) sheamru rabbanan livno shel rabbi shimon ben yochay: tizra velo techtzad vechulei, venitkavvenu baze livracha. vahagam shehotziu divrehem bilshon kelala, hakkol holech achar hakkavvana, hare shebberchuhu benosach kelala. ucheneged zo amar Adonai vaavarcha mevarchecha, vegam mekallelcha yesh min mekallel shehu mevarech gam oto avarech, velaze amar leshon yachid, ki lo kol mekallel yevarech ella perat shehu mechavven livracha, aval mevarchecha et kullan yevarech. vetevat "mekallelcha" nimshechet gam ken lematta, keshettihye killato liklala aor. nimtzeta omer ki mechavven Adonai ligmor keneged hamevarchim levarech kullam, vehamekallelim hem shene peratim: perat echad yesh sheyyeshno bivracha venimshechet hatteva lemala, uferat echad hem baarira venimshecha hatteva lematta.

Od yirtze al ze hadderech, vaavarcha mevarchecha, perush kesheyyihyu lecha bivracha achat shenayim, shehem hamekallel umitkavven livracha kemaase sheamru tizra, vechazar haav uvercho, kava Adonai beracha lishnehem, shello tomar ki ikkar hamevarech hu harishon veen hashsheni ella mefaresh, talmud lomar "mevarchecha" ki shenehem yitbarchu. veamro umekallelcha yesh gam ken lehasemichah lemala, vehu al derech amram bemassechet taanit (20:) veze leshonam: tova kelala shekkillan achiyya hashshiloni mibberacha shebbercham bilam vechulei, ucheneged mekallel kaze amar sheyyeshno bichlal habberacha, velaze ramaz leshon yachid ki lifrat ze davka yechavven levarech, umekallelcha perat acher sheeno ella mekallel – laze aor.

Venivrechu vecha vegomer. veze hu hahefresh shebben mevarchecha lesheeno mevarech velo mekallel, ki mevarcho yevarchehu Adonai bichvodo mippiv, aval shear mishpechot haadama yitbarchu meemtzaut avraham.

rashi: Neharot. lev mevin lattora velannevua:
Midbar. makom shello hayta chachmat hattora:
targum: Akarev galutehon mibbene ammaya veedberinun beorach takana veeftach lehon al nagdin naharin uvego mashiryan mabbuin ashave madbera laagamin demayan vaara bet tzachvana lemabbue maya:

ohc: Vehaya ki yiru vegomer. hikdim lomar lah taam lema shemmetzavve otah besamuch imri na vegomer, shettomar meaz vetodia mibbeli shoalah davar, tishtaddel lehashemia ki hi achoto, vehu amro imri na, perush: atta, mibbeli shoel. uletzad shettomar lamma nitztarech lehodia davar mibbeli shoel, laze amar ki zulat ze lo tihye sheela, uchesheyyiru otam yedu min hassetam ki hi ishto, vehu amro vehaya ki yiru vegomer, lo yishalu davar ki meatzman yomru vadday ishto zo, uletzad amram ken bedatam yahargu avraham, laze hikdim hu lehotzi kol achva lechol makkir veroe otam.

rashi: Vayyatek mishsham. oholo:
Mikkedem levet el. bemizrachah shel bet el nimtzet bet el bemaaravo, hu shenneemar bet el miyyam:
Oholo. oholo chetiv, battechilla nata et ohel ishto veachar kach et shello (Bereshit Rabba):
Vayyiven sham mizbeach. nitnabbe sheatidin banav lehikkashel sham al avon achan, vehitpallel sham alehem:
ohc: Vayyatek mishsham vegomer. lo zachar lemi hetik. verashi zichrono livracha peresh "oholo", vehu chaser. veulay ki ramaz shehetik tzur mimmakom shennira elav sham, vehu amram zichronam livracha bivrachot (5:) befasuk (Iyov 18:4) "halemaancha teazav aretz veyetak tzur mimmekomo", ki betzet yisrael mimmekom tefillato gorem sheyyetak tzur shehu hakkadosh baruch hu mimmekomo, umikkol shekken bema shellefanenu shennira Adonai elav uvana lo mizbeach sham uchesheyyaavor mishsham avraham yetak tzur mimmekomo, vehu avraham hammatik.

Od yirtze shehetik mizbeach shebbana sham, kesheratza lehattot oholo bemakom acher satar hammizbeach shebbana vechazar uvenao bammakom asher asa sham oholo. velo hutzrach lefaresh ki samach al hazekarato besamuch "vayyiven sham mizbeach vegomer vayyatek mishsham". gam hera beetzba beamro "mishsham" shechozer el haamur besamuch, vehaven:

rashi: Karvu rivchem. kol haovde kochavim umazzalot, bou verivu vehitvakkechu im banay:
Atzumotechem. teanot beriot vachazakot shellachem, velashon 'riv hu ze bilshon mishna: "shenayim shehayu mitatztzemin baddin" bemassechet sanhedrin (sanhedrin lo 2):
targum: Kerivu dinchon amar Adonai ailu chezvatchon amar malkeh deyaakov:

rashi: Musar Adonai beni al timas. im yavou alecha yissurin, yihyu chavivin alecha (tanchuma, yitro 16):
Veal takotz. milleshon "katzti vechayyay" (Bereshit 27:46):
targum: Beri marduta deelaha la tasle vela tamrik vemachsenuteh:

ohc: Kum hithallech baaretz vegomer. beferek hammocher et happerot (bava batra 100.) veze leshono: tanya, halach bah learkah ulerachbah kana bah mekom hillucho, divre rabbi eliezer, vachachamim omrim: lo kana ad sheyyachzik. may tama derabbi eliezer? dichtiv "kum hithallech vegomer learkah" vegomer, verabbanan, hatam mishshum chavivuta deavraham vechulei, kede sheyyehe noach likkavesh lifne banav, ad kan. hinne lisvarat rabbi eliezer, hagam shehechzik bitlishat haaretz usemichatah lefanav kemo shepperashnu befasuk "ki et kol haaretz" vegomer, af al pi chen mimma sheamar hakkatuv kum hithallech vegomer, lelammed tora ba shehalicha have chazaka. velisvarat chachamim demishshum chavivuta vechulei, chezkat haaretz lizchut avraham zacha middin hakkatuv lemala, veen lemedin mikkatuv ze ki chavivuta deavraham yechavven.

rashi: Rau iyyim. ovde avoda zara haggevurot sheeese veyirau:
Karvu vayyeetayun. ze etzel ze neesafim lehillachem, kesheyyiru haggeulla:
targum: Chazo nagvata vidachalun devisyafe ara yezuun yitkarvun veyetun:

rashi: Vayyiven sham mizbeach. al besorat hazzera veal besorat eretz yisrael:
ohc: Vayyera Adonai el vegomer vayyiven sham vegomer. kavvanat hakkatuv lehodia hafelagat chibbat avraham bekono, ki Adonai nigla elav uvissero bazzera uvintinat haaretz, vehu lo hechshiv besorat shete maalot tovot lichlum beerech simchato begilluy shechinato yitbarach elav, lekayyem ma shenneemar (Tehillim 16:11) "sova semachot et panecha", vehu amro vayyiven mizbeach laAdonai hannire elav, kan peresh sibbat simchato asher aleha bana mizbeach hu letzad heraoto yitbarach elav, vehaven. veze ot levanav kamma mehem asher hirchiku cheshek hazzera beerech cheshek hattora vehammitzvot, vetze ulemad mibben azzay (yevamot 63:) betaanato "uma eese venafshi chashka battora".

rashi: Orech yamim vegomer veshalom yosifu lach. torati umitzvotay:
targum: Metul denugeda deyomata ushenaya dechaye ushelama nosfun lach:

rashi: Asher im yuchal ish. keshem shei efshar leafar lehimmanot kach zaracha lo yimmane:
Bera. ra lashshamayim vera labberiyyot:
Birsha. shennitalla veresha:
Shinav. sone aviv shobbashshamayim:
Shameaber. sam ever lauf velikpotz velimrod behakkabba:
Bela. shem hair:
Tizrem. tizre otam kevammizre laruach:
Veruach tissaem. mealehem legehinnom:
targum: Tedirinun verucha titlunun umemre kealola lekasha yevader yathon veat tevua bememra dayya bekadisha deyisrael tishtabbach:

rashi: Biminah. lammeyamminim bah veoskim bah lishmah, orech yamim, vechol shekken osher vechavod. velammasmiylim bah, sheoskim bah shello lishmah, mikkol makom osher vechavod yesh (shabbat 63.):
targum: Nugeda deyomata viminah uvismalah utera vikara:

rashi: Noten layyaef koach. vesofo lehachalif koach laayefutechem:
targum: Dihav letzadikaya dimshalhan lefitgame orayta chuchema udelet lehon tekof nichsin masge:

rashi: Vayhallu otah el faro. hilleluha venehem lomar haguna zo lammelech:
Lo tikra et shemah saray. demashma saray, li velo leacherim, ki sara setam shemah, shettehe sara al kol (berachot 13):
Beer lachay. ketargumo:

targum: Are ana Adonai elahach matkef yeminach daamarit lach la tidchal memri vesaadach:
Tavinun vela tashkechinun leanshe matzutach yehon kilma uchela midaam gavrin dahavo mitgarin lemebad imach kerav:
Tevuta vekusheta la nishbekunach ketorinun betzavrach uchetov inun al luach dilbach:
Bechol archatach deehu vehu yetaretz shevilach:
Vetashkach chisda vesichla vetivuta kodam elaha vekadam bene enasha:
Bedil deyechezun veyedun vishavun dechalti al libbehon veyistakkelun kachada are gevureta dayya avadat da vekadisha deyisrael bera yatah:
Umitmalyan otzrach suvana umutzartach chamra nishpean:
Beri nimosi la tinshe ufukedani yintar libbach:
Archataha archata devusema vechulhon halichataha shelama:
Ha yibbahatun veyitkanun kol ammaya dahavo mitgarin bach yehon kilma veyevdun enashe dinach:

bart: Venumeti lo. amarti lo:
Ken haddevarim. shekkol chaverav cholkim alav:
Meshubbeshet bigyasot. veeni yachol lelech etzlechem lehaid ma sheshshamati, ella emor lahem atta ze haedut bishmi:

Rabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua omrim kulei‏ verabbi akiva omer kulei. velet hilchata kechad minnayhu. ella halacha massiim al pi ishsha veal pi kerovim chutz mechamesh nashim ditnan bematnitin, veed mippi ed, mippi ishsha, mippi eved, mippi shifcha, kasher leedut ishsha:
Lo tehe chohenet kappundakit. kelomar meyucheset lo tehe neemenet kefundakit goya, bitmiah, veim heeminu happunedakit goya mesicha lefi tummah, kol shekken sheyyaaminu beishsha yisreelit:
Lichshettehe pundakit neemenet. kelomar sheggam happundakit enah neemenet:
Partzuf panim im hachotem. im lo raahu befartzuf panav, o shennittal chatmo, en meidin lehassi et ishto, shemma eno hu:
Meguyyad. menuttach. kemo godu illana (Daniel 4):
O chayya ochelet bo. davka bemakom sheen nafsho yotza, aval bemakom shennafsho yotza, meid alav shehu met:
En meidin ella ad shelosha yamim. im lo rauhu ad leachar shelosha yamim lemitato en meidin alav, dechayshinan shemma nishtannu marit panav veeno ze shehem sevurim:

Rabbi yehuda ben bava omer lo chol adam vechulei. yesh lecha adam shemmemaher lehinnappeach, kegon adam shamen. veyesh makom sheadam memaher lehaseriach ulehishtannot bo kegon mekom chamma. veyesh lecha shaa shehaolam cham veadam memaher lehaseriach ulehishtannot. vehakkol lefi haadam vehammakom vehashshaa, ben lekulla ben lechumra. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Betzat hashsheretz. yesh bishmona sheratzim shemmetilim betzim, kegon hatztzav vehalletaa vehachomet:
Hamerukkemet. shennotzar bah efroach:
Tehora. lefi shei efshar ligga baefroach shebbifnim:
Nikkeva chol shehu temea. veaf al pi shello naga. shehashshomer machnis umotzi tuma bedavar sheefshar ligga:

Achbar shechetzyo vasar. yesh min achbar sheeno pare verave ella meatzmo notzar min haadama, keashpa hammashretzet tolaim. veim adayin lo nishlema beriat haachbar ella mitztziddo echad hayemani o hassemali. hannogea babbasar, tame. baadama shekkenegdo, tahor:
Rabbi yehuda omer kulei. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Velo vechayya. tzevi veayyal:
Velo vishchuta. bese shachut:
Velo vitrefa. kegon shenechtechu ragleha min haarkuva ulemala:
Kilayim. tayish habba al rachel:
Mippene shehu se. deven rachel ben ez keruyin se. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer:
Koy. beriyya bifne atzmah hi, safek chayya safek behema:
Netano lakkohen. happeter chamor atzmo:

Ad sheyyafrish se tachtav. vehu leatzmo. veachar kach yishtammesh bappeter chamor. ulefi shehakkohanim chashudim leinyan ze shello lehaferish se tachtav, hilkach yisrael hannoten peter chamor lakkohen eno zaz mishsham ad sheyyifdennu hakkohen befanav:
Kulit. kol etzem sheyyesh bo moach karuy kulit. vekulit hammet hannogea bah ben setuma ben nekuva tame, deha etzem kasseora bammet metamme bemagga uvemassa, kedichtiv (Bamidbar 19) o veetzem adam:
Vekulit hammukdashim. shehappiggul vehannotar metammein hayyadayim. degazru behu rabbanan mishshum chashde chehunna veatzle chehunna, vegazru af baatzamot sheshshimmeshu et hannotar:

Kulit nevela. nevela en atzmoteha metammein, dichtiv benivlatah, velo vaatzamot. vechen sheretz. hilkach setumim tehorim af milletamme vemassa, vechol shekken bemagga, dei efshar lo ligga bammoach shebbifnim. veaf al gav deshomer machnis umotzi tuma, hane mille bedavar sheefshar ligga battuma atzmah vaafillu lo naga bah ella vashshomer, tame, aval hecha dei efshar ligga battuma atzmah, en shomer metamme:
Nekuvim kol shehu. afillu kechut hassaara sheefshar lehachenis bo chut hassaara shel rosho o zekano vahare hu mittamme bechach:
Minnayin sheaf bemassa. akkulit dinvela kae, desheretz eno metamme vemassa:

Hallokeach noten pea lakkol. shechovat happea mimma shekkatzar nishar beze hachetzi shekkana hallokeach, vahave keillu lo machar lo ella ma shennishar bassade achar sheyyotzi mimmenna happea sherauy lehotzi meotah sade. vechen happode miyyad haggizbar motzi min hachetzi sheppada happea haruya lassade chullah:
Ellu devarim sheen lahem shiur. middeorayta, aval midderabbanan yesh lahem shiur, deha tenan besefa en pochatin lappea mishshishshim:
Happea. sheadam chayyav lehanniach besof sadehu laaniyyim, kedichtiv (Vayikra 23) lo techalle peat sadcha bekutzrecha:
Vehabbikkurim. dichtiv (Shemot 23) reshit bikkure admatcha tavi bet Adonai‏ elohecha, velo natna tora bahem shiur:

Vehareayon. shechayyav adam leheraot baazara beshalosh regalim, dichtiv (sham) shalosh peamim bashshana yerae chol zechurecha, vezot hariyya en lah shiur, dechol emat devae ayyel umitchaze venafek. perush acher olat reiyya veshalme chagiga shechayyav lehavi kedichtiv (sham) velo yerau fanay rekam, en lah shiur middeorayta dichtiv (Devarim 16) ish kemattenat yado, ella shechachamim natnu vah shiur, haola maa kesef vachagiga shete chesef:

Ugemilut chasadim. divgufo, kegon bikkur cholim velikbor metim vechayyotze vahen, aval gemilut chasadim divmamono, kegon pidyon shevuyim ulehalbish arumim ulehaachil et harevim vechayyotze vahen yesh lahen shiur, sheyyitten bechol paam shettavo mitzva kazo leyado chamishshit min harevach shebbinchasav, vetu lo michayyev, dehachi amrinan hamevazbez al yevazbez yoter mechomesh. hilkach mibbae leh leinash leafrushe chamishshit harevach bechol et kede sheyyehe matzuy kol zeman sheyyavo gemilut chesed leyado sheyyekayyemennu, uvehachi nafek yede chovato:
Vetalmud tora. en lah shiur dichtiv (Yehoshua 1) vehagita bo yomam valayla:
Vetalmud tora keneged kullam. shakul keneged kullam:
Min happerek shel arkubba. hannimkeret im harosh:

Ad kaf shel yad. etzem rachav shel katef shekkorin 231. vehen shene atzamot, haetzem haemtzai dehaynu min happerek shel arkubba hannimkeret im harosh ad mekom shekkenegdo begamal nikkar, vehaetzem haelyon hamechubbar lagguf. vehazzeroa hayemini bilvad hu shennotnim lakkohen, dichtiv (Devarim 18) venatan lakkohen hazzeroa, hameyumman shebbazzeroa:
Vehu shel nazir. kelomar, vechen zeroa beshela haamur bannazir, kach nittelet:
Uchenegdo varegel shok. haamur bishlamim nammi have shene atzamot min happerek shel arkubba ad buka deatma, dehaynu kol hayyarech:
Sovech shel ragel. hayenu perek shebben hakkulit veetzem haemtzai. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Happerek shel lechi. etzel hatztzedaim. vechotech kelappe matta:

Ad pikka shel gargaret. ad shippuy chova shehi pakitah ufitchah shel kane, dehaynu lechayayim hattachtonot im hallashon. perush acher, pikka shel gargeret tabbaat haggedola shel kane sheasuya agulla kefikka. ufikka hi agulla kechaddur uvetochah nekev shettochavot hannashim bappelech lehachebido keshettoot bo:
Shene mine chittin. kegon shechamtit ulevana:

Haog. ilan shehapperi shello adom, vekorin lo belaaz 366 107. verambam peresh shehu tzemach shemmeabbedim bo haorot vekorin lo baaravi 207, vehaeshkolot shello reuyin laachila. velav davka ellu shemmana hattanna chayyavim bappea velo mine ilanot acherim, ella ellu vedomehen kaamar:
Karka bet rova. makom sherauy lizroa bo rova hakkav. ufershu vo shehu eser ammot umechetza al eser ammot bekeruv:
Haosa satayim. rabbi yehoshua lo azel batar zeria, ella karka hammotzia satayim shehen shenem asar kabbin:
Liktzor velishnot. derech hakkotzrim ochez melo chappo min hakkama vekotzer, kedichtiv (tehillim 129) shello mille chappo kotzer. veim yesh bakkama kede lemallot kappo shene feamim chayyevet befea:
Karka kol shehu chayyevet bappea. disvira leh peat sadcha kol shehu mashma, ufaleg akkullehu:
Uvabbikkurim. dichtiv behu admatcha. vehanne mille bevikkure chitta useora, aval bevikkurim shel ilan eno chayyav ella im ken yesh lo karka shesh esre ammot saviv lailan, shehu shiur yenikato:

Velichtov aleha perozbul. hillel tikken perozbul, kesheraa shehayu nimnaim millehalvot laaniyyim mippene hashsheviit shemmeshammetet hachov, tikken sheyyehe moser shitrotav levet din, vechotev, moser ani lachem peloni ufeloni haddayyanin kol chov sheyyesh li sheegvennu kol zeman sheertze, umishshekkatvu lo shetar ze shuv en sheviit meshammetet chovo. vedavka kesheyyesh karka kol dehu lallo deaz chashiv keillu hachov gavuy kevar beyad bet din vetu lo karena veh lo yiggos, vechashvinan lekarka kol shehu keillu shave kol hachov, deen onaa lekarkaot:
Veliknot immah nechasim sheen lahem acharayut. demittaltelin niknin aggav karka, bechesef bishtar uvachazaka, keditnan beferek kamma dekiddushin, vesham meforash:
Hallavlar. hassofer:
Hazzugot. hem kol otan shenayim shenayim hannizkarim beferek kamma demassechet avot, shekkibbelu shenayim mippi shenayim [ad] mippi shimon hatztzaddik:
Haishsha. lo tinnase. hoil uvelo banim yatza baalah:

Velo tityabbem. shemma yalda tzaratah. veim tomar tachalotz veachar kach tinnase lashshuk mimma nafshach, tertzu baggemara mishshum dachalutza pesula lichhunna, veim tachlotz veyimmatze achar kach sheyyalda tzaratah valad shel kayyama vachalitzatah enah kelum, tzerichim lehacheriz aleha shehi keshera lichhunna velo nifsela mechamat otah chalitza, umi shennimtza bishat chalitzatah velo nimtza beshaa shehichrizu al hachalitza delav kelum hi velo nifsela lakkehunna al yadah kesheyyire otah nesua achar kach lechohen yomar shechalutza mutteret lakkohen:
Hayta lah chamot. bimdinat hayyam:

Enah chosheshet. shemma nittan lah yavam, af al gav dechayshinan leel shemma yalda tzaratah, hatam hu dechol ma deyalda tzaratah ben zachar ben nekeva mappik lah lehiach meyabbem, aval chamot dei nammi yalda lo zakik lah lehiach ella im ken yalda zachar, ikka lememar shemma hippila, veim timtza lomar lo hippila shemma nekeva hayta:
Yatzta melea. meubberet:
Chosheshet. shemma nittan lah yavam. veen halacha kerabbi yehoshua deamar enah chosheshet:
Shete yevamot. neshe shene achim:
Mippene valah shel zo. shemma hu chay uzekuka lo, veaf al pi sheishto omeret met, enah neemenet lehattir zo lashshuk al piha, sheen yevama meida lachavertah:
Lazo edim. shemmet baalah, velazo en lah edim:
Zo sheyyesh lah edim asura. linnase lashshuk, mippene yevamah, sheen edim shemmet:
Vezo sheen lah edim mutteret. shehare bishvil baalah enah neeseret, shehi neemenet lomar met baali, uvishvil yevamah nammi lo mitsera, shehare bau edim shemmet:
Lazo banim velazo en banim. veen edim lo lazo velo lazo, et sheyyesh lah banim mutteret, veet sheen lah banim asura:

Nityabbemu. shehayu lahen kan shene yevamin venityabbemu umetu hayyevamim, asurot lehinnase lashshuk, zo mippene baalah harishon shel zo vezo mippene baalah harishon shel zo, af al pi shehayu shetehen nesuot livamehen bechezkat shemmetu baalehen, al pi atzman nisseu, vehayu neemanot, shehaishsha sheamra met baali tityabbem. aval achshav shettihyena nesuot lashshuk lo, sheim yinnasu lashshuk nimtza edutah shel zo moil lazo veedutah shel zo moil lazo, veen hayyevamot meidot zo lazo:
Hoil vehutteru layvamin. bechezkat shemmetu baalehen, hutteru linnase lashshuk, detu lo chayshinan shemma hem bachayyim. veen halacha kerabbi elazar:

Mayim sheyyesh lahem sof. shennirim kol arba ruchot shesseviv hammayim. umayim sheen lahem sof, sheen adam yachol lirot kol sevivav. verabbi meir lo maflig ben mayim sheen lahem sof lemayim sheyyesh lahem sof. aval chachamim pelige bivrayta, veamre, mayim sheyyesh lahem sof ishto mutteret im shaha sham shiur shei efshar sheyyichye keshiur ze betoch hammayim, umayim sheen lahem sof ishto asura, deshemma leachar sheala mishsham yatza vehalach lo, kidamar rabbi yose bematnitin. vahalacha kachachamim:

Veala leachar shelosha yamim. disvira leh lerabbi meir adam chay betoch hammayim yamim rabbim, umishshum hachi afillu bemayim sheyyesh lahem sof dei nafek hava chaze leh, chayish dilma nafek batar yamim rabbim velo chazu leh. verabbi yose paleg aleh veamar maase besuma sheyyarad litbol bammeara vechulei, umeara mayim sheyyesh lahem sof, veshahu ad shettetze nafsham vehissiu et neshotehen:
Min haarkubba ulematta. hoil veyachol lichyot, lo tinnase, shemma yatza velo rauhu, demayim sheen lahem sof hen:
Hameduldalim baadam tehorim. deadam ki yamut ketiv (Bamidbar 19):
Met haadam habbasar tahor. demita osa nippul uvasar shepperesh min haadam hachay tahor:

Haevar metamme mishum evar min hachay. vedin haevar shepperash min haadam hachay shehu metamme, kol zeman shehu evar shalem metamme vemagga uvemassa uveohel. aval kazzayit basar shepperash mimmennu, o etzem kasseora shepperash mimmennu, tahor. veevar shepperash min hammet vechazar uferash meoto evar kazzayit basar o etzem kasseora, tame:

Verabbi shimon metaher. beevar min hammet nammi kemo beevar min hachay. desavar keshem sheevar min hachay basar happoresh mimmennu o etzem kasseora happoresh mimmennu tahor, hachi nammi beevar min hammet. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Of tame patur milleshalleach. dichtiv kan tzippor, of mashma ben tahor ben tame, tzippor tahor velo tame:
Of tame rovetz al betze of tahor. af al gav demina deefrochim bar shilluach hu, patur. dekan tzippor bainan, shettehe haem hamekannenet tehora:
Veof tahor harovetz al betze of tame patur. deamar kera veet habbanim tikkach lach, lecha velo lichlavecha:

Kore. baaravi korin lo 557, uvelaaz 301. vedarko shehazzachar rovetz al habbetzim kemo hannekeva, hilkach rabbi eliezer mechayyev leshalleach hazzachar. aval bishar ofot mode rabbi eliezer shezzachar patur, deem amar rachamana, velo av. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer:

Para sheyyalda chemin chamor vachamor sheyyalda chemin sus patur. i tana para sheyyalda kemin chamor velo tana chamor sheyyalda kemin sus, hava amena para sheyyalda kemin chamor hu defatur mishshum delo damu ahadade chelal, deha yesh lah karnayim veha en lah karnayim, ha parsoteha sedukot veha parsoteha kelutot. aval chamor sheyyalda chemin sus, ema chamor adom hu velichayyav. vei tana sefa velo tana resha, hava amena chamor sheyyalda chemin sus hu defatur mishshum desus lo kadosh babbechora, aval para sheyyalda kemin chamor detarvayhu kaddeshe babbechora ema lichayyav, tzeriche:
Peter chamor peter chamor shene feamim. chad bekaddesh li chol bechor, vechad bire atta omer elay:
Mahu vaachila. kelomar behema sheen hayyoledet doma lannolad, mahu vaachila:

Shehayyotze mehattame tame. udevash devorim utzerain muttar, velo mikkere yotze min hattame, lefi sheen mematztzot oto mibbesaran ella machnisot oto legufan, sheochlot mippirche hailanot umehen naase haddevash. vachalev haadam muttar keshepperash, aval linok mishshede haishsha asur. vechol shear chalav shel behema vechayya temea, have yotze min hattame veasur:
Dag tame shebbala dag tahor. af al gav delo chazinan leh shebbala, kevan derov dagim mashritzim beminan, kemo shebbala befanenu dame:

Haochel etzel chamiv bihuda. keshehayu osin seuddat erusin bevet avi hakkalla bihuda, hayu nohagim shehaarus mityached im arusato kede sheyyehe libbo gas bah, lefichach keshennisset achar kach en lo taanat betulim:
Amra met bali veachar kach met chami. chamotah asura, sheen kalla meida al chamotah. veaf al gav deamra baresha met baali detu enah kallatah vehaveya nachrit, afillu hachi lo mehemna:

Hayta vat yisrael lechohen tochal batteruma. uveha nammi halacha kerabbi tarfon. aval bekiddesh achat mechamesh nashim veeno yodea eze mehen kiddesh, vechen gazal echad mechamishsha veeno yodea eze mehen gazal, betarvayhu halacha kerabbi akiva:
Medabberet. mityachedet:
Vechohen hu. meyuchas:
Neemenet. keshera lakkehunna:

Haroe makom shennaasu vo nissim. kegon maberot yam suf venachale arnon umaberot hayyarden veeven sheyyashav aleha moshe alav hashshalom kesheasa milchama baamalek vedomehen. veannissa derabbim kegon hanne deamrinan mechayyeve kulle alma livruche, aval annissa deyachid kegon haroe makom shennaasa lo vo nes ihu chayyav livruche baruch sheasa li nes bammakom hazze, uveno uven beno chayyavim levarech baruch sheasa nes laavotay bammakom hazze. vechol hanne berachot dematnitin bau hazekarat shem umalchut, dechol beracha sheen bah hazekarat hashshem umalchut enah beracha:
Venistachafa sadecha. matar sochef ba al sadcha vehifsidah, kelomar mazzalcha garam veten li ketubbati:
Vehaya mikkachi mekkach taut. veen lach ketubba mimmenni:

Neemenet. umashbiin otah shevuat hesset shekken hu chidvareha, vetittol ketubbatah. vechen halacha. vei amra betula metzaani, enah neemenet, dehemnuhu rabbanan labbaal vaafillu belo shevua, dachazaka en adam toreach bisudda umafsidah:
Kol haroim ze et ze. kol zeman shehaomed etzel echad mehailanot yachol lirot hailan haacher, af al pi sheyyesh benehen gader, eno mafsik, velokeach pea meilan echad al chavero:
Lazzetim shehayu lahem bechol ruach. pea achat hayu notnim al kol hazzetim shehayu lahem letzad mizrachah shel ir, ufea acheret al kol hazzetim shehayu lahem letzad maaravah, vechen learba ruchot:
Shehayu lahem bechol hair. en notnim ki im pea achat lechullan, af al pi sheen roin ze et ze, veen halacha kerabbi eliezer berabbi tzadok sheamar mishshemo, aval halacha kerabban gamliel:

Ma tivo shel ubbar ze vechulei. rabban gamliel omer neemenet, uchesherim lakkehunna hi uvittah. aval leinyan yerusha lo amar rabban gamliel shezze haubbar yirashennu. vahalacha kerabban gamliel bechol hane bave dematnitin. vaafillu hachi lechattechilla lo tinnase lakkehunna lo hamedabberet im echad velo hameubberet, ella im ken hayu rov anshe hair meyuchasim venivala zot haishsha meechad mehem shepperash chutz lair uvaal, deamrinan kol defaresh merubba paresh, veaz tinnase lechattechilla lakkehunna ben hi ben bittah:
En pochatin lappea mishshishshim. midderabbanan:
Af al pi sheamru en lappea shiur. middeorayta kidamaran:
Hakkol lefi godel hassade. im sadehu gedola vaaniyyim muatim noten umosif al shishshim lefi godel sadehu, veim sadehu ketanna vaaniyyim merubbim mosif al shishshim lefi rov haaniyyim:

Ulefi haanava. it degarse anava bevav, kelomar lefi rov anvato yarbe laaniyyim, leshon veanvatcha tarbeni (tehillim 18). verambam peresh leshon aniyya, kelomar ma shettaane haaretz. veit degarse anava bevet, ufershu godel haggargerim vekatnan, sheim hayu hashshibbolim shel sade bemakom echad meleot vetovot uvemakom acher tzenumot dakkot lo yanniach happea kullah min haraot ella yeshaer shishshim lara velayyafe:

Hallokeach ubbar chamoro shel nachri. keshehu vime immo uvechor hu. ulehachi nakat ubbar chamoro, sheen lecha vehema temea kedosha bivchora ella peter chamor bilvad, veayde dezuteran milleh defeter chamor, pasek veshare leh. vechol hanach pirke acharine mayre bivchor behema tehora:
Af al pi sheeno rashshay. limkor lenachri behema gassa, mippene shennaaset bah melacha beshabbat:

Vehammishtattef lo. afillu chelek hannachri mesuyyam veyadua, kegon yado o raglo shel bechor, o shel immo. kol zeman sheim yachtoch mimmennu oto evar tishshaer habbehema baalat mum hare ze shuttefut nachri ufatur:
Vehamekabbel mimmennu. shehachamora shel nachri veyisrael mekabbelah umetappel bah kede sheyyehu cholkin bavveladot, aval guf habbehema shel nachri:

Patur min habbechora. oto ubbar shekkana min hannachri o shemmachar hu lannachri eno kadosh, hoil veyesh lannachri chelek bo o veimmo, shenneemar (Bamidbar 3) hikdashti li chol bechor beyisrael, velo venachri:

Im patru et shel yisrael bammidbar. haleviyyim lo patru behemtan shel yisrael bammidbar, defeter behema, behema patra, kedichtiv (sham) veet behemat haleviyyim tachat behemtam. ella hachi kaamar, haleviyyim hifkiu kedushshat bechore yisrael bammidbar, kedichtiv (sham) kach et haleviyyim tachat kol bechor kulei, veim hifkia kedushshat haleviyyim et kedushshatan shel yisrael, din hu shettafkia et shel atzman, umeachar shellamadnu shehufkea kedushshat bechora meatzman shel leviyyim, lamadnu sheppitre chamorehen peturin min habbechora, dichtiv (sham 18) ach pado tifde et bechor haadam veet bechor habbehema hattemea tifde, kol sheyyeshno bivchor adam yeshno bivchor behema temea, vechol sheeno bivchor adam eno bivchor behema temea. aval mibbechor behema tehora lo nifteru chohanim uleviyyim, kedilkamman:
Ellu sheorotehen. metammein kivsaran:
Veor chazir shel yishshuv. mippene shehu rach veochlin oto:
Af or chazir habbar. desavar hay nammi rakkich. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Chatoteret shel gamal harakka. kol zeman shello taan masseoy:
Egel harach. kol zeman shehu yonek:
Veor happerasot. keshechotchin haraglayim, vehu rach:
Bet habboshet. bet harechem shel nekeva:
Veor shettachat haalya. or hazzanav mittachat makom sheen sear, mippene shehu rach:
Haanaka. 306:
Vehalletaa. 261:
Chomet. 84:
Halletaa chachulda. orah chaluk mibbesarah. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Vechullan sheibbedan. kol ellu sheamru shehen metammeim kabbasar, im ibbedan naasu or uvatlu mittorat basar utehorin:
O shehillech bahen. sheshshetachan kede lahaloch bahen, shehu ketzat ibbudan:
Chutz meor haadam. devar tora or haadam leachar sheibbedo tahor, uma taam amru or haadam sheibbedo tame, gezera shemma yaase adam orot aviv veimmo shetichin lammitta leshev velishkav alehen:
Yesh lahen orot. veen echad mehen sheyyihye oro metamme chivsaro. udelo chetanna kamma dachashiv arbaa mehen sheorotehen kivsaran. veen halacha kerabbi yochanan ben nuri:
Zachar unekeva mafrish tale echad leatzmo. deshemma otah shello vikkera yalda et hannekeva:
Shenneemar ufeter chamor tifde vese. kol se bemashma, se chevasim o se izzim, se zachar o se nekeva vechulei:
Ufode vo feamim harebe. im chazar kohen unetano lo:

Nichnas laddir lehitasser. kegon yisrael shehayu lo asara sefek pitre chamorim vehifrish alehen asara seyin vehen shello, hare ellu nichnasim laddir lammakom shemmachnisim sham habbehemot lehitasser, umeasseran kederech shemmeasserim shear behemot. vehu haddin sheim haya lo sefek peter chamor echad o shenayim [vehifrish alehem se echad o shenayim], shennichnas laddir im shear kevasav lehitasser:

Veim met nehenim bo. se shehifrisho lefidyon peter chamor, im met beyad bealim kodem sheyyavo leyad kohen, nehene vo hakkohen af al pi shello higgia leyado mechayyim, demeiddana deafresheh birshuta dechohen kae:
Umassiim al pi vat kol. [im] shamu kol tzivchat peloni met:
Betzalmon. shem makom:

Kol davar shehu ochel. lemiute sefiche sittim, sheaf al pi shehen ochel al yede haddechak lav ochel mikru veen chayyavin bappea, dichtiv (Vayikra 19) uvekutzrechem, veen ketzira ella bedavar harauy laachila:
Venishmar. lemiute hefker sheen lo shomrim sheeno chayyav bappea, dichtiv (sham) leani velagger taazov otam, perat lehefker shekkevar neezav:
Vegiddulav min haaretz. lemiute kemehin ufitriyyot, sheen lahem shoresh baaretz vegiddulehem min haavir, sheen chayyavin bappea dichtiv (sham) ketzir artzechem:
Ulekitato keechad. lemiute teena vechayyotze vah min hailanot shennilkatim happerot shemmitbashshelim bahem rishon rishon, dichtiv (sham) ketzir, mashma davar hanniktzar harebe beyachad:
Umachniso lekiyyum. lemiute yarak sheeno mitkayyem ella mitappesh miyyad, dichtiv (sham 23) peat sadcha bekutzrecha, veen hayyarak niktzar:
Vehattevua vehakkitniyyot. tevua mechameshet hamminim, chitta useora vechusemet shibbolet shual veshifon kitniyyot polin vaafunim vaadashim vedomehen:
Bakkelal hazze. lehitchayyev bappea kesheyyishlemu vahem kol hattenaim hallalu:
Kol hakkodashim shekkadam mum kavua lehekdeshan. hare hen kemakdish etzim vaavanim lidmehen, veen bahen kedushshat hagguf:
Venifdu chayyavin babbechora. im yaldu leachar shennifdu. aval kodem pidyon lo, dikdushshat damim madcha min habbechora, sheen kedushsha chala al kedushsha:

Uveladan vachalavan muttar leachar pidyonan. aval makdish temimim venaasu vaale mumin venifdu, veladan asur kedilkamman. uven resha dekatane muttar uven sefa dekatane asur mayre kegon deiabbar lifne fidyono veityallid leachar pidyono. vachalavan nammi demakdish temimim venifdu nafka lan deasur dichtiv bifsule hammukdashin shennifdu tizbach veachalta vasar, tizbach velo giza, veachalta velo lichlavecha, basar velo chalav:
Veen osin temura. afillu kodem pidyonan. tov meikkara ose temura vaafillu naasa ra achar shehikdisho, aval ra meikkaro eno ose temura:
Veim metu yippadu. veaf al pi sheenan reuyin ella lakkelavim, vaanan kayma lan deen podin et hakkodashim lehaachilan lakkelavim, hane keetzim bealma ninhu velo nachit lehu kedushshat hagguf:

Chutz min habbechor vehammaaser. deaf al gav dekadam muman lehekdeshan, chala alehen kedushsha gemura lechol divrehem, ella sheen kesherim likkarev, divchor barechem tala rachamana, lo shena tam velo shena baal mum kaddish, tam karev, uvaal mum neechol lakkohen bemumo. umasar behema nammi ketiv beh (Vayikra 27) haasiri yihye kodesh laAdonai‏ lo yevakker ben tov lara. tov tam, ra baal mum:
O mum over. kodem lehekdeshan, demum over keman deleteh dame:

Peturim min habbechora. dichtiv bifsule hammukdashin shennifdu katztzevi vechaayyal, ma tzevi veayyal peturim min habbechora, deha kol habbechor asher yivvaled bivkarcha uvetzonecha ketiv (Devarim 15), af pesule hammukdashin shennifdu afillu yaldu leachar shennifdu peturim min habbechora:
Umin hammattanot. hazzeroa vehallechayayim vehakkeva:

Veladan vachalavan asur. bidiabbar lifne fidyono veityallid leachar pidyono mayre, kedifrishit leel. dei iabbar veityallid leachar pidyono, velad tzevi veayyal hu. vei ityallid lifne fidyono, afillu kadam muman lehekdeshan nammi veladan asur:

Vehashshochatan bachutz chayyav. veaf al gav deenan reuyin lefetach ohel moed deha baale mumin ninhu, utenan harauy lefetach ohel moed chayyavin alav bachutz vesheeno rauy lifnim en chayyavim alav bachutz, mokminan lah lematnitin bedukkin shebbaayin verabbi akiva hi deamar im alu lo yerdu, hilkach hoil uvifnim lo yerdu, chayyavin alehem bachutz im shechatan kodem pidyonan:
Veosin temura. kodem pidyonan. dichtiv (Vayikra 27) tov bera o ra betov:
Veim metu. meatzman:
Yikkaveru. deen podin et hakkodashim lehaachilan lakkelavim:

Hayta bat yisrael lechohen. im hayta tzaratah bat yisrael lechohen, tochal batteruma bechezkat shebbaalah kayyam, veenah chosheshet leedut tzaratah, shehoil veenah neemenet lehassiah enah neemenet lefoslah. vechen halacha:
Bana vayit chadash vekana chelim chadashim. ben yesh lo kayyotze vahen ben en lo kayyotze vahen mevarech shehecheyanu:

Al haraa meen hattova. mefaresh baggemara kegon shetztzafu mayim al artzo veshatfu tevuato shel shana zo, af al pi sheriuu hammayim pene haadama venaaset sadehu meshubbachat lashshanim habbaot, hasheta miha raa hi umevarech dayyan haemet:
Veal hattova meen haraa. kegon deashkach metzia, af al gav deraa hi dei shama bah malka chovto bemakkot veyissurin veshakil la minneh hasheta miha tova hi umevarech hattov vehammetiv:
Hatztzoek lesheavar. hammitpallel al ma shekkevar haya hare zo tefillat shav, demay dahava hava:

Battehora uvattemea. ben shehi tehora shechuta vehammafshit tame, ben shehi nevela temea vehammafshit tahor, im mafshito laasot min haor shatiach dehaynu matztza lehatztzia al gabbe hammitta o al gabbe shulchan, kegon shekkorea vechotech haor kullo learko merosh habbehema vead zenavah, umatchil lehafeshit haor, have chibbur yad lehotzi tuma min hannevela im nogea adam tahor baor, ulehachnis tuma labbasar im tehora hi:

Ad kede achiza. shehen shene tefachim. utefe mehachi lo have yad lehachenis ulehotzi tuma, veim habbasar tahor venaga tuma beyoter mishshene tefachim ellu lo nitma habbasar, veim habbasar nevela venaga tahor beyoter mishshene tefachim hallalu lo nitma hattahor:
Ulechemet. im lo chatach haor mittechilla learko ella mafshito kaful letzorech chemet, matchil mitztzavvar vehofcho kelappe zenavah:
Ad sheyyafshit et hechaze. have chibbur. vehannogea baor kenogea babbasar ben littame ben letamme. mippene shehechaze kashe lehafeshit mikkol haevarim:
Hammargil. shemmatchil meragle habbehema lehafeshit umafshito kaful letzorech chemet:
Kullo chibbur. mippene shehechaze lesof hefsheto hu, lefichach kullo chibbur ad hechaze, vehannogea baor hammufshat kenogea babbasar ben littame ben letamme:
Or sheal hatztzavvar. meatzmo nifshat, lefichach eno chibbur laasot hammufshat harishon chibbur kederech shehechaze ose:
Vachachamim omrim vechulei. vahalacha kachachamim:
Hazzeroa vehallechayayim. baaretz uvechutza laaretz. mishshum devae lemitne bechullin aval lo vemukdashin, tane lechullehu:
Bifne habbayit. bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyam:
Vaetten otam. bechaze vashok ketiv. otam miut hu, chaze vashok in midi acharina lo:

Loke veeno meshalleach. af al gav delav hannittak laase en lokin alav, hacha hayenu taama desavar rabbi yehuda shalleach meikkara mashma, vehachi kaamar kera, lo tikkach haem, aval ma yesh alecha laasot keshettimtza hakken, shalleach teshallach et haem, veen kan nittak laase ella averat ase velo taase. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
En lokin aleha. im kiyyem ase shebbah. aval im lo kiyyem haase, kegon hallokeach em meal habbanim ushechatah o meta tachat yado, loke:
Malbenot. arugot merubbaot. uvishvil sheasuyot kidfuse hallevenot keruyin malbenot:

Shebben hazzetim. vehu haddin lechol shear ilanot. venakat zetim leashmuinan daafillu zetim shechayyavim bappea lo mafseke levet hillel, vechol shekken shear ilanot sheen chayyavin bappea difshita delo mafseke:

Bet shammay omrim pea mikkol echad veechad. mikkol malben umalben, hoil veomdot haarugot piske piske veen mitarvin zo im zo kasavre bet shammay demafseke zetim. [aval] hecha derashe shurot mitarvim mizze laze [modu] delo mafseke. uvizman shehailanot meruchakim ze mizze ad shebbekarka bet sea shehu chamishshim amma al chamishshim amma en bo asara ilanot, modim bet hillel shennoten pea lechol malben umalben, dehoil vehailanot meruchakim nirin haddevarim shello bishvil hailanot naasu hammalbenot. uvizman shehailanot retzufim veyesh eser ilanot befachot mibbet sea modim bet shammay shennoten pea achat al hakkol, lo nechleku ella kesheyyesh eser ilanot bevet sea:
Achat omeret met. shete tzarot habbaot mimmedinat hayyam, achat omeret met baali veachat omeret lo met:
Rabbi meir omer hoil umachchishot kulei. velet hilchata kevateh:

Met bali veachar kach met beni neemenet. hoil vehaya lah ben velo hayta bechezkat zekuka leyavam kesheyyatza, hasheta nammi ki amra met baali veachar kach met beni, sheen bah zikkat yavam, mehemna. aval ki amra met beni veachar kach met baali verotza lehityabbem, lo mehemna, veim baa lehinnase lashshuk, choshshim lidvareha, deshavita lenafshah chaticha deissura lealma, vecholetzet velo mityabbemet:
Ushete tzon. alma tarte mikre tzon:

Shenneemar chamesh tzon asuyot. shemmeassot et baalehen veomrot lo kum ase mitzva chadasha, shello hayta mitzva alav befachot mikken. vehayenu al karchacha reshit haggez, dichtiv beh tzon demashma merubbe. deillu bechor ketiv bechor shor, demashma afillu chad. vechen mattanot im shor im se:
Mane mane uferas. kol achat mane vachetzi. uvetzir mehachi la chashiv gez, shezzo pachut shebbaggizot:

Bechol shehen. lav davka, divfachot mishshishshim selaim lo michayyav bereshit haggez. ella mishshum derabbi dosa yehiv shiura rabba, kare tanna leshiura zuta derabbanan kol shehen. vehassela mishkalo esrim vearbaa maim, umishkal kol maa shishsha asar garine seora:
Kamma hu noten lo. habba lechallek reshit haggez shebbeyado, lo yifchot lechol kohen mimmishkal chamesh selaim tzemer:

Melubban. velo sheyyihye chayyav hayyisrael lelabbeno, ella sheyyitten lo shiur min hatztzemer hatztzoi, dehaynu sheeno melubban, ad shekkesheyyelabbenennu hakkohen yaamod al mishkal chamesh selaim tzemer melubban:

Kede. sheyyuchal: laasot mimmennu veged katan. harauy lesherut. umay nihu, avnet. middesamach kera achar reshit haggez miyyad, ki vo bachar Adonai‏ elohecha mikkol shevatecha laamod lesharet, shaminan minna dehachi kaamar, ten lo mereshit gez tzoncha kede sheyyuchal laasot beged laamod lesharet. vehakkatan shebbabbegadim harauy lesherut hu avnet, vehu naase mechamesh selaim tzemer melubban. vereshit haggez en lo shiur min hattora, umiddivre sofrim shello yifchot meechad mishshishshim. veen chayyav bereshit haggez ad sheyyigzoz chamesh tzon, vetihye gizzat kol achat mechamishtan en pachot miv sela, sheim hayta gizat achat mehen pachot miv sela af al pi shechamishtan gozzot yoter mishshishshim selaim hare ze patur:
Ad shetztzevao. bealav kodem shennetano:
Patur. millitteno od. dekanye beshinnuy, vahava leh kemazzik mattenot kehunna o sheachalan, defatur:
Velo tzevao. en ze shinnuy veakkatti beeneh hu:
Hallokeach gez tzono shel nachri. keshehu mechubbar latztzon, patur. degez tzoncha ketiv, vehay tzon lav dideh hu, veatztzon kafed rachamana velav aggizin dideh:
Im shiyyer hammocher hammocher chayyav. deamar leh lokeach mattana dechohen gabbach hi:
Veim lav hallokeach chayyav. deamar leh mocher mattana dechohen lo zabbani lach:
Shechufot. lo shechorot velo levanot:

Ze noten leatzmo. hallokeach noten leatzmo al ma shellakach, vehammocher noten leatzmo al ma sheshshiyyer etzlo. degizat hallevanot tova mishshel shechufot. vechen zecharim unekevot gizat hazzecharim kasha vehay dinkevot rakkich:
Zikim. kochav hannire kemo sheppoteach harakia veyore kachetz mimmakom lemakom. i nammi kochav shennire kemo sheyyesh lo zanav aroch:
Zevaot. shehaaretz mizdazaat veroeshet:
Reamim. kol hannishma barakia meananim sheshshofchim mayim mizze laze, kema detema (yirmeya na) lekol titto hamon mayim bashshamayim:
Veal haruchot. shebbaim bisara vazaaf, veenam metzuyot ella lifrakim:

Baruch shekkocho male olam. vei vae mevarech baruch ose maase vereshit, shekkol ellu maase vereshit hem dichtiv (tehillim kalla) berakim lammatar asa, aval al heharim veal haggevaot vechulei‏ omer ose maase vereshit davka, delo matze livruche alayhu shekkocho male olam, sheenan nirim berov haolam ella kol echad veechad bimkomo:
Hayyam haggadol. yam okyanus shemmakkif haolam:
Baruch sheasa et hayyam haggadol. shemmittoch gadlo vachashivuto kovea beracha leatzmo:
Lifrakim. mishsheloshim yom lishloshim yom:

Al haggeshamim vechulei. mevarech hattov vehammetiv, vehu deit leh ara beshuttafut im acharine, dehachi mashma hattov vehammetiv, hattov ledideh vehammetiv leacharine, aval ki let leh ara kelal omer modim anachnu lach Adonai‏ elohenu al kol tippa vetippa shehoradta lanu vechulei. veim yesh lo karka levaddo mevarech shehecheyanu:
Sade shekketzaruha kutim. leatzman. velo shekketzaruha poale kutim leyisrael, deaz have keillu ketzaruha yisrael:
Kirsemuha nemalim. derech hannemala lachtoch kene hashshibbolet millematta. velaze korim kirsum, leshon yecharsemenna chazir miyyaar (tehillim 80):
Petura. dichtiv gabbe pea uvekutzrechem, ad shettihyu attem hakkotzrim:

Shechovat hakkatzir bakkama. kelomar chovat happea shel ze hinnichah bakkama. unehi deim killa sade, chazra pea loomarim vechayyav lehaferish pea min hoomarim, hanne mille hecha dechilla hu, aval hacha hu lo chilla:

Shehachelev moalin bo. vaafillu kadashim kallim shehen mamon bealim veen bahen meila bechayyehen, yesh meila beemurehen leachar shennizrak daman. dichtiv gabbe kadashim kallim (Vayikra 3) kol chelev laAdonai, ulehachi ketiv behu laAdonai, lememar dekadshe Adonai‏ karinan beh leinyan meila:
Vetame. im achalo betumat hagguf chayyav shete chattaot, achat mishshum chelev veachat mishshum tumat hagguf:

Ma sheen ken baddam. degabbe dam ketiv (sham 7) al hammizbeach lechapper, lechappara netattiv velo sheyyehe karuy shelli limol bo, sheeno omed ella lechapper bishvilchem. umishshum piggul en bo, dechol sheddavar acher mattir oto, kegon besar kadashim shehaddam mattiro lakkohanim bizrikato, uchegon ola sheddamah mattirah lammizbeach, deim lo nizrak damah en evareha niktarim dichtiv (sham) vezarak hakkohen et haddam al mizbach Adonai‏ vahadar vehiktir hachelev lereach nichoach, ellu yesh bahen mishshum piggul, aval dam dehu gufeh mattir hu en chayyavin alav mishshum piggul. umishshum notar vetame nammi en bo, dichtiv baddam tere miute, hu velachem, chad lemiute minnotar vechad lemiute mittuma:
Ella bivhema tehora. kedichtiv (sham 7) min habbehema asher yakriv mimmenna:
Reshit haggez. kol haggozez tzono vaafillu gozzan mea feamim noten min haggiza mattana lakkohen:

Noheg baaretz uvechutza laaretz. vehaidna nahug alma kerabbi illaiy, deamar reshit haggez eno noheg ella vaaretz. deyalef netina netina mitteruma, ma teruma enah noheget ella vaaretz af reshit haggez eno noheg ella vaaretz. verabbotay horu bammattanot nammi deen nohagot ella vaaretz, dereshit haggez vehammattanot shavin hen. velo hodu lahen shear chachme haddor:
Bemukdashim. afillu kadshe vedek habbayit. mishshum dichtiv gez tzoncha, velo shel hekdesh:
Nohagim bevakar uvetzon. dichtiv (Devarim 18) im shor im se:
Uvemuat. afillu lo shachat ella achat:
Ella virchelot. ketiv hacha (sham) gez tzoncha, uchetiv hatam (Iyov lo) umiggez kevasay yitchammem, ma lehallan kevasim af kan kevasim:
Nittan li yavam bimdinat hayyam. sheyyalda chamotah bimdinat hayyam, vehi halcha bechezkat sheen lah yavam:
Met baali veachar kach met yevami vechulei. detarvayhu ka sharya nafsha lashshuk, neemenet umutteret lashshuk bechezkatah harishona, shehappe sheasar hu happe shehittir:
Shebba al hakketanna. pechuta mibbat shalosh shanim veyom echad, sheen biatah bia:
Vekatan. pachot mibben tesha, sheen biato bia, uva al haggedola:
Umukkat etz. shennitka lah etz beoto makom:
Ketubbatan matayim. im nisseu setam:
Vachachamim omrim mukkat etz ketubbatah mane. vehilchata kevatayhu. vaafillu lo hikkir bah, ketubbatah mane, velo have mekkach taut:
Mittechillat hassade umeemtzaah. veen tzarich lehanniach pea besof hassade, dichtiv (Vayikra 19) lo techalle peat sadcha liktzor, amra tora ten pea veaf al pi sheyyesh lecha adayin kama liktzor:

Uvilvad sheyyitten bassof kashshiur. af al gav deravi kera batchilla uvaemtza sheyyesh torat pea lema shennatan, mikkol makom lo miftar ella im ken noten besof hassade tashlum shiur echad mishshishshim im ma shennatan baemtza uvattechilla. ken muchach bayrushalmi. verambam peresh uvilvad sheyyitten bassof keshiur pea hatztzericha lechol hassade, shetztzarich sheyyanniach besof hassade echad mishshishshim chutz mimma shehinniach battechilla uvaemtza:
Im shiyyer kelach echad. besof hassade vehinniach oto lefea somech alav, vechol ma shehinniach baemtza uvattechilla torat pea aleha:

Veim lav. shello hinniach afillu kelach echad besof hassade lefea, hare ma shehinniach baemtza uvattechilla enah chashuva pea ella din hefker yesh lah. ufaleg adderabbi shimon deamar demikkol makom hi chashuva pea ella delo miftar baal hassade behachi. vahalacha kerabbi shimon:
Keva. chalav hakkarush shebbetoch hakkeva:
Nachri veshel nevela. hachi kaamar, shechitat nachri shehi nevela, hare zo asura:
Hammaamid. chalav:
Beor shel keva. dehu basar:

Im yesh bah. litten taam bechalav: hare zo asura. veim lav, mutteret. veaf al pi shehu maamid, hoil vehaor atzmo shel hetter hu veen issuro ella mechamat davar acher shennitarev bo, lo amrinan behay hakkol holech achar hammaamid. aval im heemid haggevina beor keva shel nevela, afillu en bah litten taam bechalav, asur, mippene hammaamid sheasur veissuro mechamat atzmo. ulefichach asru gevinot hannachrim, mippene shemmaamidin otam beor keva shel nevela. aval hakkeva atzmah dehaynu hechalav hakkarush shebbetoch hakkeva, assikna delet bah issur kelal, defersha bealma hu. ken katav rambam. aval Rashi katav, vechalav hannimtza karush beor hakkeva shemmolchin otah beorah, ani hayiti noheg hetter ad henna, uvilvad shello yittenu vah chalav acher, vetoe hayiti bechach, shehayiti sover middeamrinan [baavoda zara daf 29] gabbe kevat ola, kohen sheddato yafa gomah chayya, shema minna persha bealma hi velo mittassera, velo hi, chalav gamur hu, midditnan bematnitin keshera sheyyanka min hatterefa kevatah asura, shema minna chalav hu. vekevat ola desharya, mishshum delav gufah hu ella sheyyenakattu meimmo vahava leh kanus betoch meeha kenatun bikara umuttar:

Chutz mechamotah. taama dechullehu, mippene shessonot otah umitkavvenot lekalkelah. chamotah sonaatah, sheomeret belibbah zot tochal kol amali. bat chamotah omeret zot tirash kol amal avi veimmi. yevimtah yerea shemma sofah lihyot tzaratah. bat baalah omeret zot baa bimkom immi vetochal kol amalah:
Ma ben get lemita. deamrinan af hannashim sheen neemanot lomar met baalah, neemanot lehavi gittah:
Shehakketav mochiach. desamchinan ikkara al hagget. veaf al gav daalayhu nammi samchinan, shetztzerichot lomar befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam:
Ed echad omer met venisset. lav davka nisset, ella hittiruha lehinnase af al gav shello nisset, veachar kach ba ed echad veomer lo met, lo tetze mehetterah harishon:

Ed echad omer met ushenayim omrim lo met. kegon shehem pesule edut. veashmoinan hoil veheemina tora ed echad en kan torat edut, vechi hechi dechad chashiv, pesule edut nammi chashive, hilkach hallech achar rov deot, ben kesherim ben pesulim:
Shenayim omrim met veechad omer lo met vechulei. ha ka mashma lan deazlinan achar rov deot bifsule edut, ben lekulla ben lechumra:
Haimmahot shel betzalim. betzalim gedolim shemmannichin otan legaddel zera, umittoch shemmishtahin baaretz lo chazu laachila ella al yede haddechak, ulechach patar rabbi yose. veen halacha kemoto:

Malbenot habbetzalim shebben hayyarak. savar rabbi yose deyarak kezera acher dami, sheen derech bene adam lihyot machnis betzalim ben hayyarak, utenan leel beferek sheni dezera acher mafsik. veen halacha kerabbi yose:

Shetayim bichnisato ushetayim bitziato. bichnisato omer shettachniseni lichrach ze leshalom, nichnas omer mode ani lefanecha shehichnastani lichrach ze leshalom hare (ze) shetayim bichnisato. bikkesh latzet omer shettotzieni mikkerach ze leshalom, leachar sheyyatza omer mode ani lefanecha shehotzetani mikkerach ze leshalom. vechol kach lamma, mippene shetztzarich sheyyitten adam hodaa levoro al ma sheavar alav min hattov, veyitpallel al heatid shettavo lo tova:

Haor veharotev. mishshum ditnan beferek behema hammaksha [daf oz] gabbe shilya, veenah metammea tumat ochalim velo tumat nevelot, tana haor veharotev. vehay deafsekeh, mishshum detana beferek behema hammaksha matza vah ben tisha chay taun shechita vechayyav beoto veet beno, tana achar kach oto veet beno. veayde deayre beh bishchita sheenah reuya tane batreh kissuy haddam. veayde detana bechissuy haddam venoheg bechayya vaof tana gid hannashe denoheg bechayya velo veof. veayde deayre beh beyarech shennitbashshel bah gid hannashe [bivliat issur], tana kol habbasar. uvatreh hadar leinyena kammayta deshilya, avenah metammea tumat ochalim:

Haor veharotev. haor shel behema shechuta kegon pachot mikkabbetza basar veorah mechubbar bah, mitztaref, mippene shehu shomer labbasar, vehashshomrim mitztarfim letuma kalla shehi tumat ochalim, dichtiv bah (Vayikra 11) al kol zera zarua asher yizzarea, kederech shebbene adam motziim lizria, chitta biklippatah useora biklippatah vaadashin biklippatan. veaf al gav divhahu kera tahor hu ketiv beh, taama mishshum delo huchshar, desamich leh vechi yuttan mayim al zera, dehuchshar, tame hu:
Veharotev. keshehi kerusha derech leachlah im habbasar, umitztarefet lehashelim shiur kabbetza. aval enah ochel lekabbel tuma bifne atzmah:
Vehakkippa. tevalin. vehen atzman lav ochalim chashive, aval leitzterofe mitztarfin:

Vehaelal. gid hashshidra vehatztzavvar. vehu rachav velavan vekashe vekorin lo belaaz 226. vedugmato [beiyyov 13] rofe elil kullechem, shemmishshennifsak en lo refua lehitchabber od, kach attem, davar sheen bo refua attem omrim lerappeot. i nammi, kare tanna elal levasar sheppelatto sakkin, keshemmafshitin et habbehema peamim shehassakkin polet min habbasar etzel haor, vela chashiv ochel, aval mitztaref im haochel:
Vehakkarnayim vehattelafayim. kol shechotchan veyotze mehem dam etzel ikkaran millematta shehen rakkim. umihu beanpe nafshayhu lav ochalim ninhu:
Mitztarfin. mishshum shomer:
Letamme tumat ochalin. lehashelim shiur kabbetza. sheen ochalim temeim metammeim befachot mikkabbetza:

Aval lo tumat nevelot. im minnevela hen, en metammein, veen mitztarfin lechazzayit lehashelim shiur nevela letamme adam uvegadim shealav, dichtiv (Vayikra 11) hannogea benivlatah, velo veor sheen alav kazzayit basar vehaor mashlim lechazzayit, shehannogea bo eno tame, lefi sheen shomer mitztaref letumat nevelot. vechen kippa verotev lav min nevela ninhu. veelal vegidim lav basar hen, aval ochalim bealma havu bahade basar:
Kayyotze vo. [yesh] shehu metamme tumat ochalim, lihyot mekabbel tuma min hashsheretz umetamme ochalin acherim, veeno metamme meelav tumat nevelot letamme acherim:

Hashshochet behema temea lenachri. yisrael sheshshachat behema temea letzorech nachri veodah mefarkeset, af al gav delo chazya lenachri, delo sharya shechita livne noach ad shettamut, afillu hachi hoil veyisrael shachat, shechita maalyata hi, vehoil dishchita sharya legabbe deyisrael bivhema tehora, meshavya leh machashavto ochla bashshechita af bitmea lenachri. aval nachri bishchita lo meshavya leh machashavto ochla, delo ashkechan shechita legabbeh. utemea leyisrael lo meshavya leh ochla, devatla machashavto:
Aval lo tumat nevelot ad shettamut. deha vechi yamut min habbehema ketiv (sham):
O ad sheyyattiz et roshah. dehavya lah gistera unevela mechayyim, dachashuva meta, vaafillu hi mefarkeset:
Ribba hakkatuv letamme tumat ochalim. deha ikka kol hane dilgabbe ochalim ochla ninhu unevela lo mikre af al pi deshayyeche vah:
Haelal hamechunnas. hay elal desefa lechulle alma have basar sheppelatto sakkin etzel haor:
Hamechunnas. hanneesaf lemakom echad. dehoil veachsheveh lo batil vachashiv habbasar nevela, vechayyav alav im naga venichnas lammikdash o achal kodesh. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Mitzva shehi keissar. sheen bah chesron kis ella davar muat:
Hamenammer. melakket sadehu mekomot mekomot, demechaze kimnumar, leshon venamer chavarburotav (yirmeya 13), shekkatzar hattevua shennitbashshela rishon rishon bassade:
Veshiyyer kelachim lachim. otan shello nitbashshelu:
Noten pea mikkol echad veechad. keshechozer lelakket hakkelachim lachim sheshshiyyer. denimmur mafsik velav atchalta diktzira chashiva:
Bezorea shevet. yarak shekkorin lo 76 belaaz:

Shehu noten pea lechol achat veachat. mippene sheen darkan lizroa mehen sade achat, lefichach chashuvin kol otan arugot keillu kol achat mehen sade achat. veshevet vechardal chayyavim bappea af al pi sheen notnin pea layyarak, mishshum dilzera avide uchemine zeraim chashive. vahalacha kachachamim:

Im rov hair massiin lakkehunna. af al gav derubba chad saggi bealma, maala asu beyochasin, vehacha atzrechuha rabbanan tere rubbe, rov sia haoveret sham verov hair. veen massiin lechattechilla lakkehunna ella bitre rubbe, vechen halacha:
Betula almana gerusha. kelomar, betula shehi almana o gerusha o chalutza min haerusin, vechazra venisset, ketubbatah min hashsheni matayim:
Veyesh lah taanat betulim. im lo matza lah hashsheni betulim, ibbeda ketubbatah, demekkach taut hu shehare bechezkat betula nesaah:
Afillu shama min hannashim. sheen mitkavvenot lehaid, yachol lelech lehaid lehassi et ishto:

Hare anu holchim lispod velikbor et ish peloni. baggemara moke shetztzarich sheyyomru anu baim millispod velikbor et ish peloni. vetzarich nammi sheyyishma otam mesapperim meinyene hahesped, kach vechach rabbanan havu hatam, kach vechach safdane havu hatam, mippene shedderech tinokot lesachek ulehaalot shemot, veshemma nemala o chagav kavru umechannim oto beshem ish peloni:
Betula nisset layyom revii. velo velel chamishi, deikka lemechash shemma yihye tarud bannissuim velo matze bael:

Sheim yesh lo taanat betulim. kegon sheyyomar baalti velo matzati dam, lo shena im hi ketanna o naara o bogeret. o petach patuach matzati, im hi ketanna o naara, aval bogeret en lah taanat petach patuach:

Yashkim veyavo levet din. beod kaaso alav, shemma yitpayyes vetitkarer dato vikayyemenna, veshemma zinneta tachtav vahare hi asura alav. uvaggemara parech vetinnase beechad beshabbat veim yesh lo taanat betulim yashkim beyom sheni levet din. umeshane, shakdu chachamim al takkanat benot yisrael sheyyehe toreach basseudda shelosha yamim, echad beshabbat vesheni veshabbat ushelishi veshabbat, uvirvii konsah. uvizman sheen batte dinin yoshvim besheni uvachamishi, ishsha nisset bechol yom, vehu shettarach basseudda shelosha yamim. umippene takkanat aniyyim nohagim biktzat mekomot lissa beerev shabbat. vetaama dealmana leyom chamishi, shakdu chachamim al takkanat benot yisrael sheyyehe sameach immah shelosha yamim, chamishi veshabbat veshishshi veshabbat veshabbat. vehannose et haalmana asur baasiyyat melacha shelosha yamim. vehannose et habbetula kol shiva. uleinyan birkat chatanim, ben bachur shennasa almana ben alman shennasa betula mevarchim birkat chatanim kol shiva, vealman shennasa almana, yom echad:

Ellu mafsikin. ben sade lesade veyihyu necheshavim kishte sadot, leinyan sheim hinniach pea beachat mehen al chavertah lo alta lo lefea, dichtiv (Vayikra 19) peat sadcha, shello yanniach pea missade lachavertah:
Hannachal. nahar:
Vehashshelulit. ammat hammayim shemmechalleket shalal laagappeha sheammot acherot shel mayim shotot mimmenna:
Vederech hayyachid. arba ammot:

Vederech harabbim. shesh esre amma, umishshum sefa nakat la devae lemitne sefa shekkol ellu en mafsikin beilan, veka mashma lan daafillu derech harabbim shehi rechava shesh esre amma enah mafseket beilan:

Shevil harabbim ushevil hayyachid. shevil zutar tuva, deshakil kara umanach kara. veashmeinan daafillu shevil derabbim im hu kavua limot hachamma velimot haggeshamim, kelomar shemmehallechin bo afillu bizman shehassadot zeruot bimot haggeshamim, mafsik ben hassadot hazzeruot vei lo, lo mafsik:
Habbur. sade sheenah zerua. vehaadama lo tesham (Bereshit 47) metargeminan veara lo tevur:
Vehannir. charisha. kemo niru lachem nir (yirmeya 4):
Vezera acher. kegon sheshshete hassadot zeruim chittim uvenehem karka zarua min acher. veshiur rochav habbur vehannir vezera acher kede shelosha telamim shel maanit hammacharesha:

Vehakkotzer leshachat mafsik. dekasavar kol leshachat lav ketzira hi, delo chashvinan la atchalta diktzira. shachat, tevua shello hevia shelish, vekotzrim otah lehaachil labbehemot. veen halacha kerabbi meir:
Hakkol mafsik lazzeraim. mefaresh baggemara bayrushalmi dehakkol laatoye sela shehaya over al pene kol hassade, im tzarich hu laakor et hammacharesha mitztzad ze kede latet otah letzad ze, mafsik:
Ella gader. gavoah asara tefachim:
Sear kotesh. anfe hailan keruyin sear. uferush sear kotesh, shehannofot shel ilanot mitarvin ze im ze lemala min haggader keeli ze hattakua bammachtesh:
Or sheyyesh alav kazzayit basar. bemakom echad:
Hannogea betziv hayyotze mimmennu. retzua vetiltul hayyotze meoto vasar vetaluy vedavuk bemiktzat. uveoto tziv lekka kazzayit aval meure hu lechazzayit:
Uvesaara. shebbaor keneged oto vasar:
Tame. desaara have shomer:
Metamme vemassa. shehare nasa kazzayit nevela:
Velo vemagga. dei efshar ligga beyachad, ushete negiot enan mitztarfot:
Lo vemagga velo vemassa. kedimfaresh taama besefa shehaor mevattelan:
Umode rabbi akiva. deaf al gav delo have kazzayit meure bemakom echad, bichhay gavna kegon shettachav shene chatzae zetim bekesam, kelomar etz dak, vehesitan, shehu tame. vahalacha kerabbi akiva:
Sheen haachim nichnasim. lenachalat baalah, derachamana amar (Devarim 17) al pi shenayim edim. vegabbe nissuin didah hu deakilu rabbanan mishshum iggunah:
Missefer ketubbatah. minnussach hakkatuv bishtar ketubba, keshettinnasi leacher, vahare hi nisset, veim ken tittol ketubbatah:

Hammachalik betzalim. it dimfarshe leshon veanochi ish chalak (Bereshit 26), al shem shekkeshennitleshu nishar hammakom chalak. veit dimfarshe hammachalik kemo hamechallek, shennotel chelek min habbetzalim lachim lemachran bashshuk vechelek acher manniach yeveshim laggoren lekiyyum:
Noten pea leellu leatzman. dechishne mine chittim damu:
Vechen becharem. vechen hammachalik becherem dino kemachalik bivtzalim:

Hammedel noten min hameshuyyar al ma sheshshiyyer. bizman shehabbetzalim zeruim retzufim notel mehem echad mibbentayim kede shehannisharim yitgaddelu berevach veyeasu gassim. vezehu hannikra medel, sheddole vesholef otam mimmekomam, utenan ezehu medel, notel achat umanniach shenayim. veotan sheoker litten revach lannisharim enam chayyavin bappea, lefi shettakkanat hannisharim hi, hilkach noten pea min hannishar levad vehanneekar patur mikkelum delo chashiva ketzira:

Hammachalik meachat yad. kelomar meinyan echad, o kullo laggoren o kullo lashshuk. verambam peresh meachat yad mimmakom echad, shehachelek shennotel limkor bashshuk eno notel oto mikkan umikkan ella kullo mitztzad echad:
Leolam hu noten mishshum pea. mi shello hinniach pea bassade bamchubbar chayyav lehaferish min hattalush, vehappea shemmafrish min hattalush venoten laaniyyim petura min hammaasrot:

Ad sheyyemareach. sheyyease keri vetzibbur shel tevua, aval im ba lehaferish pea achar hammeruach tzarich sheyyafrish hatteruma vehammaasrot techilla veachar kach yittol happea, sheen patur min hammaasrot ella happea shennittela kodem hammeruach:

Venoten mishshum hefker ufatur min hammaasrot. (mishshum hefker) hammafkir tevuato uva acher vezacha vah, en hazzoche vah chayyav bemaasrot dichtiv (Devarim 14) uva hallevi ki en lo chelek venachala immach, yatza hefker sheyyadcha veyado shavin, aval hammafkir tevuato leachar hammeruach en hahefker hahu poter min hammaaser:
Umaachil labbehema vechulei. vaafillu hu atzmo muttar leechol achilat aray kodem meruach, aval habbehema ochelet afillu achilat keva:

Notel min haggoren vezorea vechulei. demin hattora hazzorea patur min hammaaser afillu leachar meruach dichtiv (sham) asser teasser veachalta, vezorea lo karinan beh veachalta, mihu midderabbanan chayyav. sevira leh lerabbi akiva dekodem meruach patur min hammaaser afillu midderabbanan. veen halacha kerabbi akiva:

Shellakchu et haggoren. shekkanu tevua min haggoren, vekansu chachamim sheyyihyu chayyavim lehaferish terumot umaasrot velatet otam lechohanim uleviyyim acherim kede shello yihyu koftzim liknot tevua o yayin laggittot velaggeranot. veim kanu kodem meruach, sheadayin lo hukbea tevua zo lemaaser, hammaasrot shellahem:

Hammakdish ufode. hammakdish garno ufedao miyyad haggizbar, vehu gadish o kama shello hukba lemaaser keshehaya beyad hahekdesh, chayyav happode lehotzi mimmennu hammaasrot. aval im nitmareach haggoren beyad haggizbar hoil uveshaa shehaya rauy sheyyukba lemaaser dehaynu bizman hammeruach hayta beyad hekdesh, en happode chayyav lehotzi mimmennu maasrot, shehahekdesh patur min hammaasrot:
Betula shehi almana o gerusha o chalutza min hannissuim. im chazra venisset setam, ketubbatah mane, divchezkat beula kayma mishshennichnesa lachuppa:
Shellakchu et hailan. mehanach ilanot dechashiv beferek kamma shechayyavim befea:
Hammocher kilche ilan. sharshe tzemachim shechayyavin bappea, velo machar lo hakkarka, noten hallokeach pea mikkol echad veechad:

Bizman shello shiyyer. kelomar im lo hitchil baal hassade liktzor o lelakket perot, az hu dechayyav hallokeach litten pea. aval im hitchil baal hassade liktzor sadehu kodem shemmachar et ellu, shennishar min hassade shello niktzar o shello nilkat, baal hassade hu hannoten pea al hakkol, dimki atchil bakketzira o bilkitat happerot ichayyav bappea shel kol hassade. verabbi yehuda leferushe milleteh detana kamma ata, vechen halacha:
Ammat hammayim sheenah yechola lehikkatzer keachat. shehi rechava kol kach ad shehaomed baemtza eno yachol liktzor mikkan umikkan:

Rabbi yehuda omer mafseket. ufaleg attanna kamma deamar leel al shelulit dehaynu ammat hammayim divchol inyan mafsik, verabbi yehuda savar deim yechola lehikkatzer keachat enah mafseket. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda:
Vechol heharim asher bammader yeaderun. har shechudo zakuf veen bakar bechelav yecholin laavor sham, umafsik ben shete hassadot:

Hu noten pea lakkol. kelomar noten pea achat lechol shete hassadot velo chashiv hefsek, hoil vehem nedarim bammader, kelomar shebbene adam chofrim oto har bichli shechofrim bo et hakkarka, en ze hefsek. sheharoe omer en ze karka bur ella lemachar chofrim oto bammader vezorim oto ushete hassadot hem achat:
Chayyav adam levarech al haraa. keshemmevarech dayyan haemet al haraa, chayyav levarech besimcha uvelev tov keshem shemmevarech besimcha hattov vehammetiv al hattova:
Davar acher bechol meodecha. bechol middot hamedudot lecha, ben midda tova ben middat puranut:
Lo yakel adam rosho. lo yinhag kallut rosh:

Keneged shaar hammizrach. chutz lehar habbayit asher bachoma hannemucha asher leragle habbayit lammizrach, lefi shehu mechuvvan, shekkol hashshearim mechuvvanim ze keneged ze, shaar mizrach, shaar ezrat nashim veshaar ezrat yisrael, ufetach haulam vehahechol uvet kodesh hakkadashim bime bayit rishon:
Baafunedato. ezor chalul shennotnim bo maot. perush acher beged shellovesh al besaro lekabbel hazzea shello letannef shear begadim, ugenay laadam latzet beoto beged levaddo:

Kappandarya. likkanes befetach ze velatzet befetach shekkenegdo kede lekatztzer hillucho derech sham. uleshon kappandarya addemakkifna dare eol beha, kelomar beod sheani tzarich lehakkif shurot shel battim akatztzer mahalachi veekkanes derech kan:
Urekika. asura behar habbayit:
Mikkal vachomer. mimminal, uma minal sheeno derech bizzayon asur, rekika shehi derech bizzayon lo kol shekken:

Kol chotme berachot shebbammikdash. hamevarech omer besof kol beracha baruch Adonai‏ elohe yisrael min haolam vead haolam chonen haddaat vechen bechullam, vehaonin omrim baruch shem kevod malchuto leolam vaed. sheen onin amen achar kol beracha shebbammikdash, dichtiv beezra (Nechemya 9) kumu barchu et Adonai‏ elohechem min haolam ad haolam, veomer achar kach vivarchu shem kevodecha, kelomar sheonim baruch shem kevod malchuto leolam vaed. veashmeinan hacha divmikdash rishon lo hayu omrim ella baruch elohe yisrael min haolam velo yoter velo hayu omrim vead haolam:

Mishshekkilkelu hamminim. sheen maaminim bitchiyyat hammetim veamru en olam ella ze, hitkinu ezra uvet dino sheyyehu omrim min haolam vead haolam lomar sheshshene olamot yesh, haolam hazze vehaolam habba, lehotzi millev hamminim shekkofrim bitchiyyat hammetim:

Sheyyehe adam shoel bishlom chavero bashshem. bishmo shel hakkadosh baruch hu, velo amrinan mezalzel hu bichvodo shel makom bishvil kevod habberiyyot lehotzi shem shamayim alav, velamdu mibboaz sheamar lakkotzrim Adonai‏ immachem, vechi tema boaz middateh denafsheh kaavad velo gamrinan minneh, ta shema min hammalach sheamar legidon Adonai‏ immecha gibbor hechayil, vechi tema lo shaal hammalach bishlom gidon, velo bercho, ella bishlichuto shel makom hodio shehashshechina immo, velo gamrinan minneh, ta shema veomer al tavuz ki zakna immecha, al tavuz et boaz lomar shemmiddato asa ella lemad mizzikne ummatcha, ki yesh lo al mi lehissamech, shenneemar et laasot laAdonai‏ heferu toratecha:

Rabbi natan omer heferu toratecha. peamim shemmevattelim divre tora kede laasot laAdonai, af ze hammitkavven lishol bishlom chavero, vezehu retzono shel makom, shenneemar (tehillim lod) bakkesh shalom veradfehu, muttar lehafer tora velaasot davar hannire asur:
Bizman shekkenafeha nogot bakken chayyav leshalleach. deamar kera rovetzet, velo meofefet. umiddechatav rovetzet velo chatav yoshevet, shema minna deim kenafeha nogot bakken chayyevet:
Shenneemar shalleach. leolam mashma:
Natal et habbanim vechulei. dechevan denatal et habbanim have leh ken mezumman:
Nittan li vimdinat hayyam. umet beni veachar kach met baali, delo mafka nafshah mechazaka kammayta, sheomeret adayin hi tzericha leyavam, neemenet umutteret lehityabbem:

Enah neemenet. lehinnase lashshuk belo chalitza, dechi hemnuha rabbanan laishsha, gabbe baalah hemnuha, mishshum dedayka uminnasva, aval leappuke nafshah miyyavam lo hemnuha, mishshum dezimnin desanya leh:
Vechoshshin lidvareha. deafka nafshah miyyavam, vecholetzet velo mityabbemet:
Mevarech al hayyayin veachar kach mevarech al hammazon. sheen birkat hammazon teuna kos. uvet hillel savre birkat hammazon teuna kos:
Onin amen achar yisrael hamevarech. veaf al pi shello shama hazekarat hashshem ella sof habberacha, demistama lashshamayim berach:
Ella im ken shama kol habberacha. shemma berach lehar gerizim:

Bechor shennitarev bemea. matnitin ayre bivchor shebba leyad kohen venafal bo mum beyad kohen umecharo leyisrael bemumo. dei bivchor beyad yisrael kodem shennetano lakkohen, ammay potrim et kullan mimmattenot kehunna, lema leh kohen, i bechor hu kulla didi hu, i lo vechor hu hav li mattentae. aval keshekkevar ba leyad kohen umecharo leyisrael bemumo venitarev bemea, potrim et kullan mimmattenot kehunna, dechol chad vechad yachol lidchot et atzmo velomar lakkohen, shelli bechor hu, shemmecharo hakkohen ufatur min hammattanot, demin habbechor en notnim mattanot, sheen kedushsha chala al kedushsha:
Echad shochet et kullan potrin lo echad. shei efshar shello yehe habbechor echad mehen, veyachol lomar ze hu:
Tzarich sheyyirshom. sheyyaase vo siman. sheyyavinu hakkol sheyyesh lechohen o lenachri shuttafut bah:
Veim amar lo. im amar kohen leyisrael para zo ani mocher lecha chutz min hammattanot shebbah:
Patur. yisrael min hammattanot:
Amar lo. yisrael lachavero tabbach, mechor li bene meeha shel para zo:
Vehayu vahen mattanot. hakkeva, shehi achat min hammattanot:
Notnan. lokeach ze lakkohen:
Veen hammocher menakke lo min haddamim. shehare haya yodea hallokeach shemmattanot sham, veze lo machar lo et hakkeva:

Lakach hemennu vemishkal. kach vechach hallitra, veshakal lo hakkeva. notnah lo lokeach lakkohen, shehare haggezela etzlo vetzarich lehashiv, vehattabbach yenakke lo min haddamim, shehare machar davar sheeno shello. veim avar hashshochet velo natan mattanot min habbehema, lo neesar habbasar baachila, aval menaddin oto. vaafillu kohen sheppatur min hammattanot, im hu tabbach sheshshochet umocher bashshuk, mamtinin lo shetayim veshalosh shabbatot, mikkan vaelach motziin mimmennu mattanot venotnin otan lechohanim acherim. veim kava bet mitbachayim, en mamtinim lo ella motziin mimmennu miyyad, veim lo ratza litten menaddin oto:
Noten tale echad lakkohen. befidyon. demimma nafshach chad minnayhu bechor:
Zachar unekeva. veen yadua im yatza zachar techilla vehu vechor, o nekeva yatza techilla veen kan din bechora:
Mafrish tale. mishshum safek, umafkia alav kedushshat happeter chamor:

Vehu leatzmo. shehu atzmo yochal hattale velo yittenennu lakkohen, dechohen have motzi mechavero, vealav haraya lehavi edim shehazzachar yatza techilla. veissura lekka, daafillu peter chamor gamur sheppedao vese shuv en kedushsha lo vo velo befidyono, ella gazel hu deikka im eno noten tale lakkohen, demamono hu, vehacha lekka gazel desafek hu:

Shete chamorot veyaldu vechulei. zachar unekeva, noten tale echad lakkohen bishvil hazzachar. o shene zecharim unekeva, dachada yalda zachar vachada yalda zachar unekeva o i nammi chada yalda shene zecharim veachat yalda nekeva, notnim tale echad lakkohen, deha chad zachar ikka vadday bechor, veaidach dahave safek deshemma hannekeva yatza techilla mafrish tale vehu leatzmo:
